Both plane endpoints and arbitrary other source-pair extensions remain open; no surface-quadric factoriality or embedding rectification is assumed. Relative critical schemes now give a separate global gate. A polynomial section over a constant two-variable base, or a base-compatible smooth curve times A1 with vertical Hessian rank one, forces gradient invertibility under unit Hessian. Its nonautomorphic members are exactly the two old endpoint source orbits. Native graph members with multiple full critical points have no relative unitization over that fixed base. Arbitrary four-variable source mixing and three genuinely free-dependent unretained coordinates remain open. One proper relative Morse component now suffices: no condition on other components is needed, and a globally proper everywhere-Morse relative projection can only have degree one. Each nonautomorphic component must therefore fail properness or contain vertical degeneracy. However each single condition separately retains exactly JC2. The universal f_M model has relative projection K and vertical Hessian -DK^T*DK, while the finite-free Fermat construction gives every K a proper relative projection with explicit monomial basis and ramification at zero. Its properness is not properness of K. Neither model automatically supplies a compatible closed ambient embedding. The two plane endpoints and unrestricted graph compatibility remain open. Uniform quadratic two-planes now have the same unique-plane rigidity under nonautomorphy as affine ones: any genuinely quadratic constant two-plane or two distinct quadratic planes closes the candidate. All unit-Hessian members have at most one full critical point. Arbitrary nonlinear free helpers and nonaligned potentials of free degree at least three remain open. Only the singleton-zero endpoint survives for these positive images. Actual positive linear source weights would close gradient invertibility, but image invariance alone does not supply that hypothesis after nonlinear source changes. Other nonlinear images and both plane endpoints remain open. The output-base gate now admits arbitrary degrees for both ambient observables: a smooth scheme-theoretic codimension-two complete intersection of their highest forms at infinity forces any carried Keller pair invertible. The leading regular sequence supplies a common filtered basis and height-one graded domains, while the explicitly imported smooth complete-intersection Picard theorem supplies generic factoriality. lessons.title: Keep algebraic field generators and coefficient moduli distinct
lessons.when: Many exact number fields are constructed from different minimal polynomials in one process.
lessons.use: Do not reuse one bare formal root expression across different supplied minimal polynomials. Use distinct formal generators for residue arithmetic, canonicalize the residue generator and assert the exact monic modulus both in the coefficient field and its polynomial ring. Independently replay the specializations from literal minimal polynomials in another backend and include known rational points as controls. Parenthesize polynomial powers in Singular expressions before rational division.
lessons.avoid: Accepting cached algebraic-field domains merely because their printed aliases look correct. The rejected v1 reuse identified QQ[w]/(w-2) with a request for QQ[w]/(w-14), producing wrong support minima. All v1 ledgers are invalidated rather than silently overwritten; old sparse proofs used no such field construction.
lessons.boundary: The repaired frame specialization uses distinct Dummy generators with modulus assertions; Singular verifies all1293 field cases. The explicit48-term witness is independently checked in Fraction polynomial arithmetic. This does not independently audit arbitrary SymPy number-field workflows.
lessons.reopen_when: A field constructor, algebraic alias scheme, polynomial coefficient domain or serialization layer changes.

lessons.use: For B[Z] with commuting derivations partial_Z and delta, use H(F)=(S_Z integral_Z F,T_Z integral_Z F). It solves every fiber linearized defect polynomially and extends any compatible finite jet hbar-adically. For a full polynomial symplectic frame, use its commuting Hamiltonian basis to identify the correction complex with polynomial de Rham cohomology. Then isolate the finite-realization, filtration or arithmetic condition that a proposed Dixmier bridge actually needs.
lessons.avoid: Promoting a restricted nonzero residue to unrestricted formal nonliftability, completing spatial variables when polynomial primitives suffice, or evaluating arbitrary hbar-adic series at hbar=1.
lessons.boundary: QFL1 cancels the retained period with polynomial current Z orders9 and8, outside QRT3's bounds1 and0. Formal existence gives no termination, common degree bound, arithmetic-support compatibility, missing fourth classical image, or DC2 coverage. Growth of one chosen formal representative does not prove intrinsic growth.
lessons.reopen_when: A canonical finite or arithmetic realization criterion is proved and a necessary degree or module bound is established for actual Weyl endomorphisms.

lessons.title: Close native base-eliminated graphs by their full boundary affine-direction classification
lessons.when: A polynomial graph eliminates x or y from the original Meng--Yang family, leaving one free base and three retained dual variables.
lessons.use: Project every hypothetical jointly affine two-plane to the one-dimensional free base, retaining both ranks. First classify every pure-dual affine direction of the complete boundary trace by polynomial degree. In the x chart any such direction forces a constant graph trace and then a singular residual coefficient pair. In the y chart a pure-dual plane maps its boundary line injectively; a moving-base plane gives the exact first normal jet and a cubic residual Jacobian whose degree 4m-1 term forces a triangular inverse. HC4MYGU0 closes zero boundary slices after arbitrary retained-dual substitutions. HC4MYGU1/2/3 reduce all origin-avoiding base-only graph reparameterizations exactly to the unit-ideal plane Keller problem, distinct from the p-chart singleton-zero problem. HC4MYGK0/1/2 add the relative critical-scheme determinant test and close every y=a(x)*p+b(x) with nonzero polynomial a after all retained-three-dual automorphisms. HC4MYGR0/1/2/3 add closed affine critical-component geometry and the generic-fibre Euler calculation, closing arbitrary nonlinear y boundary-root graphs and opposite x=a(y)*p+b(y) with a(0) nonzero. HC4MYGS0/1/2/3 add the preserved whole critical target-line map, an all-degree pole classification and the Chau/Orevkov plane-degree obstruction, excluding every nonzero-a opposite affine-p graph and reducing the full family to its base-only unit-ideal endpoint. HC4MYGN0/1/2/3 add empty-critical-scheme/Euler, initial Newton-face and finite smooth ramification gates, closing every separated y=a(x)*P(p)+b(x) in all degrees without Tang. HC4MYGM0/1/2/3 remove the whole finite polar and singular locus, require a full polynomial Bezout certificate and complete critical curve, impose an exact reciprocal conductor budget on escapes, and state the necessary entire abstract Keller-fibre realization. HC4MYGW0/1/2/3 add a genus-free whole-curve Euler/pole budget, algebraic differential descent, all quadratic p closure and a whole unbounded-degree family excluded despite passing local critical gates. HC4MYGY0/1/2/3 compare every Euler jump and one entire reciprocal-root product, closing the full positive-p y chart and leaving exactly its base-only nonautomorphic unit-ideal endpoint. HC4MYGX0/1/2/3 extend the global method to opposite nonlinear graphs, closing all simple-boundary and no-escape configurations and forcing at least six distinct critical roots in any remaining nonautomorphic mechanism. HC4MYGZ0/1/2/3 now compare the exceptional base-zero fibre and close both entire positive-p base charts, including every opposite escape; both whole p-only families retain only the base-only unit-ideal nonautomorphic endpoint. HC4MYHA0/1/2/3 extend the closure to every y=R(x,p,q) independent of old r: a general cylindrical-trace criterion combines with the all-degree plane polynomial G=P*(F^2-1)+Q*F and its square suspension, without a generic irreducibility or critical-projection assumption. HC4MYHB0/1/2/3 now use an isolated trace point and its Milnor intersection length to remove the generic-base Euler hypothesis for power-saddle traces. They close all r graphs under full (y,p,q) automorphisms fixing x and all hyperplane coordinate-triple pullbacks, including genuine old-r-dependent y graphs with unit-affine r boundary. HC4MYHC0/1/2/3 now retain the whole Hodge polynomial of one trace fibre. The positive t coefficient excludes rank zero, and genus/puncture coefficients force actual A1 Keller-fibre components in rank one. This closes arbitrary univariate-plus-saddle traces, nonlinear polynomial-coordinate r boundaries and branched trace triples, without isolated-point or generic-base data. HC4MYHD0/1/2/3 now count the whole value fibre by affine-dual row ranks, closing every one-affine-dual-direction y graph and every non-r opposite direction in arbitrary graph/coefficient degree. The pure-r opposite exception has no positive Hodge coefficient; its complete critical Hessian reduces remaining nonautomorphy to the two existing plane endpoints, without asserting a converse realization. HC4MYHE0/1/2 now compare two parallel whole trace Hodge profiles: one pure trace forces rank zero under nonautomorphy, whereas H(U)+V*a(U,W) of positive W degree and deg H>=2 cannot have a nonpositive pure signature. This closes arbitrary q-independent r boundaries with one constant nonzero-base slice. HC4MYHE3 also closes unibranch one-place boundary curves, including singular cusp powers, without that second slice. HC4MYHF0/1 now replace orientation-specific trial with the intrinsic plane: two distinct jointly affine planes force an inverse by an elementary proof, while the covectors admitting one pure trace form exactly the unique-plane annihilator under nonautomorphy. Three independent pure directions close every degree with no sign condition; two determine three concrete directional Hessian identities and otherwise retain the exact JC2 endpoint. HC4MYHF2 makes complete profiles count and reconstruct the reduced quotient fibre, preserving the two distinct unresolved ideals. HC4MYHG0/1 now use full critical schemes, critical Hessian values and entire value fibres to survive every polynomial source automorphism. Zero-boundary base graphs and split one-variable degrees at least three cannot acquire unit Hessian after any full source mixing. HC4MYHG2 identifies all full-source base-only graph orbits and the fixed degree-six p graph with the existing coordinate/unit-ideal and quadratic/singleton-zero endpoints. No new graph-degree or source-word search is warranted inside those full orbits, and neither endpoint is solved. HC4MYHH0/1 now normalize arbitrary finite reduced coefficient fibres by local orientation and three determinant-one base shears. Every nonautomorphic finite-critical cotangent candidate is right-equivalent to the explicit degree n+1 inverse-derivative template. HC4MYHH2 identifies full-source unitization for n>=2 with one relative SL2 row equation, without solving it or producing a graph embedding. All reference templates already meet the fixed-function critical/Hodge necessary conditions, so future work needs a global row/properness or embedding restriction rather than another such invariant or native-degree sweep. HC4MYHI0/1 now apply the classical global single-generator Keller criterion: one common extra reconstruction polynomial forces an inverse, while hypothetical nonautomorphic HC4 requires exactly two relative generators. HC4MYHI2 closes every embedded realization of the exact universal A=F, B=xF+yG encoding, regardless of the remaining dual function. HC4MYHI3 closes all target-dependent affine-dual output-base embeddings, including rank drops away from the image. These are genuine all-degree embedding obstructions, not a solution of the unrestricted row equation or a statement that every graph has the required global reconstruction. HC4MYHJ0/1 remove every restriction on the dual map over a fixed plane Keller output base. Disjoint constant-unit conjugate hypersurfaces form one polynomial pencil; primitive nonconstant coefficient content removes the target denominators, and smoothness makes the relation derivative a scalar unit and forces generic degree one. Thus (K(z),H(z,w)) cannot be a closed hypersurface embedding for nonautomorphic K, for arbitrary source-dependent nonlinear H. Changing only matrix descent, dual degree or embedded fibre shape is no longer a remaining direction. The exact stable additional-generator minimum is r+2, and the intrinsic cotangent pair cannot extend to ambient coordinates in A5. Arbitrary graph embeddings need not have that physical-base interpretation. HC4MYHK0/1 now make the mixed-projection boundary exact: for k linear outputs, ell their intersection dimension with the cotangent pair, the additional-generator minimum is N-k+ell under nonautomorphy. The pure-one-component lower bound uses the classical plane stable-coordinate implication; the full-pair lower bound is HC4MYHJ1. All other A5 completions are explicit source-recovery constructions, so embedding existence alone cannot close them. Keep the fixed potential identity and marked covector transfer separate. Noncoordinate directional derivatives also identify exactly the unique cotangent plane. HC4MYHL0/1 now use the fixed-potential common-zero-base trace to close every rank-one mixed gradient realization, while preserving the correct abstract embedding classification. The free eta coefficient is (-Q_s*P+P_s*Q)/J, and nonlinear composite degree makes P divide P_s, forcing a triangular pair. Only the full-eta-rank centered gradient-base stratum survives. HC4MYHL2 adds the exact distinguished-critical-value transfer and a global necessary Euler square equation, neither of which is a properness proof or a completed embedding. HC4MYHM0/1/2 now straighten the entire ambient function to lambda_star+L*T^2+N*y*Z+2*N*x*W with an explicit polynomial inverse. Every literal graph in every constant affine direction is closed under unit Hessian by the quadratic-plus-one-square or ternary quadratic trace criterion. Check four affine-linear retained normal projections before further degree work. Preserve the actual source parameterization: full source orbits of two fixed normal graphs already contain exactly the two unresolved plane endpoints. The transverse square equation alone is not universally obstructive because constant noncritical D always passes it. HC4MYHN0/1 now lower the ambient affine projection gate from four to three, including all degenerate quadratic kernels and fully nonlinear remaining coordinates. Restricted source planes expose one-extra-generator Keller recovery, while the other cases give a triangular component or affine-line fibre. There is a genuine unit-Hessian example with exactly three affine retained projections, so this strengthens the graph theorem. Two-affine normal embeddings already realize both distinct conditional endpoints with actual polynomial inverses, and no full two-affine closure or JC2 equivalence is claimed. HC4MYHO0/1/2 now separate complete endpoint branches in the two-affine geometry: a unit two-directional-partial ideal forces a unique vertical cotangent plane and an explicit relative coordinate; aligned nondegenerate kernel rank three is exactly the unit-ideal endpoint. All affine-hyperplane normal image types are classified under arbitrary source reparameterizations into the old singleton-zero/coordinate orbits or a forbidden critical-line case. New directions beyond those endpoints require nonlinear normal image hypersurfaces. No unaligned two-affine closure or singleton uniqueness from mere attainment is claimed. HC4MYHP0/1 now require checking the whole polynomial quadratic-similitude saturation, since explicit genuine nonlinear images can have zero affine pullbacks while their unchanged source potential is a closed quadratic. HC4MYHQ0/1 enlarge the output-base obstruction to linear-quadratic ambient observables through a global quadric filtration, without requiring ambient coordinate completion or fibre rectification. HC4MYHR0/1 now test relative critical sections and curve products and classify every base-only quadratic graph under unrestricted relative free-variable automorphisms, without alignment and with at most one full critical point under unit Hessian. HC4MYHS0/1/2 add a one-component proper-Morse closure and exact universal JC2 boundaries for the two separate conditions, with an explicit arbitrary-dimensional finite-free monomial-basis construction. HC4MYHT0/1 add uniform quadratic-plane rigidity and the entire fibre-affine two-affine embedding classification, with alignment forced and all base matrix degrees unrestricted. HC4MYHU0/1 now rectify isotropic-ideal image graphs explicitly and classify every compatible positive-weight invariant image into the singleton orbit or a degenerate critical-point obstruction, without assuming equivariance in actual source coordinates. HC4MYHV0/1 now test arbitrary-degree ambient output observables by a global filtered criterion and a smooth scheme-theoretic complete intersection at infinity, with the Picard input explicit. HC4MYHW0/1 replace factoriality by torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy and replace height-one graded domains by geometrically integral affine fibres; HC4MYHW2/3 close r=1 quadric pairs, specified degenerate ranks and all cyclic Danielewski powers. HC4MYHX0/1 preserve arbitrary finite monodromy descending from a regular polynomial parameter; HC4MYHX2 closes all constant-coefficient Danielewski P(z) and every T*Y+xy-B(T,z) suspension in every degree, beyond the earlier abelian class-action gate. HC4MYHY0/1 now close normal finite monogenic root covers and every monic two-parameter Danielewski output by root transitivity; HC4MYHY2 imposes a global nonmonogenicity gate on every nontrivial finite Keller normalization. HC4MYHZ0/1/2 supply the finite leading-fibre gate and independent abelian-root gate for nonmonic outputs, with exact localized-unit defect. HC4MYIA0/1/2 upgrade the unconditional nonmonic gate to finite nilpotent root/class groups and arbitrary common-prime radical depth. HC4MYIB0/1/2 add arbitrary Galois-intermediate exclusion, the exact global normalization-boundary basis, and subnormal class-stabilizer closure beyond nilpotent actions. HC4MYIC0/1/2 add combined leading-order factor divisibility, rational-label critical-curve geometry and new unrestricted-parameter S3 cubic closures. HC4MYID0/1 refine critical units to factor-specific supports and all subset rank budgets, closing a new square-discriminant S3 family with arbitrary leading multiplicity. HC4MYID2 closes reduced singleton critical units with nonconstant separation, including the cubic two-simple-leading-level case. HC4MYID3 closes the fixed cubic by a polynomial second chart omitting a hyperbola and consequently the entire specified two-simple-level square-critical class. HC4MYIE0/1/2 supply the intermediate-pole necessity, cyclic derivative surface, normal monic rescaling and unrestricted square-free-leading cubic closure. HC4MYIF0/1/2 constrain every source factorization, close square-free-leading quartics and supply a field-degree and nonnormal-order obstruction for the remaining unequal pair. HC4MYIG0/1/2 add reduced-pencil rational monodromy, one-exception polynomial parameters and all-degree scaled and reciprocal-scaled one-variable output closures. The same mechanism now closes rational scalings and rational affine input with polynomial output translation, including all sparse two-positive-term outputs without a gcd condition. HC4MYIH0/1/2 add the strict projective multiplicity bound, exact affine-in-V exception certificate and all-degree mixed-critical-value expansion outputs. HC4MYII0/1/2/3/4 add plane intermediate-branch geometry, unrestricted rational affine parameters, actual-inertia quotient certificates, all nonadjacent pure-power binomials and every cubic output. HC4MYIJ0/1/2/3 add relative central-series descent, actual product-cover preservation with arbitrary parameter monodromy, and the all-degree finite-critical-pole binomial certificate. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 add parameter-cover unit norms, integral algebraic monic models, a direct critical-value valuation lemma and unrestricted plane polynomial-output closure. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons.avoid: Dropping the pure-dual plane, checking only a normal-jet coefficient box, omitting graph-chain-rule terms, treating the finite leading-coefficient controls as an all-degree proof, or transferring native affine directions and Hessian constancy through an arbitrary nonlinear parameter change.
lessons.boundary: All earlier three-affine and ambient quadratic obstructions remain valid. Two directional partials generating the global unit ideal now force their unique plane to be the cotangent plane, give a globally affine free-variable form and an explicit relative coordinate inverse. The aligned rank-three quadratic kernel branch is exactly the unit-ideal plane endpoint. All affine-hyperplane normal images, under arbitrary source parameterizations, are exactly the singleton-zero orbit, the unit-ideal coordinate orbit, or the isotropic-through-center critical-line branch that forbids unit Hessian. Neither endpoint is resolved. Rank-one aligned fibre attainment is not singleton uniqueness; unaligned two-affine embeddings and nonlinear normal image hypersurfaces remain open with the unrestricted row equation. Polynomial quadratic-similitude saturation is now an additional global gate: if q composed with an ambient polynomial automorphism is a*q, undo it in the same source parameters before classifying retained projections or hyperplane images. The entire saturated three-affine class stays closed; the full-source hyperplane saturation retains exactly the old two endpoints or critical-line obstruction. Explicit unbounded words give zero affine pullbacks and nonlinear image equations while preserving a unit-Hessian quadratic source potential. Raw image nonlinearity is therefore insufficient. No universal rectification or generation of every quadratic symmetry is asserted. The output-base obstruction now includes a linear observable paired with any nondegenerate ambient quadratic, not only ambient coordinate pairs. In all stable dimensions r>=2, generic quadric factoriality and a height-one-compatible monomial filtration make the pencil and denominator arguments global, and smoothness forces the plane Keller base invertible. Thus an intrinsic nonautomorphic cotangent pair cannot have such an ambient extension, even after a certified ambient polynomial automorphism. Direct native A/B encodings of an independent Keller pair collapse to an invertible pair and a coordinate potential. Both plane endpoints and arbitrary other source-pair extensions remain open; no surface-quadric factoriality or embedding rectification is assumed. Relative critical schemes now give a separate global gate. A polynomial section over a constant two-variable base, or a base-compatible smooth curve times A1 with vertical Hessian rank one, forces gradient invertibility under unit Hessian. Consequently every base-only normal graph j=(s,t,h(s,t),H,G) under arbitrary relative free-variable polynomial automorphisms has at most one full critical point under unit Hessian, with no cotangent alignment. Its nonautomorphic members are exactly the two old endpoint source orbits. Native graph members with multiple full critical points have no relative unitization over that fixed base. Arbitrary four-variable source mixing and three genuinely free-dependent unretained coordinates remain open. One proper relative Morse component now suffices: no condition on other components is needed, and a globally proper everywhere-Morse relative projection can only have degree one. Each nonautomorphic component must therefore fail properness or contain vertical degeneracy. However each single condition separately retains exactly JC2. The universal f_M model has relative projection K and vertical Hessian -DK^T*DK, while the finite-free Fermat construction gives every K a proper relative projection with explicit monomial basis and ramification at zero. Its properness is not properness of K. Neither model automatically supplies a compatible closed ambient embedding. The two plane endpoints and unrestricted graph compatibility remain open. Uniform quadratic two-planes now have the same unique-plane rigidity under nonautomorphy as affine ones: any genuinely quadratic constant two-plane or two distinct quadratic planes closes the candidate. This classifies every fibre-affine two-affine embedding j=(s,t,b+A*w) in all base degrees. Global source generation requires a polynomial left inverse of A; generic rank is not enough. Alignment follows under nonautomorphy, a rank-three helper quadratic closes unconditionally, and lower ranks force a base-only helper and the two old endpoints. All unit-Hessian members have at most one full critical point. Arbitrary nonlinear free helpers and nonaligned potentials of free degree at least three remain open. Nonlinear isotropic-ideal image graphs now have explicit global quadratic isometries to hyperplanes, with arbitrary coefficients in unchanged variables and all source parameterizations. Compatible positive linear ambient weights give a constructive recognition gate: a smooth invariant image either has an isotropic tangent normal forbidding unit Hessian, or its lower-weight nonlinear terms admit a weighted Euler shear to the nonisotropic hyperplane. Only the singleton-zero endpoint survives for these positive images. Actual positive linear source weights would close gradient invertibility, but image invariance alone does not supply that hypothesis after nonlinear source changes. Other nonlinear images and both plane endpoints remain open. The output-base gate now admits arbitrary degrees for both ambient observables: a smooth scheme-theoretic codimension-two complete intersection of their highest forms at infinity forces any carried Keller pair invertible. The leading regular sequence supplies a common filtered basis and height-one graded domains, while the explicitly imported smooth complete-intersection Picard theorem supplies generic factoriality. Generic factoriality alone and smooth reduced support do not suffice; Pi=(x,xy+z^2) has an exact denominator failure. Arbitrary extensions need not have the required leading forms. Singular, nonreduced or excess-dimensional infinity intersections and both plane endpoints remain open. Generic factoriality is now relaxed by HC4MYHW0/1: torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy suffices, since Keller function fields contain no nontrivial abelian Galois intermediate field and all conjugate component classes then become zero. Geometric integrality of affine height-one fibres suffices for global primitive saturation even with nonconstant fibre units or reducible graded rings. The earlier r=1 exclusion for nondegenerate linear-quadratic output pairs is removed by HC4MYHW2, without calling the quadric surface factorial; degenerate restricted-rank-at-least-three quadratics close too. HC4MYHW3 closes cyclic Danielewski output pairs in every power m>=2, including nonreduced ordinary leading schemes and generic nonfactoriality outside every older smooth-infinity frame in the HC4-size first type. Nonabelian class actions, torsion, nonintegral height-one fibres, uncovered ranks and infinity schemes and both plane endpoints remain open. The nonabelian boundary is now narrower: HC4MYHX0/1 prove that a nowhere-critical polynomial parameter is relatively algebraically closed in the source field, using an explicit classical closed-polynomial import. A class action descending from a finite cover of that one parameter retains its full possibly nonabelian group under Keller base change, so the component classes become principal. This does not make all special parameter fibres irreducible or the whole Keller extension trivial. HC4MYHX2 closes every constant-coefficient nonconstant Danielewski P(z), with arbitrary root group, and every suspended T*Y+xy-B(T,z) with arbitrary two-variable B and all degrees. The earlier nonabelian-P(z) and suspended-coefficient escape proposals are retired. Genuinely two-parameter unsuspended monodromy, torsion, nonintegral height-one fibres, other missing filtrations and both plane endpoints remain open. HC4MYHY0 now preserves irreducibility of every normal finite monogenic cover under Keller base change, in every dimension and degree. All conjugate constant cross-resultants and integral roots rule out inertia crossing; explicit purity and finite-cover comparison inputs make the quotient trivial. HC4MYHY1 closes every two-parameter P(T,z) with nonzero constant leading z coefficient: root transitivity, without full splitting-group preservation, makes the invariant root-divisor classes zero. HC4MYHY2 forbids a globally monogenic finite normalization for any nontrivial Keller intermediate field; a nonautomorphic plane normalization needs at least two additional global algebra generators. Generic primitive elements do not provide normal monogenic models. Nonconstant leading coefficients, nonnormal monic presentations, nonglobally-monogenic normal finite algebras, other embeddings and both plane endpoints remain open. HC4MYHZ0 computes the exact torsion-free localized-unit defect as the sum of the reduced full-fibre component lattices at the zeros of a(T). HC4MYHZ1 preserves normal monogenic root-cover irreducibility on that vertical open when just those finitely many full K1-fibres are irreducible. The remaining finite etale generic-affine-line quotient is a finite Galois parameter extension, eliminated using HC4MYHX0; the explicitly imported Riemann-Hurwitz formula proves the constant-field descent. HC4MYHZ2 consequently closes every nonmonic P(T,z) under that finite-fibre gate. Independently, abelian generic root monodromy closes all such P without the fibre hypothesis, including every z degree one or two and arbitrary translated powers a(T)*(z-b(T))^m+c(T). A remaining nonautomorphic realization in this family needs both nonabelian generic root monodromy and positive localized-unit defect at a leading-coefficient zero. Generic parameter regularity does not supply the finite-fibre hypothesis, and etale affine curve maps are not automatically finite. The audited Tian-Sun 2024 claims are excluded as proof inputs. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIA0 upgrades the cyclic obstruction to full preservation of every finite nilpotent Galois target group under Keller base change in every dimension: a proper source image lies below a normal cyclic prime quotient, which would give a forbidden intermediate field. HC4MYIA1 therefore permits finite nilpotent class monodromy in the filtered output criterion. HC4MYIA2 closes every nonmonic xy-P(T,z) with nilpotent generic root group without a special-fibre assumption, including arbitrary-depth common-prime radical compositions and every composition of arbitrary quadratics. The explicit nonmonic quartic T*(z^2-T)^2 has nonabelian D8 group and is newly closed even without K1=0 irreducible. The remaining branch in this full family needs both nonnilpotent generic root monodromy and positive localized-unit defect at a leading zero. Arbitrary solvable groups do not follow: an S3 order-two subgroup escapes all normal prime-index containers. General wreath embeddings are primary context, not an additional proof import; the restricted common-prime construction is proved directly. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIB0 now excludes every finite Galois intermediate target-field extension inside a complex Keller field, in every dimension and without a group restriction: a visible index-one place reaches all primes by Galois conjugacy, then explicit purity and finite-cover inputs force triviality. This does not assert arbitrary full splitting-group preservation. HC4MYIB1 identifies the finite plane normalization class group exactly as the free group on the omitted boundary divisors; a torsion or globally factorial normalization forces the inverse. Local factoriality alone is insufficient. HC4MYIB2 closes the filtered output criterion when divisor-class stabilizers are subnormal in an arbitrary finite class-action image; normal class stabilizers suffice even for nonnilpotent groups. The Hurwitz lattice gives an explicit nonnilpotent class-module certificate, without an asserted ambient realization. The S3 root-lattice order-two stabilizer is not subnormal and remains a genuine boundary. Within nonmonic xy-P(T,z), positive localized-unit defect and nonnilpotent monodromy remain necessary unless another retained gate closes the case. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIC0 now constrains every source root-factor degree by m/gcd(m,q_1,...,q_k) when leading-drop coefficient orders lie above the single-slope chords; coprime combined orders give irreducibility and close the carried output in arbitrary z degree without a special-fibre or monodromy hypothesis. HC4MYIC1 clears a rational root to a polynomial label with an exact vertical-Jacobian identity. The constructed polynomial map omits its normalized critical curve, so the explicit qualitative Jelonek-Lason nonproperness input forces each critical component to have affine normalization A1. Independently a square-free leading coefficient dividing the next coefficient excludes rational roots. HC4MYIC2 consequently closes nonmonic cubics if a is square-free and divides b, or if the critical discriminant D=b^2-3ac has square-free part of degree at least two. This includes new S3 families with unbounded T degree and no special-fibre hypothesis. The remaining cubic branch requires a rational label, positive localized-unit defect, S3 group, D of square-free degree at most one, and failure of the independent no-pole gate; D=0 was already cyclic and closed. Critical and root discriminants are distinct, and no-rational-root is not irreducibility in arbitrary higher degree. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIC1 also gives a quantitative critical-branch unit budget: if the normalized derivative Q_U has ell distinct rational roots over C(T), monicity puts them in C[T], and the corresponding polynomial labels u-beta_i(f) are localized source units with linearly independent classes modulo C(f)^*. Hence the exact localized-unit defect sum_(a(c)=0)(r_c-1) is at least ell. For a cubic with D=b^2-3ac a nonzero square, the two distinct rational critical roots force defect at least two. This counts rational critical roots, not every root after a parameter-field extension, and does not close the residual by itself. HC4MYID0 now gives precise allowed supports for all irreducible normalized critical factors over C(T), not only rational branches: H_i(f,u) can vanish only above leading levels with H_i(c,0)=0. Independence gives every subset rank inequality, so extra defect at an excluded level cannot help. An empty support, equivalently gcd(a,H_i(T,0))=1, excludes a rational root in every degree without a special-fibre hypothesis. HC4MYID1 closes cubic square-critical-discriminant outputs whenever gcd(a,b-H)=1 or gcd(a,b+H)=1, including arbitrary pure-power leading multiplicities with b nonzero at the sole leading zero and the explicit S3 family T^q*z^3+z^2-(2R+T^q*R^2)*z/3+d. No new external theorem is imported. A surviving square-discriminant cubic needs nonempty support for both branches and the subset defect budgets; when gcd(a,b)=1, two separate reducible full f-fibres are required. The two-level coefficient control T*(T-1)*z^3+z^2-4*z/3 passes this necessary support test and is not closed by it. No higher-degree irreducibility is inferred from no rational roots. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYID2 adds a global singleton-support pencil obstruction: two reduced rational critical units, each supported at one leading level, force their polynomial critical branches to differ by a nonzero constant. Mutual divisibility modulo the reduced units and ordinary polynomial degrees prove this in arbitrary degrees. Apply the coefficient pole spectrum and the normal rescaling test before critical-factor ranks. Square-free leading cubic cases and gcd(a,b)=1 cases are closed by HC4MYIE2 regardless of critical discriminant or number of leading levels. Any remaining cubic rational root must have an actual intermediate pole at a joint multiple zero of a,a_prime,b and escape the explicit normal finite monic rescaling. Move to this joint repeated-leading obstruction, higher-degree factors without linear factors, or uncovered output geometry; do not reopen the retired square-free-leading residual. Both endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. Under gcd(a,a_prime,b_(m-1))=1, stop reopening three-factor and equal-two-factor patterns: HC4MYIF0 excludes them in every dimension. In the plane, HC4MYIF1 excludes linear factors too, closing all quartics under this gcd. A higher-degree survivor must have exactly two unequal factors of degrees at least two. Apply HC4MYIF2 resultant power, field-degree divisor and explicit nonnormal monogenic order before searching examples. Seek a structural treatment of that nonnormal order or a new boundary argument; do not declare the consistent unequal valuations contradictory. Common repeated-leading primes outside the gcd gate and both plane endpoints remain open. Before pursuing the unequal-factor nonnormal order, test whether its target root or class action descends from a reduced-pencil rational parameter. HC4MYIG0/1 preserve full finite-cover monodromy for both the reduced-pencil and one-exception polynomial tests. HC4MYIG2 closes arbitrary polynomial scalings and the stated polynomial reciprocal scalings of a fixed R, with arbitrary affine input c(T)z+beta(T); do not reopen those families by increasing leading multiplicities or coefficient degrees. Beyond these closures retain the two-unequal-factor and joint repeated-leading obstructions. A rational parameter with a constant finite pencil member, or an uncertified exceptional fibre, is not admitted. Global affine height-one fibre hypotheses and both endpoint problems remain in force. The independent-numerator one-exception rational test now permits rational A,c,beta with polynomial B and final polynomiality. Every sparse a*z^m+b*z^(m-1)+d is closed, regardless of shared leading zeros. Beyond this family keep numerator-denominator independence and the exceptional multiplicity gcd explicit. For a rational parameter with several nonreduced members, first compute exact content multiplicities, include the infinity denominator, check numerator-denominator independence and an actual simple factor in each exceptional member. HC4MYIH0 closes strict sum below two in all degrees. HC4MYIH1 makes this an exact coefficient certificate for affine-in-V parameters with square-free nonconstant denominator. HC4MYIH2 closes the certified critical-point expansion families, including mixed critical values and repeated leading zeros; do not reopen them by increasing degrees. At equality retain the four numerical lists and degree congruences but no closure; the cubic rational counterexample forbids replacing the strict inequality by a weak one. Beyond the certificates retain the unequal-factor order, other repeated-leading cases and both plane endpoints. Do not reopen any plane rational affine-in-V parameter, final-polynomial rational affine fixed-polynomial output, cubic output, or pure-power nonadjacent binomial by raising degrees or adding leading multiplicities. Use HC4MYII0/1/2/3/4 first. For a new plane splitting cover compute actual divisorial inertia on branch curves without polynomial A1 parametrizations, its normal subgroup, root or class-group invariants and the remaining quotient; transitivity alone proves only irreducibility. General higher-degree coefficient variation with parametrizable critical curves remains a useful frontier. Preserve all-dimensional IH0 hypotheses when working in n>=3. Neither plane endpoint is closed. First use HC4MYIJ0/1 to separate arbitrary parameter-cover monodromy from a relatively central or nilpotent commuting geometric kernel; do not demand the whole residual quotient be nilpotent. Certify the actual product open and algebraic quotient descent, including the stronger full-faithfulness import. For a binomial compute whether a^q divides b^m before degree or group calculations: a finite pole closes all admitted degrees by HC4MYIJ3, including arbitrary a with constant lower coefficient. If no finite pole exists, reuse retained rational-parameter and normal-rescaling gates; investigate only cases outside them, or more general nonproduct critical arrangements. A nilpotent normal kernel with nontrivial quotient conjugation is not enough. Preserve plane-only scope of the nonparametrizable branch test. Neither plane endpoint is closed. Do not reopen any positive-z-degree plane output (T,xy-P(T,z)) by increasing coefficient degrees, leading multiplicities, exponent gaps, factor degrees, critical genera or parameter-cover complexity: HC4MYIK3 closes the entire class. Retain older evidence for its full-group or all-dimensional strengths. Use the all-dimensional IK0/1/2 norm and integral-model tests when relevant, preserving all conjugate integrality and actual source normality. The next meaningful plane frontier is compatible ambient observables for arbitrary graph embeddings, other output geometries and the actual endpoint source orbits. Ordinary Luroth is an explicit import; no Ritt classification or dynamical good-reduction theorem is used. Neither plane endpoint is closed. Do not reopen fixed disjoint-multiplier suspensions (T,A(X)Y-P(T,Z)) with A in C[X] nonzero and positive joint Z degree by adding variables, multiplier factors, multiplicities, coefficient degrees or stable dimensions: HC4MYIL2 closes the entire class and its ambient/target polynomial automorphism saturation. Generic factor counts use the outer degree, not joint degree, and S need not be a coordinate. A useful next gate is genuine parameter-dependent or overlapping multiplier geometry, with correlated Galois row/root actions and a verified global filtration; another is finding compatible observables for arbitrary HC4 graph embeddings. Preserve the actual fixed/disjoint and positive-degree conditions and the plane-only unrestricted Keller application. Neither plane endpoint is closed. Do not reopen disjoint moving multiplier rows by correlated monodromy: HC4MYIM0/1 split them over the parameter field while preserving outer source transitivity. For a proposed global output first compute the coefficient content and verify the exact generic content-level condition, then provide a common free filtration. Either unit highest graded multiplier/root coefficient is sufficient, and the IM3 adapted presentation closes (1+h B)Y-h b-Z in every nonlinear degree even without either original leading unit. A constant content level gives an immediate no-carried-Keller contradiction. Only genuine missing global frames, nonconstant composite content fibres, overlapping variables, different output geometries or the actual endpoint source/observable problem justify new work. Preserve the original-plane inertia argument, the horizontal qualification and the distinction between irreducibility and full groups. Neither plane endpoint is closed. For the IM3 parameter-unimodular template, verify gcd(A_0,h)=1 and the independent multiplier coefficient-content condition before using the determinant-one helper transformation. It already permits moving B(T,X), multivariable b(T,Z) with unit graded leading monomial, and arbitrary parameter-dependent affine root terms. Do not reopen it through nonunit original top coefficients, parameter degrees or extra root variables; investigate genuinely missing global frames or composite content levels instead. The strict joint degree-gap and univariate leading-divisibility families are closed in every degree. Do not reopen them by increasing remainder, parameter or source degrees. A remaining frame case must fail an actual structural hypothesis, such as divisibility of the positive-X coefficient row by the leading coefficient of P, or require a genuinely new global presentation. Do not reopen primitive disjoint moving suspensions, or the exact closed-content family, merely because their original or adapted global frame is missing. HC4MYIN0/1 bypass it. A new case must instead violate the exact content-level condition, use overlapping variables or another geometry, or address compatible observables and actual endpoint representatives. For general pencil descent retain faithful flatness, geometric height-one integrality, the generic positive filtration and the dimension-two reflexive argument. A flat map omitting a target point is insufficient. Do not reopen monic overlapping root outputs, or the certified Bezout leading family, through arbitrary lower overlapping coefficients, nonunit parameter leading terms or increased degrees. Use IO0 on the independent multiplier-component field and IO1 for the row action; then check the exact full content-level condition and only a generic positive filtration. Coefficients identified with the original source variables are outside IO0. A new overlap case must fail an actual residual-direction, content or generic-filtration hypothesis, or address other observables and actual endpoint realizations. Neither endpoint is closed. For a class-principal faithfully flat observable with integral height-one fibres, test relative additive actions on the actual image equation before seeking another generic filtration. Any locally nilpotent action moving it closes the carried pair; do not replace local nilpotence by an arbitrary derivation. For polynomial-direction overlaps, a survivor must have E in F[X], and for primitive multipliers E lies globally in C[T,V,X]. Only an additive-invariant image, a failed residual-direction/content hypothesis, another geometry or an actual endpoint/observable realization justifies reopening. One stationary action is not a nonautomorphy certificate, and its natural kernel is not automatically the full Makar-Limanov invariant. Do not reopen any one-multiplier-variable polynomial-direction overlap with admitted closed content levels through nonunit leading coefficients, different row degrees, missing generic filtrations, nonprimitive content or failure of the map forgetting root variables to be flat. IQ0 descends the helper before differentiating; IQ1 checks both multiplier substitution cases before concluding the entire field degree is one. A new HC4 overlap case in the admitted family must have exactly two helpers and one root variable, with the actual additive-invariant plane-curve image; failed residual/content hypotheses, other observables and actual endpoint realizations remain separate. Rational helper recovery is not itself global reconstruction, and no stable quotient cancellation is assumed. Do not reopen any one- or two-helper polynomial-direction overlap satisfying the residual and exact full closed-content hypotheses through absent generic ambient filtrations, nonprimitive content, different row degrees, singular helper curves or finite omitted helper points. IR0 checks the multiplier-zero image before localization; IR1 proves generic forgetful flatness, the actual helper/source component bijection, curve surjectivity and scalar units, then uses their pencil and IQ0. The complete admitted HC4 overlap family is closed in all degrees. A new HC4 proposal must leave its residual/content hypotheses or observable geometry, or prove compatible arbitrary-graph observables or actual endpoint realizations. Curve dominance implies surjectivity here by a finite-line proof; surface dominance does not. Higher-helper geometry in larger stable dimensions needs a new argument, since positive-dimensional coefficient-drop loci can create full fibres. A failed residual direction is not automatically a tractable extension of the admitted family: IS0/1/2 place every plane Keller pair in that failure class even with all geometric target fibres smooth and integral and an actual unit-Hessian embedding. A universal extension must address the source-correlated exceptional class lattice, or supply additional compatibility with the intrinsic coefficient pair of a nonautomorphic HC4 gradient. Do not infer zero source-fixed classes from scalar generic units, primitive content, one irreducible moving multiplier row, a smooth global image, or good target fibres. The constructed gradient is always invertible and does not encode the carried pair as its intrinsic nonautomorphic coefficient pair. Any claim of a new residual-free closure must explain how it avoids or resolves this exact JC2 equivalence; it must not merely assume the selected geometric source class principal. Before choosing ambient observables, test exact intrinsic Nambu-energy or inverse-Hessian certificates. Nonautomorphy requires one common two-dimensional covector plane containing every finite-energy, zero-square and pure whole-trace direction. Any three independent certified directions, a finite direction with nonzero square, or an inverse-Hessian zero cone of another exact shape closes the candidate. Do not infer a recurrence from a finite derivative prefix or infer nonautomorphy from a plane-shaped cone: the quartic-base automorphic control has that same cone. Existence of the needed extra intrinsic direction is not established, and arbitrary carried pairs remain different from intrinsic nonautomorphic coefficient data. For a reconstructed intrinsic pair, check whether two ambient affine functions centered at the ambient critical point retain a constant invertible free frame plus polynomial base offsets and have critical-value trace. IU1 then closes the candidate without restricting higher helper jets. A constant noncritical trace has only rank one and needs a new argument; its first-jet corrections do not prove global source recovery. The universal compensation IU2 cannot encode a nonautomorphic pair by an immersion, and actual unit Hessian or an embedded zero-section does not make it an embedding. Do not silently substitute a base-dependent free frame, assume ambient translations preserve Hessian, or transfer the plane nilpotent-Jacobian inverse lemma to higher dimensions. Audit a proposed one-helper recovery in codimension one, not only at the generic field or zero-section. For a primitive helper its implicit derivative must fail on an actual source divisor under nonautomorphy; moving all failures to codimension at least two, a missing boundary, or a normal implicit hypersurface closes the map. Componentwise saturation or positive-power target descent also closes it. The canonical Legendre hypersurface supplies the intrinsic helper, but normality of the actual HC4 image does not transfer to that different image. Full compensation data have exact syzygy gauge freedom and still require global ring generation; arbitrary quadratic-preserving source formulas do not certify ambient automorphisms. Do not reopen the retained constant-trace free-projection family at a noncritical value or by adding higher helper terms: IW0/1/2 close it in every degree using actual integral middle cycles. Work instead on nonconstant trace, existence or failure of aligned intrinsic ambient projections, or an actual endpoint representative. Retain IV1/2 normality and source-divisor gates for these residual cases; actual closed embedding is still stronger than immersion, and no normality transfer to a different image is automatic. Do not replace the IW section class by an arbitrary closed affine-plane class or by its zero pushforward to the total level family. For nonconstant rank-one traces first enforce the actual closed immersion of the radical zero curve. An A1 component or coordinate-composite normal trace is closed. If the trace square descends, every target zero component must be singular and polynomially parametric under hypothetical failure; smooth or nonparametric components are closed. The remaining gates are singular descended curves, genuinely non-descended normal traces, higher helper ranks and intrinsic ambient projection existence. Do not reopen contractible descended cusps or saturated contractible radical components: IY0/1/2 close them using the explicitly imported Lin-Zaidenberg classification and a proved one-puncture pencil argument. First enforce complete inverse image and retain finite-image boundary points in nu_s=d nu_t+E. Under hypothetical failure every descended component has an internal multibranch point, chi<=0, and, when target nu>0, source nu at least triple target nu. The next gates are such multibranch components, unsaturated non-descended traces, higher helper ranks or intrinsic ambient projection existence; equal generic pencil invariants are not automatic from an isomorphic singular zero curve. Do not reopen any rank-one target-descended trace, even with a nodal radical component or arbitrarily high helper jets: IZ0/1/2 close the entire family, including positive-power rational descent. For a one-place radical component, first require the full source inverse image; any hypothetical failure has an additional source prime outside the radical curve. Work next on genuinely non-descended traces with such unsaturated image curves, higher helper ranks or intrinsic ambient projection existence. The new intrinsic genus formula uses explicitly imported compactification and proper-flat normalization foundations, not ambient equivalence or zero-fibre geometric genus alone. Do not leave the extra source divisor abstract: JA0/1/2 enforce a(K)=f g with (f,g)=1, disjointness from the whole radical curve, and a forced multi-puncture component carrying a nonconstant source unit whenever a one-place selected component is present. Scalar units on all additional components close that case. For an A1-normalized selected component at most one additional one-place component can occur, only in the all-nodal case, and a finite-image boundary remains compulsory. Next use full w-dependent global source recovery to exclude these units and boundary valuations, force target descent/saturation, or address higher helper rank and intrinsic ambient alignment. Do not turn a unit modulo f or a Nisnevich square into global invertibility. Do not extend the normal-jet order as an additional closure test: JB0 makes every such order automatic. A new implication must establish global rational recovery or a uniform target degree bound, target descent, full component saturation, or a different intrinsic embedding obstruction. A pole at the finite-image boundary is not excluded by local etaleness or the divisor section. Do not revisit those centered semisimple graph images by increasing source or graph degree: JC0/1 exclude the entire orbit. A new image mechanism must escape the stated spectral/common-center certificate or supply a different global recovery implication. Do not search larger outer or source degrees in a nilpotent quadratic-composite graph for a new endpoint: JD0 gives exactly the full nondegenerate quadratic orbit. A new centered-pencil mechanism must use a nonzero eigenvalue and a nontrivial Jordan block; independent shifts and other image geometries remain separate. Do not reopen any admitted commonly centered quadratic-composite graph by changing Jordan type, outer degree or source parameterization: JE0/1 complete that family. A new mechanism must address independent centers, different image geometry, the actual old endpoint or the full w-dependent global recovery/alignment obligations. Keep inverse closure distinct from unit-Hessian nonexistence. Do not reopen the admitted invertible cyclic affine-pencil source orbits or seek a new endpoint in nilpotent affine-offset graph families by increasing degrees. A new affine-pencil mechanism must escape cyclicity, use the stated singular quadratic double-infinity resonance, or fail an actual finite-pole stationarity condition. Keep both boundary checks explicit and retain the original full-embedding/global-recovery alternatives. Do not reopen any admitted four-variable cyclic affine-pencil branch, including its former double-infinity resonance or stationary-numerator congruence proposal. JG0/1 close the full nonlinear source orbit geometrically. Use a genuinely noncyclic nonnilpotent offset, a different image mechanism, the actual old endpoint or the full embedding/global recovery/alignment obligations; do not confuse inverse closure with nonexistence. Do not reopen an invertible simple-spectrum affine pencil by changing the offset or source degree: JH0/1 exclude every such nonlinear source orbit. For a remaining noncyclic case first test the actual Krylov pairing, inactive primary type, active pole-order budget and infinity term. Keep compatible simple critical groups separate from multiple-pole escaping residues, then use geometry or the original full-embedding/global-recovery obligations. Do not reopen an invertible semisimple four-variable affine pencil by changing its projected isotropic offsets, eigenvalue multiplicities, outer degree or source degree: JI0/1 cover them all. A remaining affine candidate must be singular or nonsemisimple and still escape the earlier certificates. In the singular rank-one two-critical-point model the equal native Hessians and profile L^3-2L already pass; another invariant or actual global source/embedding argument is required, not the same critical/Hodge test again. Do not increase multiplier/remainder/compensated-graph degree or base-preserving automorphism degree in this branch: JK0/1 already give the four-orbit reduction and exclude all base-preserving maps for deg C>=2. Do not repeat special-value Hodge jumps for h0,h1: the whole formula already passes. A remaining full-source attempt must change C[x,z] and needs a proved intrinsic alignment, a new global source-orbit invariant or actual embedding recovery; no arbitrary two-point Keller row normalization is available. Do not reopen any invertible four-variable affine quadratic pencil by changing Jordan type, offset, Krylov degeneracy, outer degree or source degree: JL0/1 cover them all. A remaining affine mechanism must have singular T and still escape all earlier centered/cyclic/nilpotent and general rational/geometric certificates. Keep the actual h0,h1 full-source/base-change gate, other singular nonnilpotent geometry or the original full-embedding recovery obligation; no larger invertible-Jordan or polynomial-degree table is an active gate. Do not increase any rank-one multiplier, offset, outer, graph or source degree: JM0/1 give the complete invariant resonance and the same four fixed universal tests for all rank-at-most-one pencils. For a higher-rank singular pencil first test an actual isotropic zero eigenvector orthogonal to the offset and use the explicit polynomial shear. Transfer a critical-mass identity through quadratic stabilization, not bare nonexistence or inverse closure. Keep the h0/h1 full-source base-change gate, rank-two/rank-three singular geometry and actual global recovery open. Do not reopen compatible inner centers or admissible isotropic zero directions by changing Jordan type, offsets or degrees: JN0/1 give the four-test reduction. Do not assume an arbitrary unstabilized inverse/nonexistence conclusion is stable; use the proved specific families or actual complete critical mass. An additional affine mechanism beyond h0,h1 and the old endpoint orbits must have a quadratic-coordinate inner, singular rank-two/rank-three T and no admissible null direction. Analyze its explicit cubic/quartic-plus-univariate source normal form or actual full embedding recovery, without treating that normal form as Hessian invariance. Do not reopen isotropic-kernel pencils or the cubic coordinate-inner family by outer/source degree, coefficient or Jordan type: JO0/1 give the complete four-test reduction. Work beyond those tests on the simple-zero nondegenerate-kernel quartic with nonzero offset and two nondegenerate ternary forms, or actual global recovery. The fixed tests and quartic remain open; a polynomial source coordinate does not imply native Hessian invariance or Keller target generation. Do not reopen arbitrary-outer simple-zero quartic, nonresonant mixed-plane or ternary-cone searches by degree/Jordan type: JP0/1/2 reduce them to the four old tests plus F_N=q+alpha x+e z+t(lambda q+N-c),q=2xy+z^2,N=0,x^2,2xz,lambda*c*e!=0. Work on full-source alignment or an invariant stronger than their passing full profiles/common Hessians, or actual global recovery. Do not infer these models solved or source-equivalent to h0,h1, and do not confuse these resonant cubic functions with the previously reduced cubic coordinate-inner generating family. Do not reopen length-two versus scalar resonant families or lambda,c,e normalization: JQ0 supplies literal polynomial maps and inverses. Work on full-source changes of the natural base for fixed K2=w(2xy+z^2-1)+z or K3_rho=w(2xy+z^2-1)+2x(rho-z)+z,or prove an actual K2 equivalence with h1,or pursue global embedding recovery. JQ1 excludes every map preserving C[x,w] for K2 and C[w,y] for K3,without degree bounds. Do not apply its constant-plane rank argument to an unproved nonlinear distribution,assume arbitrary quadratic-suspension closure,or treat passing full profiles as inverse closure. Do not reopen C[x]- or C[y]-preserving source routes for h0,h1,or C[P]/C[V]-preserving routes in the actual S_rho suspension representative: JR0/1 exclude them in every source degree and every constant-slope-compatible higher normal jet. Do not seek a K2/h1 equivalence preserving x or y. Full K2/h1 equivalence may still change both algebras,and K2 one-coordinate unit-Hessian routes remain open because its slopes are unequal. For native K3 use the actual left-composed source map into the suspension representative,not a nonlinear conjugation of the Hessian. Work on genuinely unrestricted alignment or actual global recovery. Do not reopen affine-linear JR hyperbolic pullbacks or attempt coordinate recovery by the complete full-potential ML/DK algebras: JS0/1 settle those gates. Do not search either standard K2 translation module or its K2-preserving source-conjugacy saturation for the required action; every generic fibre has fixed points. Seek a different action with the exact polynomial kernel,fixed planes and whole generic freeness,or prove its impossibility,while retaining actual source recovery. This is not an exhaustion of actions fixing x and does not close K2 one-coordinate unit Hessian. A free action,kernel invariant or matching jet is not a source map producing unit Hessian; global embedding recovery remains an alternative. Do not change action speed,replica degree or kernel generators inside a standard K2 embedded invariant field or its value-preserving source conjugate: JT0/1 exclude every such action. Any candidate must use a genuinely different embedded quotient field and satisfy primitivity plus the proper nonprincipal plinth test. Abstract kernel isomorphism is not embedded-field equality. To turn an action into unit Hessian,use JT2 full global coordinate-action certificate with its actual inverse and the SAME base pair; a free action,three-variable kernel,local slice or formal jet is insufficient. Do not transfer principal-plinth theorems from three to four variables. Other actions,one-coordinate K2 routes and actual global embedding recovery remain open. Use JU0/1 exact quotient and torsor geometry for any genuinely different action: require N reduced plinth lines,one reached fixed-plane point per line,and the socle class with exact value-dependent annihilator and common-orientation affine residues. These tests remain necessary,not sufficient; recover JT2 actual complete coordinate inverse and SAME base pair or prove that recovery impossible. JU2 exhausts local volume periods for all remaining normalized models,so do not extend their local coefficient calculations. Global periods,geometry at infinity and genuinely different quotient embeddings remain possible routes. Use JV1 global kernel,two polynomial slices,Keller coefficient pair and the common affine-socle congruence as an equivalent positive certificate; the complete source inverse follows by exact denominator cancellation. JV0 recovers a B-coordinate frame from radical plinth holes and source codimension two,with five proved algebraic imports checked in context. Apply JV2 unsquared coefficient orientation and GL2(B) pair classification,not just squared critical Hessians. Seek a genuinely different embedded action or obstruct globally Keller generators of its oriented ideal. Do not keep a separate coordinate-frame existence gap after the exact JV hypotheses are met. Auxiliary all-N T_N models do not belong to the original graph frontier without a proof of realization. Do not reopen K2 source maps with Phi^*x or Phi^*y affine: JW2 excludes them,including all C[x]/C[y]-preserving maps. Keep the distinction from arbitrary actions merely fixing x,which are not classified. Use JW0 for other actual generic two-variable coordinates in affine modification charts: clear a least pole and test its exceptional geometric curve factor. A rational-field generator or native coordinate alone is insufficient,and a specialization may be a proper polynomial in a coordinate. For full K2 progress,change both native hyperbolic pullbacks nonlinearly or prove an intrinsic alignment forcing one to remain affine. Retain the JV exact slice certificate and globally Keller oriented-ideal target. Use the contracted universal affine frontier: two old endpoint inversion requirements,no two-point Keller fibre,and no unit S_rho for any rho. Do not require a separate K2 exclusion to prove that universal property once E2 is absent. Do not infer the individual K2 orbit from E2,identify h0 with h1 as functions,or treat unsquared fixed-base orientation as a full-source invariant. The explicit sign twist changes x while keeping z. Seek a global two-point Keller obstruction or a genuinely global three-point argument;retain actual embedding recovery as a separate route. Do not reopen K2 maps with any native affine coordinate pullback,or S_rho maps with any affine u,v,P,V pullback in its actual suspension frame;JY excludes all these classes in every degree. Native K3 w/y are covered,but its x/z are not the nonlinear frame P/V. h0/h1 also exclude w affine,while the z-preserving route remains exactly E2. Use the whole-torus gate only for the entire relative/Keller fibre with the specified two zeros,not an isolated torus component or an arbitrary two-point fibre. Seek intrinsic global alignment or the contracted global Keller/embedding gates. Do not deepen unmarked relative A1-type or stable-motivic invariants of the normalized smooth value family on the stated dense open:JZ proves the exact type already matches the necessary cotangent family over that open. Revisit only with actual scheme/action structure,marked quotient or volume data,gluing across deleted critical values,or an invariant not factoring through that homotopy object. Do not infer an action or source isomorphism from an A1-equivalence. Retain all completed coordinate-visibility barriers and the contracted E2/three-point/endpoint frontier. Do not seek additional global middle-homology native-volume periods or a hidden cycle index in the normalized models:KA computes the entire integral basis,monodromy and period functional,including collisions. Do not identify cycles with equal periods,or upgrade a period match to source equivalence. Revisit global topology only with data outside that object,such as a proved source-invariant Seifert or thimble/boundary marking. Actual quotient/torsor geometry,critical scheme gluing and embedding recovery remain alternatives;the two-point gate and contracted universal frontier remain open. Use the explicit alignment gates:for each rho compare S_rho with R_rho=a3 X P+C3 Q+D_rho,independently of the global E3 gate. Any K2 unit would require a full K2/h1 source equivalence as well as E2. Do not deepen homological Seifert matrices or positive infinity-relative homology:KB2 forces their complete values. Revisit infinity topology only with actual regular-link or Milnor-piece embedding data beyond those groups;vanishing homology does not imply empty or contractible pieces. The normal-form classification assumes an actual cotangent frame and simple coefficient zeros,not arbitrary source polynomials or original graph realization. Use one actual action and its exact quotient/plinth/global-slice data,or an intrinsic full-source invariant beyond complete relative ML/DK and collective orbit patterns. The latter are now completely matched by KC0/1/2 for S_rho/R_rho and K2/h1. Collective transitivity does not supply a single free action or identify the additive ind-groups. The native a3(z)=0 divisor moves under the explicit lift,but transported torus fixed schemes have not been classified. Keep E_N separate from source alignment and preserve the endpoint inversion requirements. Use the simplified KD action gate:construct or obstruct one h-preserving LND with exact embedded polynomial kernel B[h] and exact radical plinth I B[h] for a nonempty finite-point ideal in the same polynomial plane B. Do not add separate source-codimension,quotient-image,fixed-plane,one-root or global-slice requirements:KD0/1 forces them on A4. Neither the radical of the plinth alone nor collective flexibility gives these exact algebraic hypotheses. After the native common critical Hessian condition,KB makes this equivalent to the explicit source alignment;E_N remains a separate gate. Use the weaker KE action gate:construct or obstruct one h-preserving LND with exact embedded kernel B[h] and exact plinth I B[h] for any proper finite-colength ideal in B. Do not add radicality,local complete intersection or two generators as independent premises for the native frontiers:the full finite-cycle basis forces them. Exact full ideal descent is still required;its radical support is insufficient. The nonreduced A4 two-Morse-point control shows why finite critical data alone cannot replace cycle exhaustion. Keep source alignment and E_N separate;neither original endpoint inversion is resolved. Use the KF one-value gate:one h-preserving LND with actual embedded ker B[h],fixed finite cylindrical radical support,and actual plinth-ideal fibre length N at one value. Support count is forced by native H3;nilpotent length is constant across all values,so any remaining thickness is generic. The action is a constant multiple of Jac(b1,b2,h,-). Prove minimum length via a new local quotient/multiplicity argument;primitive Morse-cycle projection alone does not prove normal transversality. Do not substitute the specialized action plinth or class annihilator. A direct faithful-flat line-bundle principalization cannot change this codimension-two ideal into a divisor;only a separately certified nonflat or associated-graded construction could change that setting. E_N stays separate and endpoints remain open. After KG0/1/2,the native three-point action must use a different embedded quotient field from both whole standard modules and their h-preserving conjugates. Retain the KF actual fixed-cylinder kernel/plinth and one-minimum-length ideal-fibre test. A Morse first-jet argument needs the fixed-cylinder hypothesis;primitivity alone fails in the explicit quadric control. All-action classification,alignment,E_N and endpoints remain open. Use KH0/1/2 to target the global algebraic action:prove saturation at the Morse value of the normalized residue embedding T_i to its finite Laurent coefficient module,or verify generic rank1 of its full weighted Hankel form using supplied actual slice powers. The leading normalized class is reduced automatically and is not an ideal-fibre length certificate. Local Morse-volume data and even all compatible nilpotent jets admit arbitrary-thickness controls without a global LND. Retain the KG exclusion of standard embedded quotient classes,the KF actual one-value scheme gate,and independent E_N/endpoints. Use KI critical-type recognition:prove the ACTUAL local plinth fibre Gorenstein at each labelled Morse value,or bound the local generators of F1=ker(delta^2) by3. Generic Gorensteinness and the specialized class are insufficient. Remaining fat components must have a genuine critical non-Gorenstein type jump,at least3 local plinth generators and at least4 first-module generators. Locally complete-intersection h-dependent cases are closed. Do not impose rank-two local freeness;the desired quadric already fails it. lessons.when: Conditional GL1 gives the polynomial Gaussian phase of W*(a+T+Z^2)+G(Z,T), deg G<=3, and a scalar height-six argument is needed.
lessons.use: Rescale z=t*(a+Y), keep the factor 1/t and connection d/dt+Phi_t-1/t. Formal pure vanishing yields a rational horizontal functional on the seed-generated submodule even if the seed is not cyclic. Extend analytically and invoke the precise Hien--Roucairol period comparison. Classify V=G(z,-a-z^2) by degree, retain degenerate bounded saddles and every quartic escape saddle, and show zero-action normalized periods decay. To obtain a finite gate, bound the rational connection by N/H with degrees B=3d+3, then the minimal-seed polynomial cofactors by B*q*(q+1)/2. The no-constant-period result makes the zeroth scalar coefficient nonzero, yielding the sufficient gate 320.
lessons.avoid: Dropping the 1/t Jacobian, assuming the seed cyclic, treating a divergent formal Gaussian integral as convergent, specializing away degenerate critical points, overlooking escaping saddles, or promoting the old timeout to a unit certificate.
