lessons.reopen_when: A genuinely omitted coupling changes the phase degree, produces finite poles/relative endpoints, or alters the prefactor; reclassify every period block before applying the obstruction.

lessons.title: Use a low-degree exact unit row to eliminate a linear constant globally instead of managing pivot charts
lessons.when: A necessary system is E5=0 and DiZ-Ei=0, with a nonzero-Jacobian condition, and all-zero coefficient cases obstruct generic elimination.
lessons.use: Seek bounded-degree polynomial multipliers with sumCiDi=1. Choose Macaulay coefficient rows mod a good prime only as a heuristic, restrict the selected exact field system to rational scalars, solve it with exact Dixon arithmetic, then verify the entire sparse polynomial identity modulo the irreducible defining field polynomial. The unit row excludes the common-zero stratum and gives Zstar=sumCiEi everywhere. Verify equality of compatibility and saturation ideals and keep recovered polynomials as exact circuits.
lessons.avoid: Promoting modular row selection or a selected square solve to a full proof; relying on a unit Groebner flag without the intended certificate; losing parameter points by pivot inversion; expanding huge number-field recovery polynomials unnecessarily; assuming the reduced four-parameter compatibility ideal is solved; or allowing a timed wrapper to leave an unobserved solver child running.
lessons.boundary: PF2RULED28 gives explicit degree3 unit rows over both degree-eight marked fields, verified by full rational sparse polynomial arithmetic moduloP8. It closes the entire degree8 all-zero-D stratum at all sixteen marked points and recovers Zstar polynomially with degree<=18, preserving nonzero MsZstar and all individual coefficient-zero cases. The four-parameter core has compatibility degree<=22 but is unsolved. Actual section lifts, higher equations, nonrooted determinant/rank-drop cases and finite-map obligations remain open. Restriction of scalars with FLINT Dixon avoids the slow generic field solve and direct Groebner lift.
lessons.reopen_when: Current user priority is general all-degree geometry, primary literature and overarching obstructions, rather than progressively deeper fixed-coefficient strata. PF2RULED32 identifies the whole exceptional curve and imports Chau to force two finite critical values in every target-coordinate projection and compulsory boundary collisions. The degree-d monodromy is S_d and any meridional generating set has size>=d-1. For degree4, missing values are exactly a nonempty finite boundary collision set K, with b1(C)=|K|. Seek a global obstruction to those collisions on the actual finite Wright algebra, or an upper bound on meridional generators for forced image families; do not assume surjectivity or trace tangency. The all-order explicit jet family contracts a retained source line despite arbitrarily long boundary agreement, so a uniform boundary-jet cutoff cannot replace global source regularity and finiteness. Retain the fixed-pole results and PF2RULED31, but the quadratic-M calculation is a historical checkpoint, not the default next gate. PF2RULED31 excludes the entire rooted degree8 stratum degM<=1, including zero, by exact inverse identities U*E5=1 modulo(M2,M3,M4,M5) in both quartic fields. Do not retry constant or linear M, or retain constant D as open on the compatibility locus. Every remaining core point has degM=2,3,4 or5 and degD>=1. Extend the coefficient-degree stratification where it yields finite reduction spaces: match the actual necessary E circuits, retain full polynomial memberships, and solve exact rational multiplication-inverse systems instead of direct dense number-field inversion. The complete full-core unit certificate over both quartic fields is still missing; preserve the actual-root hypothesis, nonzero condition, arbitrary rank drops and every original global realization obligation. PF2RULED30 transports the complete rooted degree8 quadratic and four-parameter necessary presentations, including exact unit rows, to the two quartic fixed fields F=Q(y^2). Use the retained descended equations/circuits and seek an exact F-coefficient unit identity for the full nonzero-kappa core, or an unsaturated power-of-kappa certificate, in both sectors. This covers both sign choices and all16 octic embeddings with4N rather than8N rational unknowns forN field coefficients. The actual-root and nonzero conditions and all later/global obligations remain; no full-core exclusion follows from the earlier residue units. PF2RULED29 gives an equivalent 38-variable39-quadratic presentation of the same rooted degree8 necessary core, with27 auxiliaries uniquely recovered by fixed field pivots. lessons.title: Separate smooth trace isotropy, good generators and extension-field versality
lessons.when: Eliminating two coefficients of a universal Keller compiler, importing Hermite-Joubert results, or claiming a complexity minimum from arithmetic existence.
lessons.use: For N>=7 impose Tr(theta)=Tr(theta^2)=0. A point outside the trace radical makes the quadric rational, hence its primitive-and-denominator good open has points over infinite fields. Use weights5,8 in rank seven and weights5,6 thereafter. For universality over all extensions use the binary block trace form; Brassil--Reichstein makes it exact when N is invertible. The sqrt(-14) rank-seven vector and Duncan lower bound give an actual target-dimension minimum.
lessons.avoid: Calling a fixed-field u-invariant or number-field local-global result field-versal, accepting a scalar radical point as a good generator, treating minimum dimension as canonical descent, or using the new septic first/third-trace covariant without checking its remaining weights6,8 and denominator open.
lessons.boundary: Characteristic two is excluded. N>=7 is required for the displayed polynomial sections. Binary necessity is imported only when N is invertible; modular ranks retain a sufficient nonconstant-vector condition. Quadratic family sections are etale-local in general, not automatically Zariski-local. The N-6 stable-class defect is construction-specific and characteristic zero. The recent septic paper proves its characteristic-zero field-extension theorem; its wider announced finite-etale theorem is not used as a proved input.
lessons.reopen_when: A different compiler handles negative binary-test cases or low-rank A3 universality; a modular smooth-locus necessity theorem is proved; or a receiver forgetting the good line passes the inertia and fixed-space tests and supplies fixed-affine-space landing.

lessons.title: Use a common spatial bound instead of demanding h termination
lessons.when: A full formal quantization of a noninvertible polynomial symplectic map is available and the remaining issue is a finite Weyl realization.
lessons.use: Prove one finite spatial degree bound across all formal coefficients. The images then belong to a finite-PBW algebra over K[[t]], whose generic fiber is A_n(K((t))). Injective classical reduction preserves coefficient valuation, so generic surjectivity would force a classical polynomial inverse. Equivalently, seek horizontal membership of the classical point in a finite-degree full-relation scheme; ramified formal arcs suffice. The bounded-degree automorphism locus is closed using the field inverse-degree bound, and Artin approximation applies once there are finitely many spatial coefficients.
lessons.avoid: Requiring a terminating h series or evaluation specifically at h=1, inferring intrinsic unboundedness from a chosen formal representative, conflating the h=0 map with prescribed Frobenius center maps, or applying reduced-ring inverse bounds to nilpotent jet rings.
lessons.boundary: QFL2 is a conditional all-rank criterion, not a common bound for Long's map, a produced Weyl counterexample or a reduction of arbitrary DC2 to one classical seed. Exact controls verify the category distinctions; the generic-fiber and finite-type statements use written proofs.
lessons.reopen_when: An actual full lift admits a structural finite spatial carrier, or a gauge-invariant obstruction proves failure of every such carrier across all degrees.

Do not substitute the specialized action plinth or class annihilator. Retain the KG exclusion of standard embedded quotient classes,the KF actual one-value scheme gate,and independent E_N/endpoints. lessons.title: Separate the omitted-point unit-ideal Keller endpoint from singleton-zero properness
lessons.when: The actual four-variable pullback is a polynomial coordinate over its one free-base variable, or a base-only Meng--Yang graph avoids the origin and is changed by retained-dual automorphisms.
lessons.use: Use the universal minor ideal (x,y) to construct a polynomial relative coordinate frame. They close all r graphs under full (y,p,q) automorphisms fixing x and all hyperplane coordinate-triple pullbacks, including genuine old-r-dependent y graphs with unit-affine r boundary. HC4MYHC0/1/2/3 now retain the whole Hodge polynomial of one trace fibre. HC4MYHG0/1 now use full critical schemes, critical Hessian values and entire value fibres to survive every polynomial source automorphism. HC4MYHH0/1 now normalize arbitrary finite reduced coefficient fibres by local orientation and three determinant-one base shears. Every nonautomorphic finite-critical cotangent candidate is right-equivalent to the explicit degree n+1 inverse-derivative template. There is a genuine unit-Hessian example with exactly three affine retained projections, so this strengthens the graph theorem. HC4MYHO0/1/2 now separate complete endpoint branches in the two-affine geometry: a unit two-directional-partial ideal forces a unique vertical cotangent plane and an explicit relative coordinate; aligned nondegenerate kernel rank three is exactly the unit-ideal endpoint. All affine-hyperplane normal image types are classified under arbitrary source reparameterizations into the old singleton-zero/coordinate orbits or a forbidden critical-line case. New directions beyond those endpoints require nonlinear normal image hypersurfaces. No unaligned two-affine closure or singleton uniqueness from mere attainment is claimed. HC4MYHQ0/1 enlarge the output-base obstruction to linear-quadratic ambient observables through a global quadric filtration, without requiring ambient coordinate completion or fibre rectification. HC4MYHR0/1 now test relative critical sections and curve products and classify every base-only quadratic graph under unrestricted relative free-variable automorphisms, without alignment and with at most one full critical point under unit Hessian. HC4MYHS0/1/2 add a one-component proper-Morse closure and exact universal JC2 boundaries for the two separate conditions, with an explicit arbitrary-dimensional finite-free monomial-basis construction. HC4MYHT0/1 add uniform quadratic-plane rigidity and the entire fibre-affine two-affine embedding classification, with alignment forced and all base matrix degrees unrestricted. HC4MYHU0/1 now rectify isotropic-ideal image graphs explicitly and classify every compatible positive-weight invariant image into the singleton orbit or a degenerate critical-point obstruction, without assuming equivariance in actual source coordinates. HC4MYHV0/1 now test arbitrary-degree ambient output observables by a global filtered criterion and a smooth scheme-theoretic complete intersection at infinity, with the Picard input explicit. HC4MYHW0/1 replace factoriality by torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy and replace height-one graded domains by geometrically integral affine fibres; HC4MYHW2/3 close r=1 quadric pairs, specified degenerate ranks and all cyclic Danielewski powers. HC4MYHY0/1 now close normal finite monogenic root covers and every monic two-parameter Danielewski output by root transitivity; HC4MYHY2 imposes a global nonmonogenicity gate on every nontrivial finite Keller normalization. HC4MYHZ0/1/2 supply the finite leading-fibre gate and independent abelian-root gate for nonmonic outputs, with exact localized-unit defect. HC4MYIA0/1/2 upgrade the unconditional nonmonic gate to finite nilpotent root/class groups and arbitrary common-prime radical depth. HC4MYIB0/1/2 add arbitrary Galois-intermediate exclusion, the exact global normalization-boundary basis, and subnormal class-stabilizer closure beyond nilpotent actions. HC4MYIC0/1/2 add combined leading-order factor divisibility, rational-label critical-curve geometry and new unrestricted-parameter S3 cubic closures. HC4MYID0/1 refine critical units to factor-specific supports and all subset rank budgets, closing a new square-discriminant S3 family with arbitrary leading multiplicity. HC4MYID2 closes reduced singleton critical units with nonconstant separation, including the cubic two-simple-leading-level case. HC4MYID3 closes the fixed cubic by a polynomial second chart omitting a hyperbola and consequently the entire specified two-simple-level square-critical class. lessons.avoid: Claiming a unit-ideal Keller pair has been exhibited, substituting a constant dual Jacobian for an actual inverse, confusing (1) with the origin maximal ideal, importing plane surjectivity as a theorem, assuming an unrestricted JC2 equivalence, or transferring the fixed original marked collision onto x=1.
lessons.boundary: All earlier three-affine and ambient quadratic obstructions remain valid. Two directional partials generating the global unit ideal now force their unique plane to be the cotangent plane, give a globally affine free-variable form and an explicit relative coordinate inverse. The aligned rank-three quadratic kernel branch is exactly the unit-ideal plane endpoint. All affine-hyperplane normal images, under arbitrary source parameterizations, are exactly the singleton-zero orbit, the unit-ideal coordinate orbit, or the isotropic-through-center critical-line branch that forbids unit Hessian. Neither endpoint is resolved. Rank-one aligned fibre attainment is not singleton uniqueness; unaligned two-affine embeddings and nonlinear normal image hypersurfaces remain open with the unrestricted row equation. Polynomial quadratic-similitude saturation is now an additional global gate: if q composed with an ambient polynomial automorphism is a*q, undo it in the same source parameters before classifying retained projections or hyperplane images. The entire saturated three-affine class stays closed; the full-source hyperplane saturation retains exactly the old two endpoints or critical-line obstruction. Explicit unbounded words give zero affine pullbacks and nonlinear image equations while preserving a unit-Hessian quadratic source potential. Raw image nonlinearity is therefore insufficient. No universal rectification or generation of every quadratic symmetry is asserted. The output-base obstruction now includes a linear observable paired with any nondegenerate ambient quadratic, not only ambient coordinate pairs. In all stable dimensions r>=2, generic quadric factoriality and a height-one-compatible monomial filtration make the pencil and denominator arguments global, and smoothness forces the plane Keller base invertible. Thus an intrinsic nonautomorphic cotangent pair cannot have such an ambient extension, even after a certified ambient polynomial automorphism. Direct native A/B encodings of an independent Keller pair collapse to an invertible pair and a coordinate potential. Both plane endpoints and arbitrary other source-pair extensions remain open; no surface-quadric factoriality or embedding rectification is assumed. Relative critical schemes now give a separate global gate. A polynomial section over a constant two-variable base, or a base-compatible smooth curve times A1 with vertical Hessian rank one, forces gradient invertibility under unit Hessian. Consequently every base-only normal graph j=(s,t,h(s,t),H,G) under arbitrary relative free-variable polynomial automorphisms has at most one full critical point under unit Hessian, with no cotangent alignment. Its nonautomorphic members are exactly the two old endpoint source orbits. Native graph members with multiple full critical points have no relative unitization over that fixed base. Arbitrary four-variable source mixing and three genuinely free-dependent unretained coordinates remain open. One proper relative Morse component now suffices: no condition on other components is needed, and a globally proper everywhere-Morse relative projection can only have degree one. Each nonautomorphic component must therefore fail properness or contain vertical degeneracy. However each single condition separately retains exactly JC2. The universal f_M model has relative projection K and vertical Hessian -DK^T*DK, while the finite-free Fermat construction gives every K a proper relative projection with explicit monomial basis and ramification at zero. Its properness is not properness of K. Neither model automatically supplies a compatible closed ambient embedding. The two plane endpoints and unrestricted graph compatibility remain open. Uniform quadratic two-planes now have the same unique-plane rigidity under nonautomorphy as affine ones: any genuinely quadratic constant two-plane or two distinct quadratic planes closes the candidate. This classifies every fibre-affine two-affine embedding j=(s,t,b+A*w) in all base degrees. Global source generation requires a polynomial left inverse of A; generic rank is not enough. Alignment follows under nonautomorphy, a rank-three helper quadratic closes unconditionally, and lower ranks force a base-only helper and the two old endpoints. All unit-Hessian members have at most one full critical point. Arbitrary nonlinear free helpers and nonaligned potentials of free degree at least three remain open. Nonlinear isotropic-ideal image graphs now have explicit global quadratic isometries to hyperplanes, with arbitrary coefficients in unchanged variables and all source parameterizations. Compatible positive linear ambient weights give a constructive recognition gate: a smooth invariant image either has an isotropic tangent normal forbidding unit Hessian, or its lower-weight nonlinear terms admit a weighted Euler shear to the nonisotropic hyperplane. Only the singleton-zero endpoint survives for these positive images. Actual positive linear source weights would close gradient invertibility, but image invariance alone does not supply that hypothesis after nonlinear source changes. Other nonlinear images and both plane endpoints remain open. The output-base gate now admits arbitrary degrees for both ambient observables: a smooth scheme-theoretic codimension-two complete intersection of their highest forms at infinity forces any carried Keller pair invertible. The leading regular sequence supplies a common filtered basis and height-one graded domains, while the explicitly imported smooth complete-intersection Picard theorem supplies generic factoriality. Generic factoriality alone and smooth reduced support do not suffice; Pi=(x,xy+z^2) has an exact denominator failure. Arbitrary extensions need not have the required leading forms. Singular, nonreduced or excess-dimensional infinity intersections and both plane endpoints remain open. Generic factoriality is now relaxed by HC4MYHW0/1: torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy suffices, since Keller function fields contain no nontrivial abelian Galois intermediate field and all conjugate component classes then become zero. Geometric integrality of affine height-one fibres suffices for global primitive saturation even with nonconstant fibre units or reducible graded rings. The earlier r=1 exclusion for nondegenerate linear-quadratic output pairs is removed by HC4MYHW2, without calling the quadric surface factorial; degenerate restricted-rank-at-least-three quadratics close too. HC4MYHW3 closes cyclic Danielewski output pairs in every power m>=2, including nonreduced ordinary leading schemes and generic nonfactoriality outside every older smooth-infinity frame in the HC4-size first type. Nonabelian class actions, torsion, nonintegral height-one fibres, uncovered ranks and infinity schemes and both plane endpoints remain open. The nonabelian boundary is now narrower: HC4MYHX0/1 prove that a nowhere-critical polynomial parameter is relatively algebraically closed in the source field, using an explicit classical closed-polynomial import. A class action descending from a finite cover of that one parameter retains its full possibly nonabelian group under Keller base change, so the component classes become principal. This does not make all special parameter fibres irreducible or the whole Keller extension trivial. HC4MYHX2 closes every constant-coefficient nonconstant Danielewski P(z), with arbitrary root group, and every suspended T*Y+xy-B(T,z) with arbitrary two-variable B and all degrees. The earlier nonabelian-P(z) and suspended-coefficient escape proposals are retired. Genuinely two-parameter unsuspended monodromy, torsion, nonintegral height-one fibres, other missing filtrations and both plane endpoints remain open. HC4MYHY0 now preserves irreducibility of every normal finite monogenic cover under Keller base change, in every dimension and degree. All conjugate constant cross-resultants and integral roots rule out inertia crossing; explicit purity and finite-cover comparison inputs make the quotient trivial. HC4MYHY1 closes every two-parameter P(T,z) with nonzero constant leading z coefficient: root transitivity, without full splitting-group preservation, makes the invariant root-divisor classes zero. HC4MYHY2 forbids a globally monogenic finite normalization for any nontrivial Keller intermediate field; a nonautomorphic plane normalization needs at least two additional global algebra generators. Generic primitive elements do not provide normal monogenic models. Nonconstant leading coefficients, nonnormal monic presentations, nonglobally-monogenic normal finite algebras, other embeddings and both plane endpoints remain open. HC4MYHZ0 computes the exact torsion-free localized-unit defect as the sum of the reduced full-fibre component lattices at the zeros of a(T). HC4MYHZ1 preserves normal monogenic root-cover irreducibility on that vertical open when just those finitely many full K1-fibres are irreducible. The remaining finite etale generic-affine-line quotient is a finite Galois parameter extension, eliminated using HC4MYHX0; the explicitly imported Riemann-Hurwitz formula proves the constant-field descent. HC4MYHZ2 consequently closes every nonmonic P(T,z) under that finite-fibre gate. Independently, abelian generic root monodromy closes all such P without the fibre hypothesis, including every z degree one or two and arbitrary translated powers a(T)*(z-b(T))^m+c(T). A remaining nonautomorphic realization in this family needs both nonabelian generic root monodromy and positive localized-unit defect at a leading-coefficient zero. Generic parameter regularity does not supply the finite-fibre hypothesis, and etale affine curve maps are not automatically finite. The audited Tian-Sun 2024 claims are excluded as proof inputs. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIA0 upgrades the cyclic obstruction to full preservation of every finite nilpotent Galois target group under Keller base change in every dimension: a proper source image lies below a normal cyclic prime quotient, which would give a forbidden intermediate field. HC4MYIA1 therefore permits finite nilpotent class monodromy in the filtered output criterion. HC4MYIA2 closes every nonmonic xy-P(T,z) with nilpotent generic root group without a special-fibre assumption, including arbitrary-depth common-prime radical compositions and every composition of arbitrary quadratics. The explicit nonmonic quartic T*(z^2-T)^2 has nonabelian D8 group and is newly closed even without K1=0 irreducible. The remaining branch in this full family needs both nonnilpotent generic root monodromy and positive localized-unit defect at a leading zero. Arbitrary solvable groups do not follow: an S3 order-two subgroup escapes all normal prime-index containers. General wreath embeddings are primary context, not an additional proof import; the restricted common-prime construction is proved directly. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIB0 now excludes every finite Galois intermediate target-field extension inside a complex Keller field, in every dimension and without a group restriction: a visible index-one place reaches all primes by Galois conjugacy, then explicit purity and finite-cover inputs force triviality. This does not assert arbitrary full splitting-group preservation. HC4MYIB1 identifies the finite plane normalization class group exactly as the free group on the omitted boundary divisors; a torsion or globally factorial normalization forces the inverse. Local factoriality alone is insufficient. HC4MYIB2 closes the filtered output criterion when divisor-class stabilizers are subnormal in an arbitrary finite class-action image; normal class stabilizers suffice even for nonnilpotent groups. The Hurwitz lattice gives an explicit nonnilpotent class-module certificate, without an asserted ambient realization. The S3 root-lattice order-two stabilizer is not subnormal and remains a genuine boundary. Within nonmonic xy-P(T,z), positive localized-unit defect and nonnilpotent monodromy remain necessary unless another retained gate closes the case. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIC0 now constrains every source root-factor degree by m/gcd(m,q_1,...,q_k) when leading-drop coefficient orders lie above the single-slope chords; coprime combined orders give irreducibility and close the carried output in arbitrary z degree without a special-fibre or monodromy hypothesis. HC4MYIC1 clears a rational root to a polynomial label with an exact vertical-Jacobian identity. The constructed polynomial map omits its normalized critical curve, so the explicit qualitative Jelonek-Lason nonproperness input forces each critical component to have affine normalization A1. Independently a square-free leading coefficient dividing the next coefficient excludes rational roots. HC4MYIC2 consequently closes nonmonic cubics if a is square-free and divides b, or if the critical discriminant D=b^2-3ac has square-free part of degree at least two. This includes new S3 families with unbounded T degree and no special-fibre hypothesis. The remaining cubic branch requires a rational label, positive localized-unit defect, S3 group, D of square-free degree at most one, and failure of the independent no-pole gate; D=0 was already cyclic and closed. Critical and root discriminants are distinct, and no-rational-root is not irreducibility in arbitrary higher degree. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIC1 also gives a quantitative critical-branch unit budget: if the normalized derivative Q_U has ell distinct rational roots over C(T), monicity puts them in C[T], and the corresponding polynomial labels u-beta_i(f) are localized source units with linearly independent classes modulo C(f)^*. lessons.title: Use arithmetic center compatibility to exclude complete cotangent and shear word classes
lessons.when: A classical symplectic map has a proved or explicitly assumed arithmetic nonlifting theorem and a proposed construction uses Keller cotangent lifts or elementary canonical changes.
lessons.use: Prove the Frobenius center formula for each generator and retain it under composition. Inverse-Jacobian Keller derivations have zero restricted p-th iterate, so their crystalline p-th powers have exactly the cotangent center symbols. Gradient shears are exact by the p-power formula; odd-characteristic linear canonical changes are compatible. A finite word has one common arithmetic model, independent of its degree or length.
lessons.avoid: Searching longer cotangent/shear words for Long after assuming the nonlifting theorem, or treating that exclusion as an obstruction to every bounded formal lift with the same h=0 reduction.
lessons.boundary: QFL3 is conditional on the October2026 preprint's arithmetic nonlifting theorem. It excludes the specified arithmetic-compatible class only; general polynomial symplectic coordinate changes and bounded formal lifts without prescribed arithmetic support are not included.
lessons.reopen_when: The external theorem changes, or a proposed construction demonstrably changes the required arithmetic center map or lies outside the stated generator class.

For a=c=f=0 use g=0 directly and shift the moving T pole; do not invert g. Keep regular-end detours, degenerate saddles and both Laurent ends in the logarithmic growth bound. Use the seed-submodule horizontal functional and precise Hien--Roucairol comparison. For cubics the sufficient prefixes are888 generally and447 in the f=0 WZT face. lessons.title: Keep polynomial quotient coefficients as quadratic unknowns and distinguish residue units from exact certificates
lessons.when: An exact elimination has reduced parameter count but raised coefficient degrees, while the original identities are bilinear with constant leading coefficients.
lessons.use: Introduce quotient and remainder coefficients as independent unknowns. Prove triangular recovery using fixed nonzero field scalars and match the surviving equations to primary saved inputs. Keep the nonzero condition explicitly. lessons.title: Require algebraic dual nonvanishing and an actual scalar polarization
lessons.when: A bounded formal lift or coherent graph model is being used to claim finite left realization or apply a scalar differential-order obstruction.
lessons.use: For an algebraically torsion-free rank-one module over a noetherian Ore domain, prove Hom_A(M,A) nonzero; this is equivalent to left finite generation. Track algebraic versus completed duals and the boundary inverse-limit class. For scalar reduction, prove existence of a finite algebraic normal form with actual local nilpotence and the required order profile. Use QPG1 central patching after proving generic finite projectivity and an admitted C-frame; if the generic module is rank-one free, its integral frame follows automatically. For generic rank-one full actions, QVA1 now supplies C-admission from Gauss-regularity and the intended shadow; it need not be assumed separately.
lessons.avoid: Inferring local nilpotence from nilpotence in every parameter jet, inferring raw order preservation from boundedness, replacing an algebraic dual section by a formal one, or applying finite-generation claims without checking rank one and torsion-freeness.
lessons.boundary: QEF1's degree-one canonical shear has topologically nilpotent but not locally nilpotent graph constraint, and QGM1 has zero algebraic dual with nonzero completed dual. These chosen models or representatives have better normalizations, so no intrinsic nonliftability follows. A free left frame remains an extra condition. The bad boundary model is simple and holonomic generically, so standard graph-module simplicity does not repair algebraic dual nonvanishing. QIR1 makes a finite full rank-one graph carrier projective over K[[t]] itself. This does not make it free. A fixed rational full action has a unique generic full finite lattice; a rational frame makes its right matrices polynomial exactly when that lattice is free. A formal dual or formal comparison does not supply the required rational frame. QPG1 replaces a separate integral lattice construction by central patching if the generic module is finite projective and its full action has an admitted rank-one frame over C=Ahat[1/t]. Generic rank-one freeness then implies integral freeness. Formal dual nonvanishing or a division-ring intertwiner alone still does not supply those inputs. QVA1 moves the substantive existence test to a finite generic rank-one invariant carrier with the intended Gauss shadow. Its full regular action automatically produces a formal C-frame, then QPG1 patches integrally. Rational pairs p+a*r(x),x show finite generic generation remains nonautomatic: admission requires r=Hprime+fprime/f, with polynomial H and rational f.
lessons.reopen_when: A nonzero dual section actually descends with effective boundary control, or a proved algebraic normalization realizes the scalar hypotheses for every relevant gauge class.

lessons.title: Remove redundant carrier directions before further cubic degree reduction
lessons.when: A stable cubic reduction introduces many auxiliary carrier variables.
lessons.use: Compute how top coordinates and all retained carrier outputs depend on carrier directions. Retain independent combinations, apply the same linear change to the corresponding targets, and check whether complementary outputs become identity coordinates plus polynomials of retained inputs. If so, source shears remove those directions exactly without raising retained degree. Verify the complete symbolic determinant using an explicitly checked nilpotent carrier-block inverse, and transport full collision points.
lessons.avoid: Calling every coordinate-graph slice cubic; conflating ordinary degree with generic fibre degree; comparing term counts across different collision normalizations; claiming a beam search or failed family of target corrections proves minimum dimension.
lessons.boundary: The exact17/58 and13/42 constructions remain verified, but BCR2 and BCRDB1 already supplied12-variable cubic maps. BCRDB1's count40 dominates both experiments; KCUB3 improves that established map to an integral36-term form. These older construction routes are historical method evidence, not current size improvements. All bounded beam, slice and rational-line limits remain local rather than optimality proofs. KCUB29 now closes all raw linear carrier-relation subspace graphs of the savedK in the standard highest-pivot parametrization, including simultaneous and cross-weight relations:13 raw occurrences are sharp in the whole class and fixed-dimension degree minima match the literal subsets. Minimal4/5/7-dimensional degree6/5/4 families have sharp15/17/23 terms. General nonlinear graph parametrizations, later target repairs and affine output sparsification remain outside this result.
lessons.reopen_when: A further construction uses fewer than12 variables, improves the36-term target under comparable cubic/tangent normalization, or supplies a genuinely additional property absent from BCRDB1/KCUB3.

lessons.avoid: Inferring an affine-space source from a coarse quotient or a fieldwise trivialization; testing only tangent modules; asserting that the rank-N marked fibre determines degree-M monodromy; or retaining an unproved open landing gate for the constructed trace bundle model. Do not search larger polynomial degrees in these closed rank-one cubic-return or retained-output coupling classes, or confuse a cyclic dependence graph with the removal of an intermediate field. Do not replace a non-descended Schur matrix by an ordinary time Jacobian without proving descent, or confuse generic covering degree with total coordinate degree. Do not deepen root-only polynomial profile degrees while retaining every first signal, equate ordinary nilpotence with vanishing of all principal minors, or read apparent coefficient-list cycles before effective cancellation. Do not freeze the scalar response at coefficient zero, infer polynomial integration from every finite Keller jet or a full formal series, or treat a rational source-open formula as an entire affine map. Do not add more native indices as independent control channels, infer map-degree bounds from the normal-form indices, treat finite/formal source-coordinate existence as a polynomial family, or confuse sigma composed F with a retained first output. Do not treat nonlinear-r B output or arbitrarily high marked contact as a new stable class: explicit whole polynomial target shears already have both. Do not infer atomicity from a nonzero cubic descent remainder, or replace native polynomial-module membership by the source jets alone. Do not reopen the conditional native degree-greater-than-one after-profile branch: it is now empty. Do not deepen searches for polynomial plane decompositions of the completed native map, apply the Keller line theorem directly to its nonconstant Jacobian, or infer stable full-map atomicity from plane indecomposability. Do not reopen the former intermediate boundary-pole route: it is now closed in the entire signal-retaining class. Do not identify a generic intermediate fibre with A2 without proof, assume abstractly isomorphic source surfaces imply trivial factor degrees, or treat a generic etale formula as a whole polynomial factor. Do not reopen the nonconstant-unit intermediate branch or allow a proper finite-index unit lattice in a whole Keller factor. Do not substitute a generic J_d surface cover for whole power descent, remove the retained node, infer geometric factoriality from arithmetic localization, or claim that a unit-free surface has been excluded. Do not reopen nonnegative-log surfaces, geometrically factorial proper native factors or invariant geometric divisor classes. Do not import the finite torus-domination classification into our nonfinite maps, use the obsolete two-surface log-zero list, or turn an exact primitive into an etale plane pair. Higher-power primitive formulas and lattice models do not construct either arrow. Do not identify the raw singular retained-base spread with an actual whole Keller intermediate. Do not turn standard formal curve neighborhoods into a global plane chart, glue plane automorphisms into a non-plane etale target, or call the classical chart-to-JC(2) reduction new. Do not substitute local contacts for the whole closed embedded curve, or search increasing degrees inside the excluded beta-integral family or low/divisibly reducible ruling sector. Do not replace geometric ruling existence after finite extension by descent to K0, transfer arithmetic UFD across that extension, or accept multiple geometric components with multiplicity>1 in a descended ruling. Do not fill a nonfinite surface completion with finitely many points, infer positive Euler integral from nonnegative sheet loss, or apply product-leaf topology to a changed-signal receiver without proving its actual generic fibre. Do not reopen excluded orbifold patterns or the odd-degree two-double sector. Do not treat a unique or Galois-invariant ruling as an unresolved non-descent escape. Do not leave affine-type Galois permutation as an open escape. Do not infer uniqueness from two arbitrary COMPLETE-type rulings, or average different ruling coordinates without checking the generic fibre: the exact trace control is Gm.
lessons.boundary: Dimension3N+3, generic degree3^(N+1), coordinate degree4N and volume dimension3N+4 are existence bounds, not minima. V_A can be nontrivial over a scheme. Non-atomicity is proved, while atomic canonical realization remains open. An invariant natural frame is obstructed by faithful split inertia; existential bundle freeness on prescribed bases is separate. The published fixed-scheme all-family no-go still applies. These classifications use characteristic-zero polynomial retained-signal profiles and the named compiler. Any number of controls with rank-one cubic return is closed; non-descended higher-rank return and other compilers are separate. For another auxiliary block rank-one output recovery is equivalent to geometric generic-line connectedness; no general closedness conjecture is silently assumed. Arithmetic atomicity of connected input algebras is not absolute atomicity. Common kernels are proved for all constant ranks; the full selector classification is only one-directional. Higher-rank membership in C[Z,t] is an explicit hypothesis, not a determinant consequence. The full C is not assumed finitely generated or polynomial. Marked divisor identities hold universally; effective degree and absolute atomicity use the stated characteristic-zero field hypotheses. Fixed-signal rank-two source leaves need not be affine planes. A slice does not imply local nilpotence, and stable polynomiality is not an atomicity converse. The root-feedback theorem requires characteristic-zero fields, unchanged first signals and corrections in k[u,sigma,X]. Independent r_i diagonal variables force every principal minor to vanish. Frobenius dependencies and nilpotent coefficient cycles show why positive characteristic and nonreduced bases are excluded. Transitive product-fibre conclusions require transitivity on ALL nonidentity blocks; the trace filter has an extra auxiliary orbit and changes its first signal. Scalar self-feedback rigidity is a one-block affine coefficient-line theorem with a nonzero effective direction in characteristic zero. It permits all own-source channels and rational controls with whole polynomial landing, but says only that EFFECTIVE profiles are retained-signal polynomials; common direction factors may cancel a rational signal control. Curved coefficient families and mutually changing blocks remain outside. Finite-order parameter bases are nonreduced; the formal ring k[P][[lambda]] permits unbounded source degrees and differs from k[[lambda]][P]. The two-control module identity is universal over bases with2 invertible and preserves arbitrary source dependence. Affine-r rigidity and the stable signal-field normalizer use characteristic-zero fields. Affine-r rigidity is a one-block theorem with actual identity parameters and native source jets, not a theorem about mutually changing blocks. Formal-etale source gauges are classical and work over arbitrary nilpotent base ideals; their compatible formal limit can have unbounded source degree. The source-field normalizer leaves a vertical JC(m) problem and does not classify merely retained-output maps or arbitrary coordinate changes moving that field. Formal marked source equivalence permits actual polynomial families with arbitrary generic-degree jumps; it is not a global degree or stable-class invariant. Native orbit rigidity requires characteristic zero, one retained block, polynomial module membership and coordinate operations fixing identity parameters. Its stable equivalence is restricted to source maps normalizing k(u,sigma); unrestricted source changes are outside. A polynomial-r reduction survivor has non-dividing degrees >=2; negative Laurent sectors and genuine cross-block interaction remain open. The fixed dimension-three descent certificate excludes only the old cubic factor when its remainder is nonzero. Quasi-finite saturation is a classical elementary divisor consequence, not a novelty claim. The profile-factor theorem is one block with retained identities and a literal profile first factor; arbitrary source changes remain outside. Plane completion is generic in the signal and covers only nonnegative r powers. Plane indecomposability requires an irreducible Jacobian and an embedded line; its extension to all fields requires GEOMETRIC irreducibility. It does not imply stable whole-map atomicity. A nontrivial signal-retaining factor must have a genuine intermediate boundary pole. Whole-source special-signal landing and signal-moving factors remain open. The saturation overlap has explicit prior public attribution to Trushin Proposition3.1.1. The relative cancellation theorem leaves exactly TWO generic coordinates and requires a whole embedded A1 image; three-dimensional Keller counterexamples show that one curve alone does not invert a higher-dimensional target. It uses only the curve restriction, allowing poles elsewhere. Arbitrary identity stabilization and intermediate mixing are covered by the NON-PLANE generic intermediate-fibre obstruction. This is still a necessary all-factor condition, not full absolute stable atomicity. Intermediate surfaces satisfy BOTH saturation identities, geometrically have unit rank at most1 and their etale arrows miss at most finitely many points. Their abstract shape, smoothness and tangent triviality do not construct a proper factor. Primitive-unit surface rigidity requires characteristic zero, an AFFINE smooth target, cofinite etale image and the actual node. Its whole-factor unit theorem covers arbitrary last outputs with the fixed retained signal, without native jets or Laurent-degree bounds. Proper intermediates have CONSTANT geometric units; the earlier unit-rank-at-most-one route is now CLOSED on the nonconstant side. Whole constant-level irreducibility is not a statement about all further fibres after fixing E_u. Arithmetic UFD over k(u,a) does not prove geometric factoriality. The native NON-PLANE conclusion still requires the UARELPLANE1 embedded-curve witness. The one-way unit drop bounds no later unit-free chain length. CURRENT: a PROPER native intermediate is GEOMETRICALLY UNIT-FREE, has log kappa=-infinity, and has NONZERO geometric Picard group with ZERO retained-field Galois invariants, despite arithmetic UFD. The Picard factor criterion uses the native curve witness and explicitly imported Miyanishi negative-log affine-plane criterion. The log dichotomy and invariant-class vanishing cover every actual whole retained-signal Keller map. Higher-power Danielewski surfaces m>=2 pass exact volume; u has no Keller mate for all m>=1. Required arrows, free tangent frame, global polynomial lift and canonical marks/gluing remain unconstructed. The raw spread a=z^d-u^m*v is excluded globally by its critical zero fibre; only another smooth whole model could realize the same generic surface. CURRENT CHART GATE: the WHOLE carried A1 crosses the boundary of EVERY plane chart in a proper native factor, despite all finite/formal neighborhoods being standard. Any non-plane etale target containing an open A2 yields JC(2) counterexamples on all charts; this remains CONDITIONAL and has Dubouloz2009 precedent. Higher-power Danielewski targets need compatible nonautomorphic pairs surviving at nondividing ruling degrees>=2 and a carried closed embedding meeting two root components with deg Z>=m*N-r+1. Sharp beta-integral contact maps fail geometric injectivity for EVERY m>=2; other multi-root embedded curves remain open. These deductions retain the actual native/witness two-dimensional fibre and entire-curve hypotheses. CURRENT RULING/TOPOLOGY GATE: a retained-field ruling has base A1, integral arithmetic fibres and reduced geometric fibres, hence a finite geometric A2 atlas and a JC(2) burden for proper native targets. Geometric ruling existence does NOT prove descent. The whole carried curve hits two components of some split fibre. On an ACTUAL U^N times A^h leaf both proper arrows are NONFINITE and intermediate pi1 has an abelian subgroup with index DIVIDING source degree. This is virtually cyclic for one block. Multiple fibres of any surjective connected-generic geometric map to A1 are limited to one or two doubles; the two-double case requires EVEN source degree. No silent product hypothesis for the trace receiver or Euler-integral positivity is permitted. Published Galois-invariant/unique-ruling descent already closes that special descent uncertainty: a proper native factor with such a ruling would disprove JC(2). Conditional on JC(2), every geometric ruling must have a NONTRIVIAL Galois orbit of inequivalent rulings. CURRENT DESCENT RESULT: every geometric affine-type ruling of a proper native intermediate is unique and actually descends; its additive action descends too. Conditional on JC(2), only ADDITIVELY RIGID intermediates with COMPLETE-type Galois-permuted P1 rulings remain. Their descent is OPEN. A zero Picard orbit norm does not identify the individual fibrations.
lessons.reopen_when: A candidate improves these explicit bounds or proves atomicity with whole-source polynomial landing, complete marked fibre and compatible descent; a different receiver must state which stronger trivialization or symmetry data it provides. An actual candidate leaves the rank-one cubic architecture, for example through non-descended higher-rank return geometry, another compiler or a non-locally-nilpotent auxiliary with constants outside the stable-polynomial criterion, satisfies its whole-source determinant identity, retains the exact complete fibre and gluing, and proves absolute atomicity. In one constant direction, an auxiliary-only canonical escape must be all-inactive and demonstrate a full constant ring outside the stable-polynomial criterion, retaining exact marked fibre and descent. For root feedback, an atomic candidate must leave the all-signal-retaining polynomial root subring class, for example using additional source channels or a changed first output, and still prove the complete marked fibre and atomicity. A proved broader curved/multi-direction or genuine cross-block construction removes the explicit formal scalar denominator on the WHOLE source, retains complete marks and gluing, and proves full-map absolute atomicity. Scalar-line degree sweeps are closed. A two-effective-control native family leaves the scalar-line and affine-r sectors through nonlinear Laurent-r dependence, or another first-output/compiler/cross-block architecture, and proves whole-source polynomial landing, exact canonical marks, gluing and full-map atomicity. A native candidate has Cout genuinely nonlinear, escapes generic profile-coordinate reduction at a non-dividing polynomial-r degree pair or in a negative Laurent sector, and proves the full marked scheme, effective gluing and absence of ALL actual polynomial factors; another compiler or changed first-output architecture remains permitted. A whole-source native construction has genuinely nonlinear Cout and exact canonical marks/gluing; any claimed factor must escape literal profile recovery and, in the polynomial-r sector, polynomial intermediate extension. A genuinely non-plane generic intermediate surface with the exact saturated field model and whole-source realization, a new curve-witness failure or another compiler must be analyzed without assuming JC(2). A proper factor realizes a NON-PLANE geometric generic retained fibre, both field degrees exceed one, and all curve, unit, saturation, divisor and whole-polynomial requirements are certified; or an actual native integration preserves complete canonical marks/gluing and excludes every such factor. A proper generic surface is geometrically unit-free with the exact arithmetic factorial ring, saturated embedded field, whole carried curve and an all-irreducible-constant-fibre intermediate signal; both whole degrees exceed one and the entire map/global marked gluing is certified. Nonconstant-unit and finite-index unit candidates are closed. Produce an actual negative-log unit-free geometrically nonfactorial intermediate with nonzero Picard group and no invariant class, the exact canonical volume and both etale arrows. The u^m*v=z^d-a families with m>=2 are explicit necessary-condition models, not permission for a bounded coefficient sweep or proof of a whole factor. Supply an actual compatible nonautomorphic Keller atlas and a WHOLE multi-root embedded line satisfying all contacts, both cofinite arrows and a different smooth whole spread, or move to a proved intermediate geometry without such a plane chart. Finite/formal neighborhoods and exact primitives alone are insufficient; JC(2) and canonical atomicity are not declared solved. Prove a compatible JC(2)-counterexample atlas in the descended-ruling class, or prove an actual failure of ruling descent retaining all field, curve, volume and whole-source constraints. Respect the nonfinite source-divisor and sheet-loss budget, the dividing-index group constraint and the orbifold multiplicity/parity gates. Full canonical marks, gluing and absolute stable atomicity remain necessary. Prove descent or exclude actual realization of the remaining COMPLETE-type Galois orbit. The affine-type descent subproblem is closed; extend by a new identification argument, not more necessary conditions.

lessons.title: Use actual affine critical components and generic-fibre Euler to close nonlinear graph classes
lessons.when: A relative critical scheme contains a closed A1 component, possibly even when every computed critical determinant is the same nonzero constant.
lessons.use: Under hypothetical nonautomorphy project Tang planes to the single free base. Rank zero has only vertical critical components and generic coordinate fibres of Euler one. Rank one identifies its entire critical scheme with a plane Keller coordinate fibre, where an actual A1 component is rectified and line injectivity gives an inverse. For y=R(x,p) count the two explicit Euler strata to obtain1+r>=2. For opposite affine-p graphs use the boundary line and the separately dominating critical curve. Reducibility then forbids unit Hessian. HC4MYGS0/1/2/3 add the preserved whole critical target-line map, an all-degree pole classification and the Chau/Orevkov plane-degree obstruction, excluding every nonzero-a opposite affine-p graph and reducing the full family to its base-only unit-ideal endpoint. HC4MYGN0/1/2/3 add empty-critical-scheme/Euler, initial Newton-face and finite smooth ramification gates, closing every separated y=a(x)*P(p)+b(x) in all degrees without Tang. HC4MYGM0/1/2/3 remove the whole finite polar and singular locus, require a full polynomial Bezout certificate and complete critical curve, impose an exact reciprocal conductor budget on escapes, and state the necessary entire abstract Keller-fibre realization. HC4MYGW0/1/2/3 add a genus-free whole-curve Euler/pole budget, algebraic differential descent, all quadratic p closure and a whole unbounded-degree family excluded despite passing local critical gates. HC4MYGY0/1/2/3 compare every Euler jump and one entire reciprocal-root product, closing the full positive-p y chart and leaving exactly its base-only nonautomorphic unit-ideal endpoint. HC4MYGX0/1/2/3 extend the global method to opposite nonlinear graphs, closing all simple-boundary and no-escape configurations and forcing at least six distinct critical roots in any remaining nonautomorphic mechanism. HC4MYGZ0/1/2/3 now compare the exceptional base-zero fibre and close both entire positive-p base charts, including every opposite escape; both whole p-only families retain only the base-only unit-ideal nonautomorphic endpoint. HC4MYHA0/1/2/3 extend the closure to every y=R(x,p,q) independent of old r: a general cylindrical-trace criterion combines with the all-degree plane polynomial G=P*(F^2-1)+Q*F and its square suspension, without a generic irreducibility or critical-projection assumption. HC4MYHB0/1/2/3 now use an isolated trace point and its Milnor intersection length to remove the generic-base Euler hypothesis for power-saddle traces. They close all r graphs under full (y,p,q) automorphisms fixing x and all hyperplane coordinate-triple pullbacks, including genuine old-r-dependent y graphs with unit-affine r boundary. HC4MYHC0/1/2/3 now retain the whole Hodge polynomial of one trace fibre. The positive t coefficient excludes rank zero, and genus/puncture coefficients force actual A1 Keller-fibre components in rank one. This closes arbitrary univariate-plus-saddle traces, nonlinear polynomial-coordinate r boundaries and branched trace triples, without isolated-point or generic-base data. HC4MYHD0/1/2/3 now count the whole value fibre by affine-dual row ranks, closing every one-affine-dual-direction y graph and every non-r opposite direction in arbitrary graph/coefficient degree. The pure-r opposite exception has no positive Hodge coefficient; its complete critical Hessian reduces remaining nonautomorphy to the two existing plane endpoints, without asserting a converse realization. HC4MYHE0/1/2 now compare two parallel whole trace Hodge profiles: one pure trace forces rank zero under nonautomorphy, whereas H(U)+V*a(U,W) of positive W degree and deg H>=2 cannot have a nonpositive pure signature. This closes arbitrary q-independent r boundaries with one constant nonzero-base slice. HC4MYHE3 also closes unibranch one-place boundary curves, including singular cusp powers, without that second slice. HC4MYHF0/1 now replace orientation-specific trial with the intrinsic plane: two distinct jointly affine planes force an inverse by an elementary proof, while the covectors admitting one pure trace form exactly the unique-plane annihilator under nonautomorphy. Three independent pure directions close every degree with no sign condition; two determine three concrete directional Hessian identities and otherwise retain the exact JC2 endpoint. HC4MYHF2 makes complete profiles count and reconstruct the reduced quotient fibre, preserving the two distinct unresolved ideals. HC4MYHG0/1 now use full critical schemes, critical Hessian values and entire value fibres to survive every polynomial source automorphism. Zero-boundary base graphs and split one-variable degrees at least three cannot acquire unit Hessian after any full source mixing. HC4MYHG2 identifies all full-source base-only graph orbits and the fixed degree-six p graph with the existing coordinate/unit-ideal and quadratic/singleton-zero endpoints. No new graph-degree or source-word search is warranted inside those full orbits, and neither endpoint is solved. HC4MYHH0/1 now normalize arbitrary finite reduced coefficient fibres by local orientation and three determinant-one base shears. Every nonautomorphic finite-critical cotangent candidate is right-equivalent to the explicit degree n+1 inverse-derivative template. HC4MYHH2 identifies full-source unitization for n>=2 with one relative SL2 row equation, without solving it or producing a graph embedding. All reference templates already meet the fixed-function critical/Hodge necessary conditions, so future work needs a global row/properness or embedding restriction rather than another such invariant or native-degree sweep. HC4MYHI0/1 now apply the classical global single-generator Keller criterion: one common extra reconstruction polynomial forces an inverse, while hypothetical nonautomorphic HC4 requires exactly two relative generators. HC4MYHI2 closes every embedded realization of the exact universal A=F, B=xF+yG encoding, regardless of the remaining dual function. HC4MYHI3 closes all target-dependent affine-dual output-base embeddings, including rank drops away from the image. These are genuine all-degree embedding obstructions, not a solution of the unrestricted row equation or a statement that every graph has the required global reconstruction. HC4MYHJ0/1 remove every restriction on the dual map over a fixed plane Keller output base. Disjoint constant-unit conjugate hypersurfaces form one polynomial pencil; primitive nonconstant coefficient content removes the target denominators, and smoothness makes the relation derivative a scalar unit and forces generic degree one. Thus (K(z),H(z,w)) cannot be a closed hypersurface embedding for nonautomorphic K, for arbitrary source-dependent nonlinear H. Changing only matrix descent, dual degree or embedded fibre shape is no longer a remaining direction. The exact stable additional-generator minimum is r+2, and the intrinsic cotangent pair cannot extend to ambient coordinates in A5. Arbitrary graph embeddings need not have that physical-base interpretation. HC4MYHK0/1 now make the mixed-projection boundary exact: for k linear outputs, ell their intersection dimension with the cotangent pair, the additional-generator minimum is N-k+ell under nonautomorphy. The pure-one-component lower bound uses the classical plane stable-coordinate implication; the full-pair lower bound is HC4MYHJ1. All other A5 completions are explicit source-recovery constructions, so embedding existence alone cannot close them. Keep the fixed potential identity and marked covector transfer separate. Noncoordinate directional derivatives also identify exactly the unique cotangent plane. HC4MYHL0/1 now use the fixed-potential common-zero-base trace to close every rank-one mixed gradient realization, while preserving the correct abstract embedding classification. The free eta coefficient is (-Q_s*P+P_s*Q)/J, and nonlinear composite degree makes P divide P_s, forcing a triangular pair. Only the full-eta-rank centered gradient-base stratum survives. HC4MYHL2 adds the exact distinguished-critical-value transfer and a global necessary Euler square equation, neither of which is a properness proof or a completed embedding. HC4MYHM0/1/2 now straighten the entire ambient function to lambda_star+L*T^2+N*y*Z+2*N*x*W with an explicit polynomial inverse. Every literal graph in every constant affine direction is closed under unit Hessian by the quadratic-plus-one-square or ternary quadratic trace criterion. Check four affine-linear retained normal projections before further degree work. Preserve the actual source parameterization: full source orbits of two fixed normal graphs already contain exactly the two unresolved plane endpoints. The transverse square equation alone is not universally obstructive because constant noncritical D always passes it. HC4MYHN0/1 now lower the ambient affine projection gate from four to three, including all degenerate quadratic kernels and fully nonlinear remaining coordinates. Restricted source planes expose one-extra-generator Keller recovery, while the other cases give a triangular component or affine-line fibre. There is a genuine unit-Hessian example with exactly three affine retained projections, so this strengthens the graph theorem. Two-affine normal embeddings already realize both distinct conditional endpoints with actual polynomial inverses, and no full two-affine closure or JC2 equivalence is claimed. HC4MYHO0/1/2 now separate complete endpoint branches in the two-affine geometry: a unit two-directional-partial ideal forces a unique vertical cotangent plane and an explicit relative coordinate; aligned nondegenerate kernel rank three is exactly the unit-ideal endpoint. All affine-hyperplane normal image types are classified under arbitrary source reparameterizations into the old singleton-zero/coordinate orbits or a forbidden critical-line case. New directions beyond those endpoints require nonlinear normal image hypersurfaces. No unaligned two-affine closure or singleton uniqueness from mere attainment is claimed. HC4MYHP0/1 now require checking the whole polynomial quadratic-similitude saturation, since explicit genuine nonlinear images can have zero affine pullbacks while their unchanged source potential is a closed quadratic. HC4MYHQ0/1 enlarge the output-base obstruction to linear-quadratic ambient observables through a global quadric filtration, without requiring ambient coordinate completion or fibre rectification. HC4MYHR0/1 now test relative critical sections and curve products and classify every base-only quadratic graph under unrestricted relative free-variable automorphisms, without alignment and with at most one full critical point under unit Hessian. HC4MYHS0/1/2 add a one-component proper-Morse closure and exact universal JC2 boundaries for the two separate conditions, with an explicit arbitrary-dimensional finite-free monomial-basis construction. HC4MYHT0/1 add uniform quadratic-plane rigidity and the entire fibre-affine two-affine embedding classification, with alignment forced and all base matrix degrees unrestricted. HC4MYHU0/1 now rectify isotropic-ideal image graphs explicitly and classify every compatible positive-weight invariant image into the singleton orbit or a degenerate critical-point obstruction, without assuming equivariance in actual source coordinates. HC4MYHV0/1 now test arbitrary-degree ambient output observables by a global filtered criterion and a smooth scheme-theoretic complete intersection at infinity, with the Picard input explicit. HC4MYHW0/1 replace factoriality by torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy and replace height-one graded domains by geometrically integral affine fibres; HC4MYHW2/3 close r=1 quadric pairs, specified degenerate ranks and all cyclic Danielewski powers. HC4MYHX0/1 preserve arbitrary finite monodromy descending from a regular polynomial parameter; HC4MYHX2 closes all constant-coefficient Danielewski P(z) and every T*Y+xy-B(T,z) suspension in every degree, beyond the earlier abelian class-action gate. HC4MYHY0/1 now close normal finite monogenic root covers and every monic two-parameter Danielewski output by root transitivity; HC4MYHY2 imposes a global nonmonogenicity gate on every nontrivial finite Keller normalization. HC4MYHZ0/1/2 supply the finite leading-fibre gate and independent abelian-root gate for nonmonic outputs, with exact localized-unit defect. HC4MYIA0/1/2 upgrade the unconditional nonmonic gate to finite nilpotent root/class groups and arbitrary common-prime radical depth. HC4MYIB0/1/2 add arbitrary Galois-intermediate exclusion, the exact global normalization-boundary basis, and subnormal class-stabilizer closure beyond nilpotent actions. HC4MYIC0/1/2 add combined leading-order factor divisibility, rational-label critical-curve geometry and new unrestricted-parameter S3 cubic closures. HC4MYID0/1 refine critical units to factor-specific supports and all subset rank budgets, closing a new square-discriminant S3 family with arbitrary leading multiplicity. HC4MYID2 closes reduced singleton critical units with nonconstant separation, including the cubic two-simple-leading-level case. HC4MYID3 closes the fixed cubic by a polynomial second chart omitting a hyperbola and consequently the entire specified two-simple-level square-critical class. HC4MYIE0/1/2 supply the intermediate-pole necessity, cyclic derivative surface, normal monic rescaling and unrestricted square-free-leading cubic closure. HC4MYIF0/1/2 constrain every source factorization, close square-free-leading quartics and supply a field-degree and nonnormal-order obstruction for the remaining unequal pair. HC4MYIG0/1/2 add reduced-pencil rational monodromy, one-exception polynomial parameters and all-degree scaled and reciprocal-scaled one-variable output closures. The same mechanism now closes rational scalings and rational affine input with polynomial output translation, including all sparse two-positive-term outputs without a gcd condition. HC4MYIH0/1/2 add the strict projective multiplicity bound, exact affine-in-V exception certificate and all-degree mixed-critical-value expansion outputs. HC4MYII0/1/2/3/4 add plane intermediate-branch geometry, unrestricted rational affine parameters, actual-inertia quotient certificates, all nonadjacent pure-power binomials and every cubic output. HC4MYIJ0/1/2/3 add relative central-series descent, actual product-cover preservation with arbitrary parameter monodromy, and the all-degree finite-critical-pole binomial certificate. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 add parameter-cover unit norms, integral algebraic monic models, a direct critical-value valuation lemma and unrestricted plane polynomial-output closure. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons.avoid: Replacing a closed A1 component by a punctured line or rational normalization, rectifying a curve in three dimensions, assuming Euler one implies a coordinate, dropping the repeated-critical-curve case, treating every invertibility conclusion as unit-Hessian nonexistence, or continuing the now-excluded matching-determinant control.
lessons.boundary: All earlier three-affine and ambient quadratic obstructions remain valid. Two directional partials generating the global unit ideal now force their unique plane to be the cotangent plane, give a globally affine free-variable form and an explicit relative coordinate inverse. The aligned rank-three quadratic kernel branch is exactly the unit-ideal plane endpoint. All affine-hyperplane normal images, under arbitrary source parameterizations, are exactly the singleton-zero orbit, the unit-ideal coordinate orbit, or the isotropic-through-center critical-line branch that forbids unit Hessian. Neither endpoint is resolved. Rank-one aligned fibre attainment is not singleton uniqueness; unaligned two-affine embeddings and nonlinear normal image hypersurfaces remain open with the unrestricted row equation. Polynomial quadratic-similitude saturation is now an additional global gate: if q composed with an ambient polynomial automorphism is a*q, undo it in the same source parameters before classifying retained projections or hyperplane images. The entire saturated three-affine class stays closed; the full-source hyperplane saturation retains exactly the old two endpoints or critical-line obstruction. Explicit unbounded words give zero affine pullbacks and nonlinear image equations while preserving a unit-Hessian quadratic source potential. Raw image nonlinearity is therefore insufficient. No universal rectification or generation of every quadratic symmetry is asserted. The output-base obstruction now includes a linear observable paired with any nondegenerate ambient quadratic, not only ambient coordinate pairs. In all stable dimensions r>=2, generic quadric factoriality and a height-one-compatible monomial filtration make the pencil and denominator arguments global, and smoothness forces the plane Keller base invertible. Thus an intrinsic nonautomorphic cotangent pair cannot have such an ambient extension, even after a certified ambient polynomial automorphism. Direct native A/B encodings of an independent Keller pair collapse to an invertible pair and a coordinate potential. Both plane endpoints and arbitrary other source-pair extensions remain open; no surface-quadric factoriality or embedding rectification is assumed. Relative critical schemes now give a separate global gate. A polynomial section over a constant two-variable base, or a base-compatible smooth curve times A1 with vertical Hessian rank one, forces gradient invertibility under unit Hessian. Consequently every base-only normal graph j=(s,t,h(s,t),H,G) under arbitrary relative free-variable polynomial automorphisms has at most one full critical point under unit Hessian, with no cotangent alignment. Its nonautomorphic members are exactly the two old endpoint source orbits. Native graph members with multiple full critical points have no relative unitization over that fixed base. Arbitrary four-variable source mixing and three genuinely free-dependent unretained coordinates remain open. One proper relative Morse component now suffices: no condition on other components is needed, and a globally proper everywhere-Morse relative projection can only have degree one. Each nonautomorphic component must therefore fail properness or contain vertical degeneracy. However each single condition separately retains exactly JC2. The universal f_M model has relative projection K and vertical Hessian -DK^T*DK, while the finite-free Fermat construction gives every K a proper relative projection with explicit monomial basis and ramification at zero. Its properness is not properness of K. Neither model automatically supplies a compatible closed ambient embedding. The two plane endpoints and unrestricted graph compatibility remain open. Uniform quadratic two-planes now have the same unique-plane rigidity under nonautomorphy as affine ones: any genuinely quadratic constant two-plane or two distinct quadratic planes closes the candidate. This classifies every fibre-affine two-affine embedding j=(s,t,b+A*w) in all base degrees. Global source generation requires a polynomial left inverse of A; generic rank is not enough. Alignment follows under nonautomorphy, a rank-three helper quadratic closes unconditionally, and lower ranks force a base-only helper and the two old endpoints. All unit-Hessian members have at most one full critical point. Arbitrary nonlinear free helpers and nonaligned potentials of free degree at least three remain open. Nonlinear isotropic-ideal image graphs now have explicit global quadratic isometries to hyperplanes, with arbitrary coefficients in unchanged variables and all source parameterizations. Compatible positive linear ambient weights give a constructive recognition gate: a smooth invariant image either has an isotropic tangent normal forbidding unit Hessian, or its lower-weight nonlinear terms admit a weighted Euler shear to the nonisotropic hyperplane. Only the singleton-zero endpoint survives for these positive images. Actual positive linear source weights would close gradient invertibility, but image invariance alone does not supply that hypothesis after nonlinear source changes. Other nonlinear images and both plane endpoints remain open. The output-base gate now admits arbitrary degrees for both ambient observables: a smooth scheme-theoretic codimension-two complete intersection of their highest forms at infinity forces any carried Keller pair invertible. The leading regular sequence supplies a common filtered basis and height-one graded domains, while the explicitly imported smooth complete-intersection Picard theorem supplies generic factoriality. Generic factoriality alone and smooth reduced support do not suffice; Pi=(x,xy+z^2) has an exact denominator failure. Arbitrary extensions need not have the required leading forms. Singular, nonreduced or excess-dimensional infinity intersections and both plane endpoints remain open. Generic factoriality is now relaxed by HC4MYHW0/1: torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy suffices, since Keller function fields contain no nontrivial abelian Galois intermediate field and all conjugate component classes then become zero. Geometric integrality of affine height-one fibres suffices for global primitive saturation even with nonconstant fibre units or reducible graded rings. The earlier r=1 exclusion for nondegenerate linear-quadratic output pairs is removed by HC4MYHW2, without calling the quadric surface factorial; degenerate restricted-rank-at-least-three quadratics close too. HC4MYHW3 closes cyclic Danielewski output pairs in every power m>=2, including nonreduced ordinary leading schemes and generic nonfactoriality outside every older smooth-infinity frame in the HC4-size first type. Nonabelian class actions, torsion, nonintegral height-one fibres, uncovered ranks and infinity schemes and both plane endpoints remain open. The nonabelian boundary is now narrower: HC4MYHX0/1 prove that a nowhere-critical polynomial parameter is relatively algebraically closed in the source field, using an explicit classical closed-polynomial import. A class action descending from a finite cover of that one parameter retains its full possibly nonabelian group under Keller base change, so the component classes become principal. This does not make all special parameter fibres irreducible or the whole Keller extension trivial. lessons.boundary: QPF1 supplies two-generated projective ideals in every Weyl rank whose inclusions are isomorphisms in all parameter jets but whose generic fibers are nonfree. Their rank-one generic charge is one and their free special charge is zero. They have no constructed right Weyl action; the same formal left-module class has the good regular algebraization. lessons.avoid: Complexifying a real orbit-separation theorem and then assuming ordinary pure moments determine every contraction, or treating an origin local expansion as an automatic globally isolated rank-one factor.
lessons.boundary: Assaad2608.14475v2 dated12October2026 is relevant methodology, not a global cubic GMC theorem or external review. The complex shear obstruction is compatible with the real-coefficient theorem and with GMC safety.
lessons.reopen_when: The needed correlated probes are independently given, or a new theorem derives them from the actual pure hypothesis with its coefficient and rank conditions.

lessons.title: Replace finite singularity casework with a conductor valuation and a polynomial Bezout gate

lessons.use: Normalize each active multiplicity-one critical component. Under a hypothetical unit Hessian Tang rank one then supplies an entire abstract plane Keller-fibre realization with tau=A and E=D-x*tau.
