lessons.title: Use universal monodromy and isotropy before constructing a finite canonical receiver
lessons.when: Constructing canonical marked etale receivers, comparing fixed universality with input-wise descent, or trying to identify quotient source and target.
lessons.use: For finite homogeneous receivers keep the pair/self-map distinction, connected-isotropy obstruction and disconnected-isotropy costs. Torus quotients have exact finite strong prime-power degrees and symmetric ceiling4. When a nonfinite whole-affine canonical receiver is required, UACANFIB1 now supplies an all-rank polynomial vector-bundle self-map with full S_N marked fibre. UACANVOL1 states its explicit decomposition; neither homogeneous-pair topology nor generic monodromy automaticity proves atomicity at a smaller marked boundary rank. UAPARALLEL1 closes arbitrary polynomial profiles in all retained first outputs: every block subset has a polynomial factor even with cycles. UAWEILATOM1 gives exact ground-field stable length from the field-component count of A after the chosen base extension. The one-direction joint theorem remains complete. UAMULTIKER1 extends the exact common kernel C[Z] to every return rank. UABASICTIME1 factors selectors proved to lie in C[Z,t], even for nonlinear time Keller maps and cyclic nilpotent matrices. UAMARKEDDEF1 preserves the complete marked restrictions by vanishing ideals in a retained first output, giving atomic auxiliary maps of every generic degree d>=3 and preserving any prescribed finite-order thickening and canonical receiver deformations which still factor. UARETURNESC1 gives actual non-descended rank-two and full-rank escapes from the old cubic factor; full canonical atomicity still needs a separate proof. UAROOTDAG1 closes arbitrary polynomial corrections in all retained signals and source roots X_i=x_i*q_i: Keller forces the exact self equation and an effective DAG. UAROOTFACT1 gives polynomial order-ideal models and absolute stable atomic block stages even for some genuinely non-descended rank-two selectors. UAROOTSYM1 groups these into equivariant orbit factors; a transitive action on all blocks has complete fixed-target fibre T0^N and cannot give the natural N-label cover. UASELFCTRL1 closes one affine coefficient line with arbitrary own-source polynomial controls, and even rational controls if the WHOLE output map extends polynomially: only retained-signal effective profiles survive. UASELFLAUR1 supplies the exact nonlinear response and reciprocal-Riccati/pole proof. UASELFFORMAL1 provides all-order formal marked deformations and a genuine source denominator as the concrete next integration gate. UANATIVE2GEN1 replaces every finite native list by two unique effective source controls without changing the map. UAAFFINER1 closes all one-block affine-r controls and gives a fixed-size determinant equation for the nonlinear remainder. UASIGFIELD1 identifies stable signal-field normalizers as weighted compiler scalings plus vertical Keller maps. UAETALEGAUGE1 says the marked finite/formal examples are unique source coordinate changes, with necessarily unbounded source degrees in the explicit scalar family. UAQFSAT1 supplies polynomial descent for any dominant quasi-finite affine-space self-map. UANATIVEORBIT1 classifies the full native profile-coordinate orbit: affine Cout, generic affine-pair reducibility and signal-field-respecting stable profile equivalence all give the unique shear ideal (a^5*c^3). Its finite polynomial-r degree reduction closes the whole quadratic sector. UACUBICDESC1 tests an actual old cubic factor by reducing each output to its three fixed field-basis coefficients; no target-degree ansatz is needed. UAPROFFACT1 upgrades the native profile orbit to complete rational factor rigidity: recovery through ANY retained profile forces its unique target shear, by the already imported published HC4MYGL0 line theorem. UARPLANE1 converts the nonnegative-r generic leaf sector to an actual plane completion with Jacobian 1-SY. UAPLANEATOM1 makes every such completion plane-indecomposable and excludes signal-retaining whole factors whose intermediate coordinates also extend across its hyperbola. UARELPLANE1 cancels a plane Keller target whenever the final curve is a closed embedding, with no boundary-extension hypothesis. UASIGFACT1 closes EVERY native signal-retaining whole factorization, including negative Laurent-r sectors. UAINTERSURF1 replaces the former pole gate by the exact generic intermediate surface under arbitrary stabilization mixing: noninvertible target stages require a NON-PLANE fibre with the stated smooth complete-intersection, tangent, curve, unit, divisor and saturation constraints. UAPRIMUNIT1 closes the cofinite etale surface class with primitive source unit. UAUNITFACT1 uses published whole polynomial root closure to make every nonconstant geometric unit primitive and invert the source stage. A proper arbitrary stabilized native intermediate is therefore GEOMETRICALLY UNIT-FREE and non-plane, has arithmetic UFD ring and an all-irreducible-constant-fibre whole signal component. At every chain cut the unit lattice is either full Z or zero, dropping once at the first noninvertible prefix. UALOGVOL1 closes all nonnegative-logarithmic intermediates after a noninvertible source stage, by the actual r^2 whole-volume multiplier and log pullback on boundary resolutions. UAGEOPIC1 then forces NONZERO geometric Picard group for proper native factors, while its retained-field Galois invariant subgroup is ZERO by rational-point-normalized descent. UADANVOL1 excludes every ordinary smooth Danielewski exponent-one surface by a volume period; higher exponents have an explicit regular primitive. UAPLANECHART1 tests the ENTIRE carried line against EVERY open A2 chart: containment in any one inverts the whole target. Formal etaleness still makes all its finite/formal neighborhoods standard. UADANCHART1 exposes exact simultaneous Keller gluing on the classical Danielewski atlas, a JC(2)-level burden, nondividing ruling degrees and multi-root contact constraints. Its sharp beta-integral contact family fails geometric injectivity in every exponent. UAARITHRULING1 turns ANY actually descended affine-line ruling into a finite geometric plane atlas: arithmetic fibres are integral and geometric fibres reduced. A proper native factor would give JC(2) counterexamples and its whole curve must hit two components of one split fibre. UAPRODUCTTOPO1 uses source Euler characteristic1 and pi1=Z^N on actual product leaves to exclude finite proper stages and force a finite-index abelian intermediate subgroup with index dividing source degree. UAORBFIB1 excludes all multiple-fibre patterns over A1 except one fibre or two doubles, with even source degree in the latter case. UAMLFACTOR1 identifies the trivial-geometric-ML branch exactly with target invertibility in the native class. UAAFFDESC1 PROVES uniqueness and descent of every geometric AFFINE-type ruling: center at the rational point, take a nonzero weighted Galois trace in its stable coordinate line, and contract the actual volume to obtain a retained-field additive action.
lessons.avoid: Identifying different quotient source and target by affine stabilization, equating central-by-finite with virtually abelian, reading specified-group versality as full symmetric universality, or applying the full-degree universal-monodromy theorem to the trace filter. Do not search larger polynomial degrees in these closed rank-one cubic-return or retained-output coupling classes, or confuse a cyclic dependence graph with the removal of an intermediate field. Do not replace a non-descended Schur matrix by an ordinary time Jacobian without proving descent, or confuse generic covering degree with total coordinate degree. Do not deepen root-only polynomial profile degrees while retaining every first signal, equate ordinary nilpotence with vanishing of all principal minors, or read apparent coefficient-list cycles before effective cancellation. Do not freeze the scalar response at coefficient zero, infer polynomial integration from every finite Keller jet or a full formal series, or treat a rational source-open formula as an entire affine map. Do not add more native indices as independent control channels, infer map-degree bounds from the normal-form indices, treat finite/formal source-coordinate existence as a polynomial family, or confuse sigma composed F with a retained first output. Do not treat nonlinear-r B output or arbitrarily high marked contact as a new stable class: explicit whole polynomial target shears already have both. Do not infer atomicity from a nonzero cubic descent remainder, or replace native polynomial-module membership by the source jets alone. Do not reopen the conditional native degree-greater-than-one after-profile branch: it is now empty. Do not deepen searches for polynomial plane decompositions of the completed native map, apply the Keller line theorem directly to its nonconstant Jacobian, or infer stable full-map atomicity from plane indecomposability. Do not reopen the former intermediate boundary-pole route: it is now closed in the entire signal-retaining class. Do not identify a generic intermediate fibre with A2 without proof, assume abstractly isomorphic source surfaces imply trivial factor degrees, or treat a generic etale formula as a whole polynomial factor. Do not reopen the nonconstant-unit intermediate branch or allow a proper finite-index unit lattice in a whole Keller factor. Do not substitute a generic J_d surface cover for whole power descent, remove the retained node, infer geometric factoriality from arithmetic localization, or claim that a unit-free surface has been excluded. Do not reopen nonnegative-log surfaces, geometrically factorial proper native factors or invariant geometric divisor classes. Do not import the finite torus-domination classification into our nonfinite maps, use the obsolete two-surface log-zero list, or turn an exact primitive into an etale plane pair. Higher-power primitive formulas and lattice models do not construct either arrow. Do not identify the raw singular retained-base spread with an actual whole Keller intermediate. Do not turn standard formal curve neighborhoods into a global plane chart, glue plane automorphisms into a non-plane etale target, or call the classical chart-to-JC(2) reduction new. Do not substitute local contacts for the whole closed embedded curve, or search increasing degrees inside the excluded beta-integral family or low/divisibly reducible ruling sector. Do not replace geometric ruling existence after finite extension by descent to K0, transfer arithmetic UFD across that extension, or accept multiple geometric components with multiplicity>1 in a descended ruling. Do not fill a nonfinite surface completion with finitely many points, infer positive Euler integral from nonnegative sheet loss, or apply product-leaf topology to a changed-signal receiver without proving its actual generic fibre. Do not reopen excluded orbifold patterns or the odd-degree two-double sector. Do not treat a unique or Galois-invariant ruling as an unresolved non-descent escape. Do not leave affine-type Galois permutation as an open escape. Do not infer uniqueness from two arbitrary COMPLETE-type rulings, or average different ruling coordinates without checking the generic fibre: the exact trace control is Gm.
lessons.boundary: Finite normal-affine atomicity and nonfinite same-variety self-atomicity are different categories. The new receiver leaves finite quotient geometry, uses a much larger generic degree and is non-atomic. Canonical polynomial-bundle existence is settled there; atomicity, smaller costs and natural fixed-space trivialization remain separate. These classifications use characteristic-zero polynomial retained-signal profiles and the named compiler. Any number of controls with rank-one cubic return is closed; non-descended higher-rank return and other compilers are separate. For another auxiliary block rank-one output recovery is equivalent to geometric generic-line connectedness; no general closedness conjecture is silently assumed. Arithmetic atomicity of connected input algebras is not absolute atomicity. Common kernels are proved for all constant ranks; the full selector classification is only one-directional. Higher-rank membership in C[Z,t] is an explicit hypothesis, not a determinant consequence. The full C is not assumed finitely generated or polynomial. Marked divisor identities hold universally; effective degree and absolute atomicity use the stated characteristic-zero field hypotheses. Fixed-signal rank-two source leaves need not be affine planes. A slice does not imply local nilpotence, and stable polynomiality is not an atomicity converse. The root-feedback theorem requires characteristic-zero fields, unchanged first signals and corrections in k[u,sigma,X]. Independent r_i diagonal variables force every principal minor to vanish. Frobenius dependencies and nilpotent coefficient cycles show why positive characteristic and nonreduced bases are excluded. Transitive product-fibre conclusions require transitivity on ALL nonidentity blocks; the trace filter has an extra auxiliary orbit and changes its first signal. Scalar self-feedback rigidity is a one-block affine coefficient-line theorem with a nonzero effective direction in characteristic zero. It permits all own-source channels and rational controls with whole polynomial landing, but says only that EFFECTIVE profiles are retained-signal polynomials; common direction factors may cancel a rational signal control. Curved coefficient families and mutually changing blocks remain outside. Finite-order parameter bases are nonreduced; the formal ring k[P][[lambda]] permits unbounded source degrees and differs from k[[lambda]][P]. The two-control module identity is universal over bases with2 invertible and preserves arbitrary source dependence. Affine-r rigidity and the stable signal-field normalizer use characteristic-zero fields. Affine-r rigidity is a one-block theorem with actual identity parameters and native source jets, not a theorem about mutually changing blocks. Formal-etale source gauges are classical and work over arbitrary nilpotent base ideals; their compatible formal limit can have unbounded source degree. The source-field normalizer leaves a vertical JC(m) problem and does not classify merely retained-output maps or arbitrary coordinate changes moving that field. Formal marked source equivalence permits actual polynomial families with arbitrary generic-degree jumps; it is not a global degree or stable-class invariant. Native orbit rigidity requires characteristic zero, one retained block, polynomial module membership and coordinate operations fixing identity parameters. Its stable equivalence is restricted to source maps normalizing k(u,sigma); unrestricted source changes are outside. A polynomial-r reduction survivor has non-dividing degrees >=2; negative Laurent sectors and genuine cross-block interaction remain open. The fixed dimension-three descent certificate excludes only the old cubic factor when its remainder is nonzero. Quasi-finite saturation is a classical elementary divisor consequence, not a novelty claim. The profile-factor theorem is one block with retained identities and a literal profile first factor; arbitrary source changes remain outside. Plane completion is generic in the signal and covers only nonnegative r powers. Plane indecomposability requires an irreducible Jacobian and an embedded line; its extension to all fields requires GEOMETRIC irreducibility. It does not imply stable whole-map atomicity. A nontrivial signal-retaining factor must have a genuine intermediate boundary pole. Whole-source special-signal landing and signal-moving factors remain open. The saturation overlap has explicit prior public attribution to Trushin Proposition3.1.1. The relative cancellation theorem leaves exactly TWO generic coordinates and requires a whole embedded A1 image; three-dimensional Keller counterexamples show that one curve alone does not invert a higher-dimensional target. It uses only the curve restriction, allowing poles elsewhere. Arbitrary identity stabilization and intermediate mixing are covered by the NON-PLANE generic intermediate-fibre obstruction. This is still a necessary all-factor condition, not full absolute stable atomicity. Intermediate surfaces satisfy BOTH saturation identities, geometrically have unit rank at most1 and their etale arrows miss at most finitely many points. Their abstract shape, smoothness and tangent triviality do not construct a proper factor. Primitive-unit surface rigidity requires characteristic zero, an AFFINE smooth target, cofinite etale image and the actual node. Its whole-factor unit theorem covers arbitrary last outputs with the fixed retained signal, without native jets or Laurent-degree bounds. Proper intermediates have CONSTANT geometric units; the earlier unit-rank-at-most-one route is now CLOSED on the nonconstant side. Whole constant-level irreducibility is not a statement about all further fibres after fixing E_u. Arithmetic UFD over k(u,a) does not prove geometric factoriality. The native NON-PLANE conclusion still requires the UARELPLANE1 embedded-curve witness. The one-way unit drop bounds no later unit-free chain length. CURRENT: a PROPER native intermediate is GEOMETRICALLY UNIT-FREE, has log kappa=-infinity, and has NONZERO geometric Picard group with ZERO retained-field Galois invariants, despite arithmetic UFD. The Picard factor criterion uses the native curve witness and explicitly imported Miyanishi negative-log affine-plane criterion. The log dichotomy and invariant-class vanishing cover every actual whole retained-signal Keller map. Higher-power Danielewski surfaces m>=2 pass exact volume; u has no Keller mate for all m>=1. Required arrows, free tangent frame, global polynomial lift and canonical marks/gluing remain unconstructed. The raw spread a=z^d-u^m*v is excluded globally by its critical zero fibre; only another smooth whole model could realize the same generic surface. CURRENT CHART GATE: the WHOLE carried A1 crosses the boundary of EVERY plane chart in a proper native factor, despite all finite/formal neighborhoods being standard. Any non-plane etale target containing an open A2 yields JC(2) counterexamples on all charts; this remains CONDITIONAL and has Dubouloz2009 precedent. Higher-power Danielewski targets need compatible nonautomorphic pairs surviving at nondividing ruling degrees>=2 and a carried closed embedding meeting two root components with deg Z>=m*N-r+1. Sharp beta-integral contact maps fail geometric injectivity for EVERY m>=2; other multi-root embedded curves remain open. These deductions retain the actual native/witness two-dimensional fibre and entire-curve hypotheses. CURRENT RULING/TOPOLOGY GATE: a retained-field ruling has base A1, integral arithmetic fibres and reduced geometric fibres, hence a finite geometric A2 atlas and a JC(2) burden for proper native targets. Geometric ruling existence does NOT prove descent. The whole carried curve hits two components of some split fibre. On an ACTUAL U^N times A^h leaf both proper arrows are NONFINITE and intermediate pi1 has an abelian subgroup with index DIVIDING source degree. This is virtually cyclic for one block. Multiple fibres of any surjective connected-generic geometric map to A1 are limited to one or two doubles; the two-double case requires EVEN source degree. No silent product hypothesis for the trace receiver or Euler-integral positivity is permitted. Published Galois-invariant/unique-ruling descent already closes that special descent uncertainty: a proper native factor with such a ruling would disprove JC(2). Conditional on JC(2), every geometric ruling must have a NONTRIVIAL Galois orbit of inequivalent rulings. CURRENT DESCENT RESULT: every geometric affine-type ruling of a proper native intermediate is unique and actually descends; its additive action descends too. Conditional on JC(2), only ADDITIVELY RIGID intermediates with COMPLETE-type Galois-permuted P1 rulings remain. Their descent is OPEN. A zero Picard orbit norm does not identify the individual fibrations.
lessons.reopen_when: A genuinely new atomic coupling preserves the exact marked input cover, or a proved smaller canonical bundle architecture changes the current quantitative bounds. An actual candidate leaves the rank-one cubic architecture, for example through non-descended higher-rank return geometry, another compiler or a non-locally-nilpotent auxiliary with constants outside the stable-polynomial criterion, satisfies its whole-source determinant identity, retains the exact complete fibre and gluing, and proves absolute atomicity. In one constant direction, an auxiliary-only canonical escape must be all-inactive and demonstrate a full constant ring outside the stable-polynomial criterion, retaining exact marked fibre and descent. For root feedback, an atomic candidate must leave the all-signal-retaining polynomial root subring class, for example using additional source channels or a changed first output, and still prove the complete marked fibre and atomicity. A proved broader curved/multi-direction or genuine cross-block construction removes the explicit formal scalar denominator on the WHOLE source, retains complete marks and gluing, and proves full-map absolute atomicity. Scalar-line degree sweeps are closed. A two-effective-control native family leaves the scalar-line and affine-r sectors through nonlinear Laurent-r dependence, or another first-output/compiler/cross-block architecture, and proves whole-source polynomial landing, exact canonical marks, gluing and full-map atomicity. A native candidate has Cout genuinely nonlinear, escapes generic profile-coordinate reduction at a non-dividing polynomial-r degree pair or in a negative Laurent sector, and proves the full marked scheme, effective gluing and absence of ALL actual polynomial factors; another compiler or changed first-output architecture remains permitted. A whole-source native construction has genuinely nonlinear Cout and exact canonical marks/gluing; any claimed factor must escape literal profile recovery and, in the polynomial-r sector, polynomial intermediate extension. A genuinely non-plane generic intermediate surface with the exact saturated field model and whole-source realization, a new curve-witness failure or another compiler must be analyzed without assuming JC(2). A proper factor realizes a NON-PLANE geometric generic retained fibre, both field degrees exceed one, and all curve, unit, saturation, divisor and whole-polynomial requirements are certified; or an actual native integration preserves complete canonical marks/gluing and excludes every such factor. A proper generic surface is geometrically unit-free with the exact arithmetic factorial ring, saturated embedded field, whole carried curve and an all-irreducible-constant-fibre intermediate signal; both whole degrees exceed one and the entire map/global marked gluing is certified. Nonconstant-unit and finite-index unit candidates are closed. Produce an actual negative-log unit-free geometrically nonfactorial intermediate with nonzero Picard group and no invariant class, the exact canonical volume and both etale arrows. The u^m*v=z^d-a families with m>=2 are explicit necessary-condition models, not permission for a bounded coefficient sweep or proof of a whole factor. Supply an actual compatible nonautomorphic Keller atlas and a WHOLE multi-root embedded line satisfying all contacts, both cofinite arrows and a different smooth whole spread, or move to a proved intermediate geometry without such a plane chart. Finite/formal neighborhoods and exact primitives alone are insufficient; JC(2) and canonical atomicity are not declared solved. Prove a compatible JC(2)-counterexample atlas in the descended-ruling class, or prove an actual failure of ruling descent retaining all field, curve, volume and whole-source constraints. Respect the nonfinite source-divisor and sheet-loss budget, the dividing-index group constraint and the orbifold multiplicity/parity gates. Full canonical marks, gluing and absolute stable atomicity remain necessary. Prove descent or exclude actual realization of the remaining COMPLETE-type Galois orbit. The affine-type descent subproblem is closed; extend by a new identification argument, not more necessary conditions.

lessons.title: Test ambient Keller output extensions by their scheme-theoretic boundary at infinity, in arbitrary observable degrees
lessons.when: A proposed stable hypersurface embedding carries the intrinsic plane Keller pair through two ambient polynomial observables, possibly of arbitrarily high degree.
lessons.use: Check that the highest homogeneous forms define a smooth codimension-two complete intersection at infinity. Their leading regular sequence gives a common filtered A-basis and domain graded rings in every target field fibre. The smooth projective generic compactification has dimension at least three; the explicit classical Picard import and removal of its integral hyperplane boundary give factoriality. The disjoint-conjugate-component pencil, global primitive saturation and unit label derivative then force Keller invertibility. An abstract filtered criterion permits other certificates of the same ingredients. HC4MYHW0/1 replace factoriality by torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy and replace height-one graded domains by geometrically integral affine fibres; HC4MYHW2/3 close r=1 quadric pairs, specified degenerate ranks and all cyclic Danielewski powers. HC4MYHX0/1 preserve arbitrary finite monodromy descending from a regular polynomial parameter; HC4MYHX2 closes all constant-coefficient Danielewski P(z) and every T*Y+xy-B(T,z) suspension in every degree, beyond the earlier abelian class-action gate. HC4MYHY0/1 now close normal finite monogenic root covers and every monic two-parameter Danielewski output by root transitivity; HC4MYHY2 imposes a global nonmonogenicity gate on every nontrivial finite Keller normalization. HC4MYHZ0/1/2 supply the finite leading-fibre gate and independent abelian-root gate for nonmonic outputs, with exact localized-unit defect. HC4MYIA0/1/2 upgrade the unconditional nonmonic gate to finite nilpotent root/class groups and arbitrary common-prime radical depth. HC4MYIB0/1/2 add arbitrary Galois-intermediate exclusion, the exact global normalization-boundary basis, and subnormal class-stabilizer closure beyond nilpotent actions. HC4MYIC0/1/2 add combined leading-order factor divisibility, rational-label critical-curve geometry and new unrestricted-parameter S3 cubic closures. HC4MYID0/1 refine critical units to factor-specific supports and all subset rank budgets, closing a new square-discriminant S3 family with arbitrary leading multiplicity. HC4MYID2 closes reduced singleton critical units with nonconstant separation, including the cubic two-simple-leading-level case. HC4MYID3 closes the fixed cubic by a polynomial second chart omitting a hyperbola and consequently the entire specified two-simple-level square-critical class. HC4MYIE0/1/2 supply the intermediate-pole necessity, cyclic derivative surface, normal monic rescaling and unrestricted square-free-leading cubic closure. HC4MYIF0/1/2 constrain every source factorization, close square-free-leading quartics and supply a field-degree and nonnormal-order obstruction for the remaining unequal pair. HC4MYIG0/1/2 add reduced-pencil rational monodromy, one-exception polynomial parameters and all-degree scaled and reciprocal-scaled one-variable output closures. The same mechanism now closes rational scalings and rational affine input with polynomial output translation, including all sparse two-positive-term outputs without a gcd condition. HC4MYIH0/1/2 add the strict projective multiplicity bound, exact affine-in-V exception certificate and all-degree mixed-critical-value expansion outputs. HC4MYII0/1/2/3/4 add plane intermediate-branch geometry, unrestricted rational affine parameters, actual-inertia quotient certificates, all nonadjacent pure-power binomials and every cubic output. HC4MYIJ0/1/2/3 add relative central-series descent, actual product-cover preservation with arbitrary parameter monodromy, and the all-degree finite-critical-pole binomial certificate. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 add parameter-cover unit norms, integral algebraic monic models, a direct critical-value valuation lemma and unrestricted plane polynomial-output closure. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons.avoid: Assuming geometric generic factoriality controls global denominators; checking only reduced support at infinity; omitting closed embedding/global source generation; importing a rectification theorem for fibre embeddings; assuming every polynomial extension admits the good infinity frame; claiming the Picard theorem was reproved or resolving HC4 from this sufficient gate.
lessons.boundary: The output-base gate now admits arbitrary degrees for both ambient observables: a smooth scheme-theoretic codimension-two complete intersection of their highest forms at infinity forces any carried Keller pair invertible. The leading regular sequence supplies a common filtered basis and height-one graded domains, while the explicitly imported smooth complete-intersection Picard theorem supplies generic factoriality. Generic factoriality alone and smooth reduced support do not suffice; Pi=(x,xy+z^2) has an exact denominator failure. Arbitrary extensions need not have the required leading forms. Singular, nonreduced or excess-dimensional infinity intersections and both plane endpoints remain open. lessons.title: Use unnormalized partial-fraction numerators across several escape scales
lessons.when: A known full twisted rank is exhausted by finite one-variable critical jets and escaping Morse branches at several rates, so normalized ordinary Lagrange amplitudes may have badly scaled cross terms.
lessons.use: Let B be the product of finite-node jet factors and simple escape factors in a generic linear form. Use polynomial rows B/(L-L_p)^(mu_p-j) and B/(L-L_i), all degree below the full rank. For determinant checks normalize finite columns by B_p(L_p) and escape columns by B′(L_i); exact relative-product identities then make all escape cross terms small even across different rates. Keep the original horizontal functionals and seed values. Separate critical conic fixed Laurent blocks from isolated finite points and from critical-axis analytic cut-decay cases.
lessons.avoid: Treating column normalizations as parameter-independent horizontal rescalings, assuming all three distinct leading factors are linearly independent, promoting support-pattern counts to a proof without local multiplicity and full-rank checks, applying semisimple formal seed arguments to intersecting axes without a full formal decomposition, or leaving symbolic-exponent normalization failures unrecorded.

lessons.reopen_when: Escape projections collide at leading order, fluctuations grow with their separations, a missing infinity component appears, the Gaussian restriction loses an end pole, or a concurrent/repeated/line-conic leading curve is introduced.

lessons.title: Use the full-branch Orevkov quotient for every zero-excess ramification packet and retain explicit tangency costs
lessons.when: A plane Keller normalization has any number of ramified primes of any indices whose image maps are birational and immersive (zero excess); particularly the sole quartic packet left after PF2RULED45.
lessons.use: At each image value use the full finite local cover, whose cyclic factors lie on disjoint sheet clusters. Its local monodromy image is abelian, so the global representation factors through O(B) for the FULL branch union B. The transitive monodromy G must be nonabelian: abelian would be regular and Galois, but any branch defining polynomial pulls back to a source curve giving an unramified place over that branch. Hence any primary theorem making O(B) abelian excludes the full cover in every degree and index, without an S_d assumption. With a sole e2 prime the quotient is O(C)->S_d. Apply precise published abelianity criteria, not assumed positivity of polynomial infinity links. Use Nori directly in the nodal case; for quartic tangential double values include all m blowups of total multiplicity2, including final boundary separation, to obtain a_n<=1+2T. Independently classify unramified affine pieces by y=z^r,x=z^(1-r)t+h and pairwise translation poles; the common residue r*c_r is their complete exactness test.
lessons.avoid: Treating unramified omitted images as branch curves of the finite normalization; deleting an omitted prime before using finite monodromy; confusing the nonproperness union C union H with branch support C; applying a nodal positivity inequality to tangent double points without the finite blowup cost; inferring all polynomial links are positive braids, inferring nonabelianness from failure of a sufficient test, or using the withdrawn general Jacobian reduction; reopening high-index quartic rows already excluded by QPK4.
lessons.boundary: The all-index, multi-prime O(B)->G quotient requires residue-one immersive ramified image maps (zero excess), retains the full branch union and has nonabelian G without necessarily symmetric G. Positive braids for the whole branch union and the precise Neumann--Norbury class are excluded. Positive-excess/cusp local factors can be nonabelian and need new data. Only the distinct-image two-prime indices2,1 zero-excess quartic case remains; it is non-surjective and its ramified image has a double value. Every admissible unramified normal-form datum is actual smooth affine geometry, but exactness and the source LND do not supply a finite Keller target. 150 exact controls support primary-imported written proofs, not a topological formalization or independent review. Full two-prime quartic and higher-degree exclusions remain open.
lessons.reopen_when: Compare the two componentwise coordinate valuations in the same source ring and full finite target algebra. For the ramified image prioritize surviving nonpositive infinity types and their actual Orevkov quotient, canonical number and tangential contact budget. For several ramified primes use the simultaneous branch-union diagram and actual group G. For positive excess retain the noncommuting local inertia rather than assuming Orevkov factorization. Historical receipt limits remain sealed; audit their retained claims and canonical sources rather than forcing obsolete frontiers into the current next step.

lessons.title: Replace generic factoriality by abelian class-group monodromy and test affine height-one geometric integrality
lessons.when: A closed stable hypersurface embedding carries a plane Keller pair through ambient polynomial observables, but generic fibres are nonfactorial or some height-one associated graded fibres are reducible.
lessons.use: Use the elementary no-abelian-intermediate-field lemma for Keller maps. With a torsion-free generic Weil class group and abelian Galois action, an image-component class stabilizer must be the whole Galois group. The principal sum of conjugate components then makes each component principal. A common free filtration still supplies generic degree additivity, while geometric integrality of affine height-one fibres suffices for primitive saturation. This closes nonfactorial quadric surfaces, every r>=1 nondegenerate linear-quadratic pair, specified degenerate ranks and all cyclic Danielewski powers, in unrestricted embedding degree. HC4MYHX0/1 preserve arbitrary finite monodromy descending from a regular polynomial parameter; HC4MYHX2 closes all constant-coefficient Danielewski P(z) and every T*Y+xy-B(T,z) suspension in every degree, beyond the earlier abelian class-action gate. HC4MYHY0/1 now close normal finite monogenic root covers and every monic two-parameter Danielewski output by root transitivity; HC4MYHY2 imposes a global nonmonogenicity gate on every nontrivial finite Keller normalization. HC4MYHZ0/1/2 supply the finite leading-fibre gate and independent abelian-root gate for nonmonic outputs, with exact localized-unit defect. HC4MYIA0/1/2 upgrade the unconditional nonmonic gate to finite nilpotent root/class groups and arbitrary common-prime radical depth. HC4MYIB0/1/2 add arbitrary Galois-intermediate exclusion, the exact global normalization-boundary basis, and subnormal class-stabilizer closure beyond nilpotent actions. HC4MYIC0/1/2 add combined leading-order factor divisibility, rational-label critical-curve geometry and new unrestricted-parameter S3 cubic closures. HC4MYID0/1 refine critical units to factor-specific supports and all subset rank budgets, closing a new square-discriminant S3 family with arbitrary leading multiplicity. HC4MYID2 closes reduced singleton critical units with nonconstant separation, including the cubic two-simple-leading-level case. HC4MYID3 closes the fixed cubic by a polynomial second chart omitting a hyperbola and consequently the entire specified two-simple-level square-critical class. HC4MYIE0/1/2 supply the intermediate-pole necessity, cyclic derivative surface, normal monic rescaling and unrestricted square-free-leading cubic closure. HC4MYIF0/1/2 constrain every source factorization, close square-free-leading quartics and supply a field-degree and nonnormal-order obstruction for the remaining unequal pair. HC4MYIG0/1/2 add reduced-pencil rational monodromy, one-exception polynomial parameters and all-degree scaled and reciprocal-scaled one-variable output closures. The same mechanism now closes rational scalings and rational affine input with polynomial output translation, including all sparse two-positive-term outputs without a gcd condition. HC4MYIH0/1/2 add the strict projective multiplicity bound, exact affine-in-V exception certificate and all-degree mixed-critical-value expansion outputs. HC4MYII0/1/2/3/4 add plane intermediate-branch geometry, unrestricted rational affine parameters, actual-inertia quotient certificates, all nonadjacent pure-power binomials and every cubic output. HC4MYIJ0/1/2/3 add relative central-series descent, actual product-cover preservation with arbitrary parameter monodromy, and the all-degree finite-critical-pole binomial certificate. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 add parameter-cover unit norms, integral algebraic monic models, a direct critical-value valuation lemma and unrestricted plane polynomial-output closure. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.

lessons.title: Charge inverse-Fourier rank for cyclic branch extraction before constructing a model
lessons.when: A higher-rank Fourier model, finite cover or nonminimal boundary extension is proposed to extract a finite quantum branch.
lessons.use: Compute the rank N of the actual generic connection and its inverse-Fourier rank r. A Kummer self-twist of order e costs r>=N+irr_0-N_reg/e. An irreducible connection that splits over a cyclic power cover has a nontrivial self-twist, so N>2r rules out all such covers. With one finite puncture the same inequality excludes every finite cover. A degree-d pushforward of a rank-m branch costs at least (d-1)m, and boundary delta factors add rank. Use actual generic rank, not the formal classical rank.
lessons.avoid: Testing higher rank without a numerical rank budget, using raw cyclic order before minimal extension, treating arbitrary additional branched covers as cyclic, or identifying an algebraic projector with a full finite-left carrier.
lessons.boundary: The all-cover statement requires at most one finite singularity. General multiple-puncture statements concern cyclic power covers. The exact-R Long application uses QSO2 and scalar fiber reduction; it does not fix deformed first images or produce scalar projective frames. The explicit polynomial S=g(a)+2v family splits algebraically at inverse rank m+1 but the quadratic Long branch cannot have the required finite mate. QVL1 transports repeated roots to nonlinear ordinary infinity limits and closes all proper-power v-linear repairs when lower coefficients are bounded. Together with QVM1, every leading H of degree>=2 is excluded in that entire Laurent class, with arbitrary finite partner order and algebraic coefficient covers. Euler limits and finite Newton support certificates give further tests. A remaining exact-R scalar Long model in the v-linear rational Laurent class has H degree<=1 and inverse-Fourier rank at least four, by QSO2 and a positive infinity Newton contribution. The family 2v*(1+h*a)^k+4a-3ra^2 is excluded for every k>=2, even though k3 passes N6/r3 and branch extraction. Nonlinear-limit commuting Darboux algebras cannot supply a scalar generator, but other operators in larger idealizers remain outside that assertion. Other leading faces, fractional positive lower growth for nonprimitive H, H degree<=1 and nonpositional first images remain open. QZM1 gives a zero-mode cokernel test with finite-cover trace retraction and covariance under actual finite algebra automorphisms, provided the module is transported too. A new position localization can kill the vector and is not justified by trace. It excludes v*(lambda*a+mu)+G(a) for every nonconstant polynomial G and every finite scalar mate order or algebraic coefficient cover. Combined with QVL1, the pure separable class v*H(a)+G(a) with both H and G nonconstant is closed; the leading-linear rank-four cubic and derivative-tuned cubic are excluded. QPC1 subsequently closes the H-constant nonlinear-G case by a universal p-power coefficient. The complete pure polynomial v*H(a)+G(a) Long form is therefore excluded, including every finite momentum degree and coefficient cover. Additional negative-v corrections, genuine mixed coefficients, other leading faces and deformed first images remain outside this classification. Conditional global pair transport clears c(R) and requires [R,T]=0; it neither admits every chart formula nor identifies QRF2 with this new class. QPC1 also gives linear trace descent for a fixed operator mate and the necessary matrix-fiber condition chi_S derivative zero. Scalar p-centrality requires central degree p and fails for general phase matrices; no arbitrary carrier exclusion follows. The finite leading-divisor gate is stronger than the first PDO period test: if gcd(operator order, all leading-coefficient zero/pole orders)=1, the entire base low-order commutator image is zero by finite power subtraction. This excludes every nonconstant squarefree polynomial leading coefficient, with arbitrary mixed lower terms and all finite coefficient covers. Prime operator orders over K(v) require a scalar times an nth power leading coefficient. The separate rational leading PDO equation Qprime-(Hprime/(n*H))*Q=v tests algebraic primitive exactness; its squarefree degree>=3 exclusion strengthens to PDO mates. A passing leading condition remains necessary, and nonscalar matrix carriers are not classified.
