lessons.reopen_when: The contraction inequalities fail, the Jacobian is singular, the root approaches a positive-dimensional component, the desired next moment enclosure includes zero, a smoothness minor cannot be certified or a different coefficient chart is needed.

lessons.title: Use all pairwise resultants at infinity before treating higher-degree source factors as unconstrained
lessons.when: A nonmonic source polynomial can factor without a rational root, especially after the leading triple gcd has excluded intermediate poles.
lessons.use: Factor primitively over the source polynomial UFD. Smoothness of P(f_1,z)+f_2 and pairwise coprime leading factors make every pairwise resultant a complex constant. Monic normalization and the uniform root-difference valuation at V=infinity give ell_i/d_i+ell_j/d_j=1/m while sum ell_i=0. Three factors or two equal factors are impossible in all dimensions. In the plane the prior no-root gate leaves two unequal degrees at least two and closes quartics. For that unequal pair compute the exact resultant power, Keller-degree divisor and explicit integral source element whose monogenic order must be nonnormal. HC4MYIG0/1/2 add reduced-pencil rational monodromy, one-exception polynomial parameters and all-degree scaled and reciprocal-scaled one-variable output closures. The same mechanism now closes rational scalings and rational affine input with polynomial output translation, including all sparse two-positive-term outputs without a gcd condition. HC4MYIH0/1/2 add the strict projective multiplicity bound, exact affine-in-V exception certificate and all-degree mixed-critical-value expansion outputs. HC4MYII0/1/2/3/4 add plane intermediate-branch geometry, unrestricted rational affine parameters, actual-inertia quotient certificates, all nonadjacent pure-power binomials and every cubic output. HC4MYIJ0/1/2/3 add relative central-series descent, actual product-cover preservation with arbitrary parameter monodromy, and the all-degree finite-critical-pole binomial certificate. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 add parameter-cover unit norms, integral algebraic monic models, a direct critical-value valuation lemma and unrestricted plane polynomial-output closure. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons.avoid: Inferring constant resultants from disjoint finite factors when their leading coefficients share a divisor; assuming every unequal pair contradicts the valuation equations; extending the plane rational-root theorem to arbitrary dimensions; calling a primitive integral order normal; applying ruled-surface classification without Q-factoriality or almost surjectivity; inferring actual Keller realizations from a surviving degree pattern.
lessons.boundary: HC4MYIF0 extends the obstruction to all factor patterns: for any Keller map in n>=2 dimensions, primitive source factors with pairwise coprime leading coefficients have constant cross-resultants. The target gcd(a,a_prime,b_(m-1))=1 guarantees that coprimality. At V=infinity all normalized-root differences have valuation -1/m, so every pair gives ell_i/d_i+ell_j/d_j=1/m with sum ell_i=0. This excludes three or more factors and two equal factors in arbitrary degree and dimension. HC4MYIF1 combines the plane rational-root gate to leave exactly two unequal factors 2<=d<e under that gcd. In particular all square-free-leading quartics of arbitrary parameter degree and all quartics with gcd(a,b_3)=1 close, without a critical-discriminant, root-group or special-fibre hypothesis. The full quartic conclusion uses the plane-only root gate. HC4MYIF2 proves for the surviving unequal pair R=lambda*a^(e(d-1))*D^(e-d), the exact degree divisor m(e-d)/gcd(de,m(e-d)) for [L:F], and an explicit integral zeta=a^ceil(e(d-1)/(e-d))*D generating a necessarily nonnormal finite monogenic order. Unequal-factor valuations remain consistent; generic primitive orders cannot be treated as normal. The remaining gcd-admitted high-degree cases have precisely two unequal factors of degrees at least two, subject to that field-degree and order obstruction; joint repeated-leading cases remain separate. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIG0 supplies an all-degree rational-parameter regularity test: every finite reduced pencil member must be nonconstant and square-free. At most one projective parameter point can have constant point form; Riemann-Hurwitz forces any nontrivial composition to give a forbidden constant finite member. A polynomial parameter also passes when all but one finite fibre are reduced and the exceptional multiplicity gcd is one. The proof explicitly imports Petravchuk-Iena Lemma 2(1) closedness/noncomposition equivalence and reuses projective Riemann-Hurwitz. HC4MYIG1 shows Keller pullback preserves these tests and the full group of every finite Galois cover of the resulting one-variable rational parameter field. It extends the filtered class-action criterion without deleting any affine pole fibres. Parameters include (V+B(U))/A(U) and Q(U)(V+B(U)) with arbitrary polynomial A,Q and arbitrary repeated zeros; critical points and critical lines are allowed. HC4MYIG2 closes every P=A(T)R(c(T)z+beta(T))+B(T) for arbitrary nonconstant constant-coefficient R and nonzero polynomial A,c, with beta,B polynomial, and every polynomial P=R(c(T)z+beta(T))/Q(T)+B(T) with nonzero polynomial Q,c. All parameter, source, z and embedding degrees and leading multiplicities are unrestricted, with no root-group restriction. This closes the S3 family T^(3k)(z^3+z)+B(T) despite its intermediate pole, and the full sparse family T^k z^m+z^(m-1)+B(T) despite previously allowed unequal higher factors. General coefficient variation, rational affine representations not meeting the stated polynomial or parameter tests, two unequal factors outside these new closures, other joint repeated-leading cases and other outputs remain open. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIG0 further admits a one-exception rational pencil with algebraically independent numerator and denominator and exceptional multiplicity gcd one; independence rules out every omitted point form. HC4MYIG1 therefore certifies q=Q(U)(V+B(U))/D(U) for arbitrary coprime nonzero polynomial Q,D and polynomial B. HC4MYIG2 upgrades the output closure to P=A(T)R(c(T)z+beta(T))+B(T) polynomial, with arbitrary nonzero rational A,c, rational beta and polynomial B. In particular every sparse a(T)z^m+b(T)z^(m-1)+d(T), a nonzero, closes fully in all degrees without any gcd or leading multiplicity restriction. This removes both unequal-factor and common-repeated-leading residuals for that sparse family. General coefficient variation and rational output translations lacking a parameter certificate remain open; both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIH0 now permits several exceptional projective pencil values: for independent coprime numerator and denominator, require a multiplicity-one factor in each exceptional member and a bound M_lambda for its largest multiplicity. If sigma=sum(1-1/M_lambda)<2, every composition degree is excluded by the per-fibre bound (d-1)(1-1/M_lambda) and Riemann-Hurwitz. Keller pullback preserves the exact multiplicities and hence full finite parameter-cover monodromy. Equality is not closed: an explicit independent-numerator cubic rational example has four double-plus-simple members and sigma=2. The four numerical equality lists and d=1 modulo each M are necessary only. HC4MYIH1 computes all exceptional values of (Q(T)V+C(T))/D(T) from content gcds when D is nonconstant square-free. Its finite members always have a primitive horizontal factor of multiplicity one. HC4MYIH2 closes P=D[R(beta+Hz)-R(beta)]/H^2+B whenever H,D are nonconstant square-free coprime, H divides R_prime(beta), and the zeros of H select at most three critical values of constant-coefficient R. All source, coefficient, embedding and z degrees are unrestricted, with leading D H^(m-2) and repeated H levels in m>=4. This includes an explicit family for every m>=3 and a mixed-three-critical-value quartic failing the older leading gcd. The proof adds no new external theorem or orbifold classification. Coefficient profiles at or above the bound, missing simple factors, uncertified denominator members and other output geometries remain open. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYII0 now identifies every ramified divisorial curve of any plane Keller intermediate field as a polynomially parametrizable nonproperness component; other unramified sheets may remain visible. HC4MYII1 consequently makes every rational affine-in-V parameter (Q V+C)/D regular under plane Keller pullback, with only Q,D nonzero and triple gcd one: primitive horizontal branch curves leave at most one finite composition branch value, and Riemann-Hurwitz plus valuation one exclude the remaining power map. No multiplicity or denominator restriction remains in this plane parameter class. HC4MYII2 closes every final-polynomial rational affine fixed-polynomial output A R(cz+beta)+B0, now with rational B0. HC4MYII3 places the normal subgroup of actual nonparametrizable-curve inertia inside every source group; transitivity gives irreducibility, while a separately preserved quotient, including any nilpotent quotient, gives the full group. This closes (T-c0)^r z^m+z^q+d(T) for every r>=1 and 1<=q<m, since its non-axis critical curves lie in a torus and the residual quotient is abelian. HC4MYII4 completes every cubic output with all coefficient and leading degrees unrestricted: square and zero critical discriminants use II2, while a linear critical double cover forces integral critical values, polynomial cube scaling and a monic Jacobian contradiction. Full splitting-group preservation is not asserted for all cubics. These are plane-only strengthenings; earlier all-dimensional strict multiplicity tests and their equality counterexample remain valid. General higher-degree coefficient variation outside the field/inertia certificates and other output geometries remain open. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIJ0 extends the full-group gate to a relative central series over any separately preserved quotient, using the absence of Galois intermediate fields to descend the series. HC4MYIJ1 preserves every finite cover etale on an actual product U times Y when the finite geometric fibre image is nilpotent: commuting product monodromy makes it relatively central, and an algebraic section plus newly used full faithfulness of Milne Theorem 3.4 identifies the residual field with a genuine parameter cover. Both statements work in all Keller dimensions; the parameter quotient may be nonnilpotent. Essential surjectivity is not used and old forward-only imports remain unchanged. HC4MYIJ2 combines this with plane bad inertia, replacing the former nilpotent residual-group restriction by a punctured-cylinder or certified product-cover quotient. HC4MYIJ3 closes a(T)z^m+b(T)z^q+d(T) whenever a,b are nonzero, 1<=q<m and b^m/a^q has a finite pole, equivalently a^q does not divide b^m. The reduced critical-value curve U V^(m-q)=W has a nonconstant unit U(T), so no component admits polynomial A1 parametrization; the residual branch support is vertical coefficient levels plus V=0. This proves full group preservation, irreducibility and every carried stable plane inverse, without any coefficient, leading-multiplicity or degree bound. In particular every a(T)z^m+z^q+d(T) closes for arbitrary nonzero a, and varying shared-zero coefficients a=T^(m+1),b=T close for every m>=2 and 1<=q<m. The binomial bad-inertia application is plane-only. No-finite-pole binomials require another certificate; their failure of this test is not a nonclosure or Keller-realization claim. Nonproduct residual arrangements and nonnilpotent geometric fibre images remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 now close the entire plane polynomial output coefficient class. HC4MYIK0 extends normal monogenic irreducibility preservation over a finite algebraic parameter curve: the actual source is smooth and finite free over the original polynomial source, and its cross-resultant units have nonzero constant norms. Integrality of every conjugate monic model makes both the target resultant and its inverse integral; inertia, purity and algebraic section descent finish the proof without assuming constant units or an affine-plane parameter source. HC4MYIK1 admits every integral algebraic affine monic model in all dimensions, and combines the no-pole binomial side with IJ3 to complete all plane binomials. HC4MYIK2 directly proves that integral critical values force integral centered monic coefficients in every degree and every residue-characteristic-zero valuation; no dynamical reduction theorem is imported. HC4MYIK3 uses contained plane bad inertia and its normal-orbit block system. Ordinary one-variable Luroth plus a unique-pole argument gives a polynomial outer block quotient. Its surviving critical curves are polynomially parametrizable, so every outer critical value is integral. IK2/1 make the source outer action transitive, and the contained bad inertia then makes the whole root action transitive. Therefore P(f,Z)+g is irreducible for every nonconstant P in C(T)[z], and every carried closed stable embedding through (T,xy-P(T,z)) with P polynomial of positive z degree and r>=1 forces the plane Keller inverse. Every coefficient, source, embedding, leading multiplicity and z degree is unrestricted. This retires all remaining plane coefficient-profile, unequal-factor, no-finite-pole-binomial and critical-curve refinements for this output class. Full splitting-group preservation is not inferred; earlier stronger group and all-dimensional subclass statements remain valid. The unrestricted final theorem is plane-only. Other output geometries and finding compatible ambient observables for arbitrary graph embeddings remain separate. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIL0/1/2 extend the entire polynomial-output closure to arbitrarily many Z variables and arbitrary fixed polynomial multipliers in disjoint X variables. Minimal inner degree gives P=R(S) over C(T) with S noncomposite. The same closed-polynomial implication is explicitly audited over C(T); a direct relative-field argument makes S-U absolutely generically irreducible without importing special-fibre classification or a coordinate theorem. Every outer irreducibility certificate therefore transfers to P, and HC4MYIK3 gives P(f,Z_1,...,Z_k)+g irreducible for every plane Keller pair and every positive joint degree. For A(X)=c product a_j^e_j independent of T,Z, the generic A(X)Y-P-V fibre is smooth and has exact class lattice direct_sum_j Z^m/Z(1,...,1), m=deg R, independent of e_j. Fixed rows and source outer transitivity make its source-fixed subgroup zero. The original global relation gives a common free filtration and every affine height-one target fibre is geometrically integral. Consequently every carried closed stable embedding through (T,A(X)Y-P(T,Z)), p,k>=1 and r>=p+k-1, forces the plane inverse, with all degrees, variable counts and fixed-multiplier multiplicities unrestricted. Arbitrary ambient and target polynomial automorphism orbits are included. For HC4 this covers arbitrary two-Z P with A=X and arbitrary fixed two-X multiplier with one Z. No full splitting-group or unrestricted higher-dimensional Keller statement is inferred. A parameter-dependent multiplier can have correlated row/root action with nonzero invariants; overlapping variables can also break the fibre argument. Neither case is silently admitted, and neither control is asserted a Keller realization. Other output geometries and finding compatible observables for arbitrary graphs remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIM0 proves that every plane polynomial-output equation stays irreducible after every finite algebraic parameter extension E/C(T), equivalently over L kappa_bar, in any number of polynomial root variables. Lift each original bad horizontal inertia group to M E/F, use the explicit Stacks 0BU7 surjectivity lemma, and apply the original plane source theorem before fixing E; horizontal unramifiedness puts the lift into the source subgroup over L E. The same original outer block quotient has integral critical values and its norm proof survives enlargement of the monic-model parameter field. HC4MYIM1 therefore removes generic correlated row/root class invariants for every disjoint parameter-dependent multiplier A(T,X): split its rows over E, retain outer transitivity over L E and get zero source-fixed class subgroup. A global frame is still a separate requirement. HC4MYIM2 identifies the exact height-one fibre condition using the coefficient content delta_A: every P(c,Z) at its zeros must be nonconstant closed, while a constant such level forbids any carried Keller pair by Jacobian divisibility. Either a unit graded leading multiplier coefficient or a unit graded leading root coefficient supplies a global free frame, with all degrees and stable dimensions unrestricted. Other verified frames are allowed. HC4MYIM3 constructs one uniformly beyond both original leading certificates: for (T,(1+h(T)B(X))Y-h(T)b(Z)-Z), B nonconstant and deg b=m>=2, H=B Y-b gives an equivalent global presentation monic in Z, with weights m-1,a+1,m+a and generic domain h B_a H+beta Z^m. Constant coefficient content makes all height-one fibres integral. This closes every admitted degree and supplies actual HC4 unit-Hessian positive controls. Unrestricted parameter-stable irreducibility is plane-only and does not assert full splitting groups. Nonconstant composite content levels, unframed multiplier leading drops, overlapping variables, other output geometries and arbitrary-graph observable existence remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. The HC4MYIM3 unimodular parameter-frame extension admits (T,(A_0+h B(T,X))Y-h b(T,Z)-q(T) dot Z-d(T)) in arbitrarily many disjoint Z variables, with gcd(A_0,h)=1, h nonzero, positive generic X degree of B, constant coefficient content of A_0+h B, and a highest-joint-degree graded leading monomial of b of degree m>=2 with nonzero constant coefficient. Choose u A_0+v h=1 and H=B Y-b, J=u H-v Y. The determinant-one parameter matrix gives Y=u(V+q dot Z+d)-h J and H=v(V+q dot Z+d)+A_0 J. The equivalent global relation is (A_0+h B)J+b-(u B-v)(V+q dot Z+d)=0. Weights m-1 on X, a+1 on every Z and m+a on J give highest equation h B_a J+b_m(T,Z), a primitive-linear generic domain. A Z-first order supplies a monic global basis. The constant-content condition is independent of Bezout coprimality; it is automatic for fixed nonconstant B, or a primitive positive-X coefficient row, but not for arbitrary moving B. All lower b coefficients may vary with T. The carried inverse holds for every r>=p+k-1, all source, coefficient and embedding degrees and all admitted variable counts. This is a uniform frame construction, not a claim every missing frame can be repaired this way. The strict joint degree-gap extension of HC4MYIM3 replaces q dot Z+d by any C_0(T,Z) of joint degree at most n<m. With a=deg_X B, weights m-n on X, a+1 on Z and m+a*n on J make h B_a J+b_m the highest equation; the B C_0 term has positive weight gap m-n. The same determinant-one presentation and unit graded leading monomial of b give a global free frame. All independent coprimality and constant multiplier-content hypotheses remain required. Its univariate leading-divisibility corollary closes arbitrary P(T,Z) of degree m>=2 with leading coefficient h whenever the multiplier A has constant coefficient content, positive X degree, and h divides every positive-X coefficient of A. Write A=A_0+h B; content gives gcd(A_0,h)=1. Coefficientwise Euclidean division writes P=h b+C_0 with b monic and deg_Z C_0<m. Every lower coefficient of P is arbitrary. This is a structural all-degree certificate, not a universal frame theorem. HC4MYIN0 removes the common global free-filtration hypothesis for faithfully flat plane-target observables with geometrically integral height-one fibres: a relative derivation bounds the rank-two generic-pencil lattice, normality makes it reflexive, the explicit surface-reflexivity lemma makes it locally free, and faithful flatness prevents the constant section from vanishing. The invertible quotient is trivial on C[T,V], giving a global primitive pencil coordinate and polynomial saturation. Only a generic positive filtration and principal geometric generic image components remain needed. HC4MYIN1 applies this to every disjoint moving suspension (T,A(T,X)Y-P(T,Z)) whose coefficient-content levels P(c,Z) are nonconstant closed. This includes every primitive A with arbitrary P, with all degrees and admitted stable dimensions unrestricted. The ambient observable map is faithfully flat by nonconstant level polynomials and miracle flatness; parameter-stable class vanishing and a generic weighted filtration complete the proof. Earlier leading and Bezout frame certificates are retained sufficient evidence but are no longer requirements in this family. Missing global frames are no longer a frontier for the disjoint exact-content family. Nonconstant composite content levels, overlapping variables, other output geometries and arbitrary-graph observable existence remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIO0 permits arbitrary independent coefficient fields D/C(T): every positive-degree P in D[Z] has P+g irreducible over Frac(L tensor_C(T) D), including algebraic coefficients themselves. Original-source inertia is lifted on an algebraic parameter cover, outer critical images give integral critical values, and the norm theorem handles their monic models. Finite coefficient-algebra specialization then gives arbitrary independent fields. HC4MYIO1 applies this on multiplier-component function fields: arbitrary overlap of the X coefficients in P(T,X,Z) has zero generic source-fixed class group if a positive Z direction survives on each geometric factor of A(T,X). Distinct rows may have different component counts. HC4MYIO2 closes these carried outputs when every full content-level polynomial P(c,X,Z) is nonconstant closed and a positive generic filtration is certified. No common global free filtration is required. Monic root terms with arbitrary overlapping lower coefficients, and the broader polynomial Bezout leading family P=a(X)b(Z)+Q with u A+v a=1 over C(T)[X] and deg_Z Q<deg_Z b, have uniform generic filtrations in every degree. Gcd one in several X variables alone does not imply that identity, and failure of this sufficient certificate does not exclude other filtrations. Overlap alone is no longer an escape in these admitted families. Residual-direction failures, overlaps with no verified positive generic filtration, nonconstant composite content levels, other geometries and arbitrary-graph observable existence remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIP0 replaces positive generic filtrations by one F-locally nilpotent derivation moving the image equation, under faithful flatness, geometric height-one integrality and principal normal geometric generic image components. Its degree-zero kernel may be large and filtered pieces infinite-dimensional. A moved affine-space component first forces all generic units scalar; the two-sided quotient-unit argument then makes the pairwise component multipliers scalar and supplies the common pencil. No generic scalar-unit hypothesis is needed. HC4MYIP1 forces every nonautomorphic image equation into the kernels of all relative additive actions; a family with joint kernel F, in particular trivial relative Makar-Limanov invariant, forces the inverse without any generic or global positive filtration. HC4MYIP2 applies the natural polynomial-direction actions to every overlap satisfying the residual-direction and exact full content hypotheses. All surviving image equations must belong to F[X]; primitive multiplier content further gives the actual global equation in C[T,V,X]. These are uniform necessary image conditions, not existence or rectification results. The induced source actions fix the original two source coordinates and move only stable variables. Missing generic filtrations alone no longer permit a noninvariant image in this family. Additive-invariant images, composite content levels, other observables and actual endpoint representatives remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. In the general IP0/1 criterion the geometric generic ring is explicitly a normal domain; the overlap application already proves this by primitive linearity. HC4MYIQ0 applies rank-two descent directly to any transcendental h0 with generic image equation E=Q(h0): the global smooth derivative makes Q linear and the source helper rational over F, without a generic filtration or an original global helper equation. That label conclusion still requires a separate field argument. HC4MYIQ1 supplies it for every one-multiplier-variable overlap (T,M(T,X)Y-P(T,X,Z)) with a surviving polynomial Z direction on each generic multiplier row and exact nonconstant closed content levels, for all q>=1,r>=q and all degrees. No primitive-content, monic/Bezout, generic-filtration or forgetful-flatness hypothesis remains; admitted content levels may depend only on X. A nonzero substituted multiplier eliminates Y. A zero substituted multiplier puts the helper in C(T), and retained polynomial-output irreducibility makes the source base change a domain; a finite self tensor is a domain only at degree one. Thus both cases force the original Keller field degree one. HC4MYIQ2 reduces every admitted HC4 overlap survivor to exactly two multiplier variables, one root variable and no unused variables. Its image remains additive-invariant in F[X1,X2], globally C[T,V,X1,X2] for primitive content, and cannot be a nontrivial univariate polynomial composition. One-helper invariant images are no longer a frontier in this family. Two-helper invariant plane curves, residual-direction failures, composite content levels, other observables and actual endpoint representatives remain distinct. lessons.title: Separate spectral torsion, rational denominators and projective frame changes
lessons.when: A rational partner, spectral localization, coefficient cover or fractional/projective frame is proposed after a finite differential obstruction, or all Adler periods vanish.
lessons.use: A nonzero Adler moment excludes mates in the entire rational division ring, not only finite operators. Its first nonzero moment gives triangular strong duals for every q(S), proving nontorsion of the universal spectral class. For G(a)+mu*v the all-degree first period is explicit and survives every rational conjugate. Use rational Galois Reynolds descent for fixed linear mate equations on finite coefficient covers. If Adler periods vanish, test rational torus residues: rational functions of Euler operators and harmonic oscillator Hamiltonians still have no rational mate. In an actual rank-one projective realization, reduce the centralizer of exact r to the relative division ring before testing a rational pair orbit.
lessons.avoid: Inferring rational nonexistence from a finite primitive-divisor or ordinary infinity obstruction, identifying arbitrary PDO series with rational operators, equating scalar spectral localization with moving v,u coefficient poles, using Galois averaging for nonlinear simultaneous tuples, or assuming every Long deformation admits the obstructed rational normal form.
lessons.boundary: G(a) has a torsion spectral class with critical-value annihilator and a rational mate. A mixed squarefree-leading operator can also have a rational mate. The harmonic oscillator passes all Adler periods but fails rational torus admission. The all-cover rational descent uses the one-derivation Euclidean ring. Torus obstruction is stable in every rank, while coefficient-cover descent is asserted in that one-variable setting. Projective obstruction requires an actual rational pair equivalence; arbitrary formal gauges may be nonrational. General nonscalar matrices and new Long rational pair orbits remain open. QET1 uses Galois structure of the actual commutative centralizer field, not Galois averaging of coefficient covers. With finite generation and scalar Weyl units, a nontrivial Galois centralizer field forbids simultaneous individual mates. Its quadratic scalar control has an exact rational mate, preserving the rational/finite distinction. This is independent of QST1's fixed linear rational descent. QET1 also removes actual parameter poles under the polynomial classical centralizer hypothesis, with no finite-generation or field-degree assumption: individual mates have unique finite polynomial polar parts. Subtraction preserves any integral curvature exactly, so an actual generic flat tuple with regular positions descends to a finite integral flat tuple and can match a prescribed classical flat frame. Only h is inverted; rational spatial/operator denominators and arbitrary completed series remain outside this descent. QTB1's radical/Galois-factor obstruction requires membership in the fraction field of the actual centralizer, not merely commutation in the full operator division ring. An actual ratio b/c and a certified identity q(F)b^k=p(F)c^k suffice, without centralizer finite generation. This does not replace QST1 rational denominator or coefficient-cover tests. QPD1 supplies the spectral-denominator converse unused in QST1: rational mate existence on the coefficient curve is equivalent to torsion of the finite universal spectral class. The source admission boundary is corrected; Adler, torus and rational Galois proofs are unchanged. Spectral clearing also applies to rank-one projective Weyl orders, where rational commutants automatically belong to Frac B. This is not an identification with arbitrary moving-coefficient localization.
lessons.reopen_when: An actual finite carrier has a different rational orbit, a new mixed operator passes both period and torus tests with a finite Darboux certificate, or a structural theorem controls the rational pair orbit for every bounded Long carrier.

lessons.title: Use inverse-Jacobian kernels for uncapped target changes
lessons.when: A target polynomial/rational expression in all but one output of a known Keller map must pull back to bounded source degree.
lessons.use: Verify a polynomial inverse Jacobian and use its ith column as a derivationDelta_i withDelta_i(F_j)=delta_ij. Restrict this operator to the complete desired source-degree space. A selected integer minor nonzero modulo a proven prime gives a characteristic-zero rank lower bound; the independent known output-kernel generators give the matching upper bound. A complete minimal kernel can force every arbitrary-degree rational other-output expression to be affine. For bounded-degree targets involving all outputs, reconstruct the full high-degree pullback matrix and certify its column rank, including all monomial degrees through the stated cap.
lessons.avoid: Treating a modular dependency as a characteristic-zero relation; using a modular screen without reconstructing the selected integer minor; confusing a bound on the resulting source polynomial with a bound on target degree; extending the twelve raw-axis uncapped result to arbitrary affine output mixing or applying old derivations to a changed nonlinear source map.
lessons.boundary: KCUB26 certifies6175 independent nonlinear target columns throughdegree5, invariant under affine source/target frames. It separately verifies a4620-term degree15 inverse and twelve rank443 kernels on455 source monomials, proving uncapped rational single-coordinate rigidity in the displayed output axes. Exact modular minors, both inverse identities and kernel generators are independently replayed. Chain-rule and injective-pullback consequences are written, not formalized. No smaller witness, full target-orbit or global sparsity/dimension theorem follows. KCUB27 now excludes every same-weight carrier graph with one-stage raw polynomial repair in arbitrary target degree; ordered/coordinated repairs and other graph directions remain open. KCUB28 gives the independently checked512-subset finite frontier including degree4/5/6 witnesses, without a global optimum claim. Do not rerun unchanged parameter or subset screens. KCUB30 gives31 nonlinear/17 linear occurrences with a nonidentity unipotent linear part, still48 total. It is not a comparable improvement of the identity-linear-part36 bound. Fixed-source outputGL has exact minima31 nonlinear and48 total, with six Pareto pairs; KCUB26 extends these counts to cubic-preserving target degree<=5. lessons.reopen_when: Use coordinated unequal nonlinear source/target changes, temporary higher degree, target maps of degree>=6 involving all outputs after a genuinely changed frame, different graph directions with joint repair or another construction. Arbitrary affine term sparsification remains open; do not repeat the closed target spaces or raw-axis arbitrary-degree attempts.

lessons.title: Use the full trace-dual pencil and radical rank to test the actual non-equivariant finite algebra
lessons.when: A Keller normalization has sole index-two R and a source coordinate with nonvanishing simple pole along the entire R, regular on every other unramified omitted prime; in particular the full complementary r2q1 row.
lessons.use: The inverse different is O(R), generated everywhere by 1,x, so B^vee=B+xB. Use both symmetric trace pairings G0 and G1 and require their block columns to generate the entire dual at every target point. Their determinant pencil is the full source-coordinate inverse, with leading G_R and exact degree drop2 there. At a closed value compute G1 on kerG0: its rank is exactly the local ramification excess, by maximal-ideal/socle Frobenius duality. Sum these ranks in d=n+3+E. Couple this to the exact line-image member factorizations and the already retained conductor derivative pole d-3.

lessons.boundary: PF2RULED53 is uniform in finite degree, D orders, poles, boundary values and coefficients throughout the sole-ramified r2q1 row. It needs no symmetry and no zero-excess assumption. lessons.reopen_when: Construct or exclude an actual finite algebra satisfying the trace-dual equality, global block surjection, radical-isotropy/excess equation, coefficient-unit inverse, line-image factors and conductor pole simultaneously. Preserve every prime and the actual source embedding. Other R orders and common rulings require their full pole/different modules rather than substituting this two-generator special case.

lessons.title: Certify rational-parameter regularity from reduced pencil members before analyzing nonnormal factor orders
lessons.when: Root or divisor-class monodromy may descend from a rational target parameter, especially a scaled one-variable output with repeated leading coefficients.
lessons.use: Require coprime numerator and denominator and all finite pencil members nonconstant and square-free. A rational composition would force every finite ramified point into the one possible constant point form, and Riemann-Hurwitz would then force a forbidden constant member. For polynomial parameters permit one exceptional fibre if its multiplicity gcd is one. Keller pullback preserves both certificates and hence every finite parameter-cover group. Apply this to (V+B)/A and Q(V+B), with arbitrary repeated zeros, to close polynomial and polynomial reciprocal scalings of a fixed one-variable R, including all admitted affine input changes and every degree. The same mechanism now closes rational scalings and rational affine input with polynomial output translation, including all sparse two-positive-term outputs without a gcd condition. HC4MYIH0/1/2 add the strict projective multiplicity bound, exact affine-in-V exception certificate and all-degree mixed-critical-value expansion outputs. HC4MYII0/1/2/3/4 add plane intermediate-branch geometry, unrestricted rational affine parameters, actual-inertia quotient certificates, all nonadjacent pure-power binomials and every cubic output. HC4MYIJ0/1/2/3 add relative central-series descent, actual product-cover preservation with arbitrary parameter monodromy, and the all-degree finite-critical-pole binomial certificate. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 add parameter-cover unit norms, integral algebraic monic models, a direct critical-value valuation lemma and unrestricted plane polynomial-output closure. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. lessons.title: Turn inverse-Jacobian jets into universal graph duals and verify finite carrier frontiers
lessons.when: A parameterized graph restriction must be repaired to cubic by an arbitrary-degree function of the other raw outputs, or partial carrier deletion trades degree for dimension.
lessons.use: Normalize the desired cubic source polynomial by subtracting affine other-output combinations. Verify actual inverse-Jacobian jets by their identities on every raw output, then solve for a polynomial-in-parameter coefficient functional annihilating the full quadratic/cubic source basis and pairing the defect to1. Include every projective boundary. If a preliminary pairing has a root, add exact source support at that root until a unit pairing is obtained. For constructive partial deletions, exhaust the finite subset family, independently substitute the live map one row at a time and compute full symbolic Schur determinants for all reported frontier witnesses.
lessons.avoid: Promoting order5 necessary-system solutions to target completions; ignoring a parameter denominator or factor root; turning finite parameter probes into a universal obstruction; reusing the older rank6 BCR2 graph theorem for the rank5 KCUB3 map; calling a literal-subset Pareto optimum global or a primary-only comparison independently proved.
lessons.boundary: KCUB27 covers all nine same-weight carrier charts with arbitrary polynomial target degree, and its two essential pencils even for rational corrections.704 exact annihilations and2 unit pairings of parameter degree2 suffice at source order7. KCUB28 reconstructs512 literal subsets, all projected collisions and five full determinant-one witnesses: (3,7,13),(4,6,15),(5,5,17),(7,4,23),(12,3,36). The subset frontier is exact only for this finite family. Existing headline bounds and62/12 profile counts remain unchanged; global support and special-form dimension minima remain open. KCUB29 now closes all raw linear carrier-relation subspace graphs of the savedK in the standard highest-pivot parametrization, including simultaneous and cross-weight relations:13 raw occurrences are sharp in the whole class and fixed-dimension degree minima match the literal subsets. Minimal4/5/7-dimensional degree6/5/4 families have sharp15/17/23 terms. General nonlinear graph parametrizations, later target repairs and affine output sparsification remain outside this result.
lessons.reopen_when: Use base-output or nonlinear graph coordinates, changed source parametrizations, coordinated or ordered target repair beyondKCUB27, changed carrier realization/frame/construction, or output-frame sparsification. KCUB29 also closes all raw cross-weight linear carrier-subspace graphs; do not repeat these512 full charts or the earlier weighted/literal screens.

lessons.title: Bound all composition degrees at once by exact projective pencil multiplicities
lessons.when: A regular-parameter argument has several nonreduced values, especially a rationally translated critical-point expansion.
lessons.use: Require independent numerator and denominator, include every exceptional projective member, and retain a simple factor in each. Bound the local degrees by its maximum M. One unramified preimage leaves d-1 local degrees, so total ramification forces sum(1-1/M)>=2 in any nontrivial composition. Strictly smaller sums certify field regularity after Keller pullback. For affine-in-V parameters compute content gcds and critical derivative values exactly. Critical-point expansions with H dividing R_prime(beta) and at most three selected critical values then have weight at most 3/2 and close in all degrees. HC4MYII0/1/2/3/4 add plane intermediate-branch geometry, unrestricted rational affine parameters, actual-inertia quotient certificates, all nonadjacent pure-power binomials and every cubic output. HC4MYIJ0/1/2/3 add relative central-series descent, actual product-cover preservation with arbitrary parameter monodromy, and the all-degree finite-critical-pole binomial certificate. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 add parameter-cover unit norms, integral algebraic monic models, a direct critical-value valuation lemma and unrestricted plane polynomial-output closure. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons.avoid: Using gcd or lcm in place of the required maximum bound; omitting the infinity denominator; replacing an actual simple component by multiplicity gcd one; ignoring numerator-denominator dependence; treating equality numerical lists as closed or all realized; importing orbifold classifications without an orbifold certificate; allowing constant or non-square-free D in the coefficient corollary without another test; assuming nonlinear Hessian invariance.
lessons.boundary: HC4MYIH0 now permits several exceptional projective pencil values: for independent coprime numerator and denominator, require a multiplicity-one factor in each exceptional member and a bound M_lambda for its largest multiplicity. If sigma=sum(1-1/M_lambda)<2, every composition degree is excluded by the per-fibre bound (d-1)(1-1/M_lambda) and Riemann-Hurwitz. Keller pullback preserves the exact multiplicities and hence full finite parameter-cover monodromy. Equality is not closed: an explicit independent-numerator cubic rational example has four double-plus-simple members and sigma=2. The four numerical equality lists and d=1 modulo each M are necessary only. HC4MYIH1 computes all exceptional values of (Q(T)V+C(T))/D(T) from content gcds when D is nonconstant square-free. Its finite members always have a primitive horizontal factor of multiplicity one. HC4MYIH2 closes P=D[R(beta+Hz)-R(beta)]/H^2+B whenever H,D are nonconstant square-free coprime, H divides R_prime(beta), and the zeros of H select at most three critical values of constant-coefficient R. All source, coefficient, embedding and z degrees are unrestricted, with leading D H^(m-2) and repeated H levels in m>=4. This includes an explicit family for every m>=3 and a mixed-three-critical-value quartic failing the older leading gcd. The proof adds no new external theorem or orbifold classification. Coefficient profiles at or above the bound, missing simple factors, uncertified denominator members and other output geometries remain open. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYII0 now identifies every ramified divisorial curve of any plane Keller intermediate field as a polynomially parametrizable nonproperness component; other unramified sheets may remain visible. HC4MYII1 consequently makes every rational affine-in-V parameter (Q V+C)/D regular under plane Keller pullback, with only Q,D nonzero and triple gcd one: primitive horizontal branch curves leave at most one finite composition branch value, and Riemann-Hurwitz plus valuation one exclude the remaining power map. No multiplicity or denominator restriction remains in this plane parameter class. HC4MYII2 closes every final-polynomial rational affine fixed-polynomial output A R(cz+beta)+B0, now with rational B0. HC4MYII3 places the normal subgroup of actual nonparametrizable-curve inertia inside every source group; transitivity gives irreducibility, while a separately preserved quotient, including any nilpotent quotient, gives the full group. This closes (T-c0)^r z^m+z^q+d(T) for every r>=1 and 1<=q<m, since its non-axis critical curves lie in a torus and the residual quotient is abelian. HC4MYII4 completes every cubic output with all coefficient and leading degrees unrestricted: square and zero critical discriminants use II2, while a linear critical double cover forces integral critical values, polynomial cube scaling and a monic Jacobian contradiction. Full splitting-group preservation is not asserted for all cubics. These are plane-only strengthenings; earlier all-dimensional strict multiplicity tests and their equality counterexample remain valid. General higher-degree coefficient variation outside the field/inertia certificates and other output geometries remain open. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. lessons.title: Use actual centralizer field and boundary inertia before proving module finiteness
lessons.when: A fixed commuting quantum pair or tuple has a finitely generated commutative actual centralizer and one wants individual conjugates or a finite flat completion.
lessons.use: Determine the actual fraction field H over L(F_i). Under actual generic individual mates and QFC1's classical hypothesis, differential simplicity makes the finitely generated centralizer etale. Scalar Weyl units retain every base divisor; birational or Galois field data then force the polynomial centralizer and finite completion. A nontrivial Galois field instead obstructs simultaneous individual mates in all orders. Every generic inertia generator of a nonpolynomial survivor must have a fixed sheet, and its field is non-Galois of degree at least three. For another actual algebra verify the finite field extension and base-unit condition explicitly. Normalize their finite polynomial parameter-pole parts first; a full generic flat tuple already descends integrally without centralizer finite generation.
lessons.avoid: Confusing finite algebra generation with module finiteness, leading-symbol field degree with actual centralizer field degree, the latter with whole quantum division indices, a local fixed sheet with one global branch, or scalar Weyl units with units of a projective idealizer. Do not assert finite generation for all Long centralizers or use the Galois theorem without actual centralizer and individual-mate hypotheses.
lessons.boundary: A unit-bearing quadratic Galois Ore model has full flat relations and identity classical reduction but is outside the scalar Weyl algebra. The retained rank-three cotangent countercontrol has non-Galois cubic centralizer field with S3 normal closure, so the degree-three lower bound is sharp there and no universal finiteness follows. The scalar quadratic deformation has rational mates but no finite mate. Birationality is an actual field certificate, not a leading or completed one. The general etale/normalization theorem assumes finite generation; that hypothesis remains unknown for a new Long candidate. QET1 also removes actual parameter poles under the polynomial classical centralizer hypothesis, with no finite-generation or field-degree assumption: individual mates have unique finite polynomial polar parts. Subtraction preserves any integral curvature exactly, so an actual generic flat tuple with regular positions descends to a finite integral flat tuple and can match a prescribed classical flat frame. Only h is inverted; rational spatial/operator denominators and arbitrary completed series remain outside this descent. QTB1 removes finite generation from the birational/Galois conclusions, not from the finite-type etale description. Taylor flatness gives unramified valuations in every specified finite intermediate, so no nontrivial finite Galois factor survives. A birational differential overring is a localization, and scalar units force it polynomial. An actual radical ratio supplies a finite obstruction certificate without computing all B. QPD1 supplies scalar units and the field hypotheses for rank-one finite projective Weyl orders and identifies their rational centralizer with Frac B, without a scalar free frame. Its spectral clearing theorem equates rational individual admission with torsion; actual zero classes and full curvature still remain separate. The commutativity hypothesis must hold, as QSC1 ensures for Long.
lessons.reopen_when: An actual Long centralizer is computed with finite-generation evidence and a birational or nontrivial Galois field certificate, a non-Galois field fails the divisor fixed-sheet test, or a genuinely new candidate passes these geometric gates and QSC1's actual global classes.

lessons.title: Use affine sign-surface topology to square the determinant obstruction and separate Picard from Weil torsion
lessons.when: An actual normal affine double sign surface has irreducible branch, finite rational-tree resolution singularities and knot outer boundary; in particular the entire surviving quartic Keller packet has the PF54 everywhere-etale cyclic triple.
lessons.use: Close the units quotient with the prime cyclic-cover theorem or quadratic UFD degree descent. Kummer then requires nonzero Pic[3] for the quartic triple. Apply the singular Stein CW theorem to S, then the relative exceptional-tree sequence to prove H1 unchanged and H2 of its resolution free. For the compact truncation, compute the exact boundary sequence and the torsion correction: detK=abs(det Q)*abs(H1(S))^2. Thus9 divides detK in the quartic, and the entire Picard torsion order squared divides detK. Retain the isotropic torsion image in the boundary linking form, which can fail even at order9. Propagate the3-adic cable recurrence through every stage with actual winding convention.
lessons.avoid: Using a smooth-only Stein theorem on a singular sign surface; assuming a resolution is affine; discarding torsion in H2 before deriving the square formula; replacing the whole torsion correction by H1 without proving freeness; substituting Cl[3] for Cartier Pic[3] or quasi-etale for everywhere etale; assuming nine divisibility suffices for global monodromy; assuming a rational compactification or negative definiteness; exporting S4/V4=S3 to higher symmetric groups.
lessons.boundary: PF2RULED55 excludes all infinity knots with v3(detK)<=1 for the entire quartic packet at unbounded source orders, target degrees and rulings. The sign-surface square theorem is independent of branch degree, conditional on the stated topology and actual cover data. Oka Pic=Z3 is a Cstar-branch control; the A2 cone has Cl=Z3 but Pic0. 55 finite controls support written proofs with primary imports, not formal or independent full verification. Nine-divisible candidates and the general Keller objective remain open.
lessons.reopen_when: Use actual infinity discriminant/linking forms and the actual global Picard group, not deeper source coefficients. For nine-divisible survivors, test isotropic3 subgroups and combine the sign cover with the marked source and full trace-dual algebra. Higher Keller degrees need a separately justified global cover or a different general geometric argument.

lessons.title: Cover every carrier relation subspace and certify degree and support by coefficient units
lessons.when: A triangular carrier map is simplified by imposing simultaneous linear relations among its carrier outputs, or raw nonlinear occurrence counts are minimized in such graph restrictions.
lessons.use: Use reverse row reduction to cover every relation subspace by its highest-pivot chart. For each deleted outputj, include every free carrierk<j with an independent scalar, without a weight restriction. Build every full source-coefficient polynomial. A rational constant combination of the degree-defect coefficients equal to1 excludes the entire chart, including all parameter specializations. For sparsity, count parameter-independent nonzero coefficient slots; a unit identity among additional varying slots forces another occurrence. Classify surviving minimal-degree charts by exact generator identities, product-domain branches and coefficientwise normal forms. Independently replay live graph substitutions, rather than importing the producer embedding.
lessons.avoid: Treating512 charts as512 sampled points; dropping cross-weight coefficients or pivot boundaries; assuming raw occurrence counts invariant under arbitrary affine output changes; asserting an entire Pareto frontier from fixed-dimension degree minima; using a generic Groebner answer or parameter probing as an exclusion; repeating the now-closed linear graph class.

lessons.title: Rule out basepoint-free power differences and retain the unavoidable cubic order index
lessons.when: A polynomially A1-normalized irreducible branch curve is represented as A^p-B^q for coprime p,q>=2, or a genuine everywhere-etale sign triple supplies a normal cubic resolvent with only2+1 branch fibres.
lessons.use: Treat dependent and dominant coefficient maps separately. Constant units on A1 force coefficient constancy along the branch if there is no basepoint. Use polynomial abc for the dependent image and an explicit logarithmic pq-canonical form for the dominant map lifted to the smooth-point blowup retaining its exceptional curve. The piecewise toric order identities prove the obstruction in all degrees and exponents. For the actual quartic cubic quotient, derive the local product R x R[z]/(z^2-G) also at sign singularities; a global generator would produce a basepoint-free square-cube branch equation, contradiction. Keep the nonconstant determinant index of every primitive integral cubic element and the full normal algebra.
lessons.avoid: Assuming coefficient-map dominance; applying polynomial abc directly to two-variable polynomials; dropping the exceptional curve after blowing up a smooth branch point; checking a finite fan census instead of all-ray identities; treating any monogenic S3 cover of an immersive A1 curve as having an everywhere-etale sign triple; confusing free modules or primitive field elements with monogenic integral algebras; discarding the discriminant index square or assuming its support is distinct from the true branch; putting the cubic resolvent inside the quartic source field.
lessons.boundary: PF2RULED56 proves the coprime power-difference basepoint theorem in all polynomial degrees and exponents and excludes all globally monogenic normal cubic resolvents for the entire actual quartic packet. It does not force monogenicity or prove Picard3 vanishing. The explicit A1 A5 torus curve has an inner basepoint and a non-etale sign triple at its singularity; Oka Cstar covers remain allowed. 59 exact controls support written unbounded proofs, not formal or independent full verification.
lessons.reopen_when: Couple the unavoidable cubic order index to the marked quartic source and PF53 trace-dual algebra, or test actual Picard/linking data. A full contradiction needs a separately proved normal monogenic resolvent or another obstruction to every allowed index. Higher Keller degrees need separately justified cover data. Do not replace those missing geometric implications with a coefficient sweep.

lessons.title: Use Taylor branches and actual radical certificates without centralizer finite generation
lessons.when: A commuting scalar quantum tuple has polynomial classical joint centralizer and one wants a positive completion certificate or an all-partner obstruction, with no finite presentation of its actual centralizer.
lessons.use: Use commuting translation derivations and the injective Taylor map at an arbitrary maximal ideal. Flatness of its coordinate map retains an unramified valuation over every base divisor in every finite intermediate centralizer field. No nontrivial finite Galois factor can survive. Birationality then forces the actual centralizer polynomial, without finite generation, and actual generic mates yield finite integral full completion. For an obstruction it suffices to exhibit actual commutants b,c and q(F)b^k=p(F)c^k with p/q not a kth power; this certifies a forbidden radical in Frac B without computing all B. Monodromy point stabilizers must normally generate their group.
lessons.avoid: Requiring centralizer finite generation before the birational, Galois-factor or radical tests; inferring finite-type etaleness without that hypothesis; replacing Frac B membership by arbitrary rational commutation; confusing total order at a singular point with a divisorial valuation; or inferring a common global sheet from local inertia fixed points. QPD1 supplies unit and field hypotheses automatically for rank-one finite projective Weyl orders; verify them separately outside that class.
lessons.boundary: The unit condition remains essential, as infinite differential localizations demonstrate. H may be an infinite algebraic extension; the theorem normalizes only each specified finite intermediate field. The scalar radical descent uses constant root-of-unity extension and actual centralizer membership. S3 cubic fields can survive; D4 quartics fail because of a quadratic Galois factor. No actual new Long field or radical certificate is supplied. QET1's finite-type etale description retains its finite-generation hypothesis. QPD1 automatically verifies the unit, algebraicity and horizontal-constant hypotheses for a commutative centralizer in a rank-one finite projective Weyl order. Every rational commutant clears by a polynomial in the complete commuting images, so Frac B membership is automatic there. Radical and Galois-factor certificates can therefore be tested in the full Weyl division realization before a scalar free frame. Other endomorphism algebras retain separate hypotheses. QCI1 proves H/C finite for any actual full tuple with finite whole division indices, even when B is not finitely generated. Its degree d divides both N_l,N_r and N=d*M. For Long, residual M>=3 and the no-Galois-factor theorem makes nontrivial d>=3, hence N>=9. The commutative valued-field tower is only a control, not a Weyl or Long construction. QCI1 exhibits rational full pairs with birational chosen-position centralizer and genuine residual degree m, but no finite carrier in any diagonal finite rank. The all-rank obstruction is bounded matrix powers, not a forbidden Galois factor. Its source exchange changes (d,M) from (1,m) to (m,1), and the displayed rational family does not meet the actual-order hypotheses of the Taylor theorem. QGD1 supplies a separate Galois obstruction for the whole noncommutative image division ring, not H/C. Its finite quotient residue must be Galois after accounting for all valuation branches; the full classical Long cubic is not. No centralizer finite generation or chosen position field is needed for that whole-field theorem. A larger S3 normal closure with a subgroup-fixed source remains outside the direct-quotient exclusion.
lessons.reopen_when: A new actual Long pair admits a birational centralizer field proof and actual individual mates, an exact forbidden radical/Galois-factor certificate, or a finite intermediate monodromy field violating stabilizer normal generation or local fixed-sheet conditions.

lessons.title: Count coefficient-column supports and keep linear-part normalization explicit
lessons.when: A fixed-source Keller map is sparsified by linear or affine output changes, especially when nonlinear counts can be exchanged for linear terms.
lessons.use: Treat every source monomial coefficient as a vector in output space. Invertible output changes preserve nonzero columns and their projective relations. A rank2 triple of pairwise-nonparallel columns forces at least4 total supports. Partition all source columns into disjoint sets and use heavy collinear multiplicities, quotient supports and nonzero light-vector minors to derive an additive total-count lower bound even when output rows mix the sets. Track linear, nonlinear and total counts separately, construct every claimed Pareto point, and independently check both actual map determinant/collision and any proposed source normalization.
lessons.avoid: Calling31 nonlinear plus17 linear terms a comparable improvement over36 nonlinear plus12 linear under identity-linear-part normalization; claiming a smaller total when both total48; assuming coefficient-column support invariant under source mixing; inferring global optima from an output-only class; extending KCUB26 to target degree>=6 or to a genuinely changed nonlinear source without recomputing.
lessons.boundary: KCUB30 constructs an integral12-variable cubic with31 nonlinear terms, unipotent nonidentity linear part and an integral collision. Independent full polynomial determinant and all six stage checks pass. Fixed-source output frames have sharp N>=31,L>=12,L+N>=48 and the six Pareto pairs(12,36) through(17,31).42 full source columns and block bounds5,15,16,6,2,2,2 certify total48. KCUB26 is an explicit imported premise extending this count bound to cubic-preserving target degree<=5. Left normalization returns the old36-term map; source normalization gives a checked74-term conjugate. No dimension, total-term, global or identity-normalized improvement is established. KCUB31 completes the five-parameter joint source block at(2,7),(2,10),(3,9),(3,8),(9,8): sharp36 normalized only at identity, next39, and every changed source needs at least34 terms even with arbitrary output mixing.68 exact source-column quotient units cover all parameter roots; free-output minimum31 stays at the unchanged source. This leaves larger source blocks, affine centres and nonlinear transformations open and proves no total-term optimum over all joint frames.
lessons.reopen_when: Change source coordinates or graph parametrization jointly with target repair, seek another map or carrier realization, or use genuinely new higher-degree target structure involving all outputs. Do not repeat arbitrary fixed-source outputGL or degree<=5 targets. Output frames of the other partial graph maps are not closed byKCUB30. lessons.title: Preserve a genuine parameter quotient, then descend the relative central geometric kernel
lessons.when: A finite cover has nonnilpotent residual group but an actual product-open certificate, or a varying-coefficient binomial has an unresolved all-degree factor problem.
lessons.use: Certify an already-contained normal subgroup, then a relative central series over a separately preserved quotient. The no-Galois-intermediate theorem descends that series. On U times Y, the product monodromy images commute; a nilpotent fibre image has the needed relative series. Restriction to an algebraic section plus full faithfulness of Milne Theorem 3.4 proves algebraic parameter-cover descent, so regularity of the first Keller component preserves the quotient. In the plane, kill actual inertia on nonparametrizable curves first. For a(T)z^m+b(T)z^q+d(T), a finite pole in b^m/a^q supplies precisely that geometric obstruction and leaves a punctured-cylinder quotient. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 add parameter-cover unit norms, integral algebraic monic models, a direct critical-value valuation lemma and unrestricted plane polynomial-output closure. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. lessons.title: Change the exact twisted representative and keep its amplitude derivative
lessons.when: A retained full twisted connection has a polynomial top phase or structured Laurent endpoint, and analytic seed exclusions are already established.
lessons.use: Add an exact twisted divergence to the whole connection, including its vector-field derivative on all later amplitudes. For ordinary binary volume the radial divergence includes2f, cancels the constant quartic and lowers seed amplitude degree to3j. For logarithmic dy/y there is no volume constant; the cubic endpoint factor constant*K^3 lets the Euler coefficient clear only quadratic K and lowers negative seed support to-2j. Keep actual seed rank, basis grades, separated endpoint divisors and high scalar valuations; add every frame branch back.
lessons.avoid: Replacing only the scalar source while dropping E(R_j); omitting the ordinary volume2f or adding it to dy/y; clearing the degree-six endpoint instead of its quadratic cube factor; dividing by an identically zero K instead of lowering actual order; discarding K(0)=0 or the trapped component; extending258 beyond cubic G; treating a generic tame Morse theorem as a degenerate class proof; rejecting rational scalar coefficients when only polynomial t-denominators must be cleared.

lessons.title: Use shared principal factors and cancel every weighted top source
lessons.when: A complete rational twisted reduction has coefficient factors shared across its principal projections, or a weighted phase has independently variable top coefficients.
lessons.use: Inspect the whole principal division before multiplying its leading coefficients. In ordinary-node normal form A=aD,B=dD,E=DLe,F=DLf, clear D only once, keeping exact combined divergence cofactors and all old coefficient opens. Use a formal degree grading before substituting linear D,Le,Lf. For cusp/tangent choose two weighted Euler coefficients to cancel both top source terms, including their volume divergence and their derivatives on every later amplitude. Retain actual-seed rank, basis grades and scalar valuations; add all frame branches before taking a global maximum.
lessons.avoid: Assuming principal coefficients have unrelated denominators; removing a shared D without verifying all complete cofactors; introducing coprimality or D(0)!=0; bounding separate fourth-operator products after their leading cancellation; changing only the scalar source while dropping amplitude derivatives; omitting volume terms; calling complement227 or254 a full gate; lowering even258 to257 by parity; rewriting hash-bound earlier proof bodies.

lessons.title: Use source-unit norms and polynomial inertia blocks to close the whole plane polynomial-output class
lessons.when: A polynomial output still seems to need leading or coefficient refinements, or a normal monogenic argument is transported through an algebraic parameter cover.
lessons.use: Keep the actual finite normal parameter curve and smooth source base change. A factor cross-resultant is a source unit, whose finite-free norm is a nonzero constant on the original polynomial source. All parameter-conjugate monic models make the norm identity prove target integrality of both the resultant and its inverse. Inertia and purity leave a preserved parameter quotient, excluding every proper factor. Integral critical values give such monic models by direct valuation scaling. In the plane, take the normal subgroup of nonparametrizable branch inertia; its block quotient is polynomial by ordinary Luroth and the unique-pole argument. Parametrizable outer critical curves force integral critical values. This proves root transitivity for every P in C(T)[z] of positive degree and the entire polynomial (T,xy-P) carried inverse. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction.
