lessons.title: Test canonical content before choosing a global inverse format and keep the common binary/cubic index
lessons.when: An actual plane Keller finite normalization or its binary inverse is being modeled globally, in any field degree, with all omitted primes and their canonical ramification coefficients retained.
lessons.use: Use the free boundary class basis and K=sum(e_i-1)E_i. Global affine complete intersections force K0 and are impossible. Projective CI formats require s=sum degrees-r-1 dividing g=gcd(e_i-1); consequently d<=2^(g+1) within that format. Primitive K permits only cubic/P1 and quartic/two-quadrics formats. The full Euler budget plus Orevkov maximal-index exclusion remove every normal binary model in all Keller degrees. Retain the surface conductor class (d-2)L-K and its strictly positive class coefficients for an admissible source-finite inverse. In the quartic the monic cubic resolvent has exactly the same index determinant as the binary quartic order. In the whole complementary r2q1 row, generic T=x+gamma*y has conductor class R+2pD for arbitrary D pole p and forces an index support distinct from both omitted images. An actual complete two-quadric pencil has no globally everywhere-smooth conic member.
lessons.avoid: Applying the conditional CI degree bound to all algebras; assuming canonical content1 for arbitrary high indices; replacing a nonnormal binary root order by its normal finite algebra while discarding conductor; mistaking a morphism to P1 for a closed relative embedding; identifying conductor class coordinates with its actual boundary multiplicities; confusing the surface conductor with the curve normalization conductor at isolated image points; treating the binary and cubic normalization indices as independent; fixing the arbitrary D pole to2; inferring a two-quadric matrix model from a numerical format alone.
lessons.boundary: PF2RULED57 excludes global affine-CI and normal binary presentations in all nontrivial Keller field degrees and restricts primitive-canonical projective CI formats to degree3/4. It does not exclude the full two-quadric quartic algebra or higher-degree algebras with other resolutions. The shared target index is essential; in r2q1 some index curve lies in the etale source locus. 84 controls support written proofs with primary imports, not formal or independent full verification.
lessons.reopen_when: Work with the full two-quadric quartic algebra and its essential global singular-member/index data, coupled to the marked source and trace dual. For higher degrees keep the canonical content and use formats beyond the excluded global CIs. A genuine exclusion needs an obstruction to every remaining presentation, not another assumption that the binary model is normal.

lessons.title: Clear rational adjoint orbits spectrally before asking for a projective free frame
lessons.when: A complete commuting rank-n tuple lies in a scalar Weyl algebra or a rank-one finite projective Weyl endomorphism order, and rational mates or rational centralizer field certificates are available.
lessons.use: Use the Morita denominator-ideal theorem: a rational operator with finite joint adjoint orbit clears by a nonzero polynomial in the commuting images. Rational individual mate existence is exactly nonzero annihilator of the global spectral class. Rational commutants automatically lie in the fraction field of actual commutants. QHI1 supplies scalar idealizer units; the endomorphism dimension bound and division constants argument supply QTB1 algebraicity and horizontal constants. Thus its birational/Galois/radical tests apply to rank-one projective carriers without finite generation or a scalar free frame. Transport the module and algebra together under a fractional realization change.
lessons.avoid: Equating torsion with actual spectral vanishing or full flat completion, inferring a denominator-degree bound from existence, assuming the spectral polynomials form an Ore set in the whole algebra, treating a PDO as rational, or applying rank-one units to arbitrary higher-rank matrix positions. Use complete n independent commuting images and actual finite projectivity for the Morita clearing theorem; arbitrary partial modules do not qualify.
lessons.boundary: The actual centralizer must be commutative for the field tests; QSC1 provides that for faithful Long frames. Clearing is unconditional for a finite adjoint orbit in the stated rank-one projective order, but actual mates remain stronger than rational ones. The nonfree control has spectral annihilator (xi), a rational mate and no actual mate. Curve clearing concerns a fixed linear equation and does not identify arbitrary moving coefficient localization of a spectral module. No actual new Long carrier is constructed. QCI1 uses spectral saturation to place the entire rational position centralizer in the completed image. Adjoining it cannot supply the missing Long degree3: the residual division indices remain at least3. Rational field tests remain useful, but an ordinary coefficient-field differential model with residual index1 cannot be the full Long ambient division realization. QCI1 separates rational full relations from finite admission even further: its rational degree-m family has a genuine residual extension, but one generator has bounded powers and cannot preserve any finite full Weyl lattice in any positive rank or rational matrix frame. Spectral clearing presupposes an actual finite order containing the commuting images; rational images alone do not supply that order. QPG1 separates completed division equivalence from actual C=Ahat[1/t] overlap admission. A finite projective generic spectral action with a rank-one C-frame and regular full images patches to an integral graph carrier; spatially rational completed division entries alone do not qualify. Generic freeness, if proved, then suffices for the scalar integral frame. QVA1 promotes the overlap comparison under the additional finite generic rank-one full-action hypotheses. Gauss-regularity forces a principal saturated initial ideal and a C-frame; any completed division intertwiner between two regular full scalar formal graphs is a C-unit. Bare division equivalence or rational spectral images without a finite generic carrier still do not qualify.
lessons.reopen_when: A new candidate has computable spectral annihilator ideals, a rational Galois-factor/radical certificate in its Weyl division realization, or rational individual mates that can be promoted to actual zero classes and finite flat completion.

lessons.title: Use mandatory coefficient costs and source-column units before searching a joint-frame family
lessons.when: A parameterized source/output family has many potential cancellation roots and arbitrary output mixing would make direct sparsity optimization difficult.
lessons.use: Derive the full coefficient model once. Verify every scalar-times-factor product, then count disjoint mandatory nonzero groups to eliminate expensive parameter cases. Before optimizing an arbitrary output matrix, factor each source coefficient vector asg*q and certify a constant linear combination of q entries equal to1; the source column vanishes exactly on g=0. lessons.title: Retain residual quantum degree after saturating the position centralizer
lessons.when: A proposed actual Long lift or rank-one projective carrier is modeled by a coefficient-field cover, rational positional normalization or a chosen generic division index.
lessons.use: Build the tower W subset U=D(H,T) subset D with H the full rational position centralizer and d=[H:L(F)]. QPD1 and finite whole indices make d finite; differential-field bases give N_l=d*M_l and N_r=d*M_r. For the Long classical position field, H lies in the completed image, so U still completes to that image and M_l,M_r>=3. A nontrivial H has d>=3 and forces whole indices>=9. Pure coefficient-induced models have M=1 and cannot realize the lift. A rational target automorphism making all fixed positions ordinary coefficient functions would also force M=1 and is excluded, even with parameter poles.
lessons.avoid: Identifying centralizer degree with whole division degree, treating a nontrivial coefficient cover as the missing completed degree3, assuming generic left/right equality, or extending the fixed-position rational target obstruction to mixed source polarizations or arbitrary formal gauges. Check the polynomial classical joint centralizer and faithful formal frame; unscaled cotangent controls fail that hypothesis. Do not infer that residual extensions of degree greater than one are impossible in rational Weyl division rings; the explicit all-m family disproves that. Do not discard the algebraic nilpotent exception when applying the matrix power test.
lessons.boundary: The theorem constrains an actual full tuple and supplies no new Long tuple. A minimal whole index3 remains possible with birational centralizer and residual index3. The rescaled rank-three cotangent control has delta1,d3,M1,N3 and is allowed. A curve-isogeny field is not automatically the position centralizer; QIM1 remains a curve module, not a Weyl realization. No scalar frame, higher-rank matrix exclusion or all-representative nonlifting follows. QCI1 also supplies an arbitrary-rank admission test: bounded Bernstein powers of one proposed rational Weyl generator prohibit every finite full left lattice, in any rational matrix frame. Genuine residual extensions do exist: F_m=x^(1-m)*p/m,T_m=x^m has residual m with F_m as position, including m=3, but its nonpositive-degree F_m excludes every finite diagonal carrier. Swapping positions changes (d,M) from (1,m) to (m,1) without changing the whole index. QGD1 excludes the direct finite-group-quotient mechanism for the full Long image division ring: its non-Galois cubic residue cannot arise from D^G, even with parameter-pole groups and index loss. This uses the full image rather than the fixed position field and transports through arbitrary L-linear rational source/target division changes. A larger S3 Galois closure with an intermediate S2-fixed source, or a nonsymmetric residual embedding, remains possible and still needs finite admission. QGC1 closes natural larger-closure carriers under ordinary-parameter classical graph admission or arbitrary-parameter equivariance with the correct torsion-free degree-two special module. Finite valuation levels or character shifts remove the original saturation requirement. The etale obstruction concerns the extra quadratic field above Long physical target, not the unavoidable degree-three extension above its image. The original rank-one carrier therefore passes the test. Bare field extensions, unfaithful residue or excess special rank do not supply a replacement full carrier. QRA1 companion actions are regular representations from a finite differential-field extension, not the diagonal rational power-cotangent actions excluded by QCI1. Their component powers grow unboundedly and their generic rank is the cover degree. Their degree<=2 does not bound cover degree without bounding matrix size. Irreducibility over the original target division ring blocks rational rank-one extraction of this same regular action. QFR1 shows why generic division tests miss a cusp-supported class. QUR1 proves an all-ramification regular-admission obstruction for the single monic module by repolarization and a moving common zero. This is not an index contradiction, an exclusion of the QRA1 surface actions, or a proof about every Long graph carrier. QVA1 separates the new generic admission gate from an index comparison. A finite generic rank-one full action with the intended Gauss-regular shadow automatically patches to an integral carrier. It does not force equality of generic and completed indices or construct a missing residual extension. Nonprincipal normalized valuation ideals obstruct such regular actions in every degree.
lessons.reopen_when: A new full-action Long candidate realizes the required residual extension together with a finite invariant lattice, a structural theorem forbids finite admission for a stated rational-action class, or a new mixed source polarization supplies a different justified classical centralizer. Merely realizing rational residual degree3 is no longer the missing existence gate.

lessons.title: Match primary identifiers and retained claims before importing a literature result
lessons.when: A literature search or aggregator presents a potentially newer moment/vanishing theorem or counterexample.
lessons.use: Open the primary identifier and match title, author and version before using the theorem. Search the whole current ledger, including archived canonical records, before calling a source new. Reconcile changes of multiplier sign and distinguish variable count, operator order and ordinary-Laplacian power. Treat older open-status remarks as dated evidence rather than replacing current scoped claims.
lessons.avoid: Importing a secondary GVC title attached to an unrelated primary identifier; repeating the already retained DVG1 construction; treating the five-variable third-order operator as a solution of the ternary low-Laplacian-power or rank-efficient compression frontier.

Primary2610.02911 is unrelated to the secondary GVC attribution and is rejected as a GVC source. lessons.reopen_when: A matching primary version changes the theorem, a genuinely different operator/degree/dimension witness is verified, or the retained claim no longer matches the source.

lessons.title: Build the canonical dual embedding before choosing a quartic pencil or deleting residual sheets
lessons.when: A finite flat Gorenstein algebra over the plane is being modeled globally, or the whole surviving quartic Keller normalization is pulled back by its marked etale plane source.
lessons.use: Take the annihilator of1 in the RELATIVE DUAL Hom_A(B,A), not an arbitrary trace-zero coordinate submodule of B. Its Frobenius hyperplane gives the canonical embedding; prove its arithmetic Gorensteinness and all-degree quadratic generation directly. For d>=4 the free quadratic ideal module has rank d(d-3)/2. The whole quartic therefore has a global two-quadric pencil, with its actual normal determinant cubic and no globally everywhere-smooth member. Pull back the full finite normalization, split the etale diagonal, and retain the full smooth residual cubic V. Source-side tangent normalization gives the universal residual equation and determinant identity.
lessons.avoid: Assuming all normal higher-degree finite normalizations are Gorenstein; importing uniqueness from an arbitrary nondegenerate embedding without arithmetic Gorensteinness; counting quadrics without proving ideal generation; inferring a field-degree bound from the canonical format; replacing N x_A U by the possibly nonfinite U x_A U off-diagonal; treating source polynomial basis changes as target-field changes; applying the A1-normalization power-difference theorem to the smooth pulled-back branch without checking its normalization; asserting V is a plane, rational or monogenic.
lessons.boundary: PF2RULED58 proves the all-degree Gorenstein canonical construction and makes the complete two-quadric presentation unconditional for every surviving quartic, independent of all source orders and rulings. The 2026 primary correction and its collinear-point counterexample are retained. The full source residual is a smooth finite flat cubic and equals the normal resolvent pullback. It does not exclude all such algebras, treat non-Gorenstein higher-degree normalizations, or prove the Keller conjecture.

lessons.reopen_when: Filtration or witness division fails, endpoint paths feed each other, formal specialization increases degrees, or the frame restriction is unavailable.

lessons.title: Combine divisor filtrations formally before specializing shared polynomial factors
lessons.when: Several seed-row valuations are available for divisors that can share roots or specialize to constants, or uniform endpoint step costs overestimate displacement paths.
lessons.use: Treat divisors as independent graded variables with compatible derivatives, prove each pole estimate for actual seeds and exact witnesses, combine product divisibility in the formal UFD, and specialize only afterward. Use fractional amplitude grades and ceiling exponents where integral grades fail. Cancel common powers, including negative early powers as multiplication, and scale completed rows. For nonfeeding endpoint paths, bound cumulative cost by exponent displacement before determinant arithmetic.
lessons.avoid: Multiplying separate divisibility claims after actual divisors have acquired common factors; assuming specialized coprimality; deriving t-degree savings by dividing constants; taking integer amplitude grades without checking principal branches; omitting denominator/vertical/basis derivatives; inferring odd173 or homogeneous145 from even174/146.

lessons.title: Keep coefficient fields independent and use polynomial directions on multiplier components to handle overlap
lessons.when: Root coefficients overlap multiplier variables or live in algebraic and function-field parameter extensions.
lessons.use: Prove the algebraic-coefficient theorem itself before spreading to arbitrary fields: lift relative bad inertia to the original-target Galois closure, use original plane nonproperness, make outer critical values integral and apply the actual parameter-cover norm theorem. Spread any later factor to a finite coefficient algebra with explicit denominator and degree guards. On each geometric multiplier component, use its independent function field and a surviving polynomial Z direction to get source transitivity. The exact row lattice has zero source-fixed subgroup even for different row component counts. Combine full closed content levels with a generic positive filtration and rank-two reflexive descent. A polynomial Bezout leading coefficient gives a determinant-one presentation with uniform positive weights, including every monic root term with arbitrary overlapping lower coefficients. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons.avoid: Treating the old parameter extension statement as already allowing new algebraic coefficients; identifying coefficient parameters with original source g; applying plane nonproperness on a parameter-cover source; losing vertical components without checking dominance; counting rows by total degree; confusing multivariable gcd one with comaximality; dropping the generic positive filtration or exact content hypotheses; inferring full splitting groups.

lessons.title: Test full quantum symmetry quotients using their Galois residue covers
lessons.when: A full quantum image or rank-one projective Long carrier is modeled as a finite symmetry quotient, or hidden division automorphisms and generic/completed index loss need to be controlled.
lessons.use: For W=D^G, keep every conjugate h-valuation, construct branch selectors and average only after suppressing the other branches. The residue field of W is the fixed field of the valuation stabilizer H, whose residue action is faithful in characteristic zero. Thus the classical residue extension must be Galois, even if G has h poles. Generic indices are |G| and the selected completed index is |H|; the index loss counts the other branches. Long has a non-Galois cubic residue extension with trivial deck group, so it admits no such direct finite quotient. Its completed automorphism group is trivial. lessons.title: Use both affine-space quotient unit groups to turn a moved additive action into a pencil, or force an invariant image
lessons.when: A generic positive filtration is missing but the observable fibre carries relative locally nilpotent derivations.
lessons.use: An F-defined locally nilpotent derivation gives equal additive degrees on conjugate principal image components. If it moves their product, the common degree is positive, and any generic unit must be scalar by restriction to one affine-space component. The first component relation makes its multiplier degree zero; restriction to the opposite component and the same degree contradiction make it scalar. This supplies the common generic pencil without a scalar degree-zero kernel or finite filtered pieces. Rank-two reflexive descent gives the inverse. Thus nonautomorphic images are fixed by every relative additive action; joint kernel F suffices to close them. For overlapping polynomial-direction outputs the natural actions have exact joint kernel F[X], and primitive content descends this globally to C[T,V,X]. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. lessons.title: Test finite closure carriers through graph congruence and character shifts
lessons.when: A natural valued division closure is proposed as a finite left target-Weyl carrier, including when its ambient residue map is not faithful.
lessons.use: Use the finite residue multiplier ring criterion. At ordinary quantum parameter, an identified classical graph makes the divided left/right operators preserve the ambient valuation filtration; noetherianity makes every residue level finite and Ore clearing makes one full. Its multiplier ring is finite etale, so ramification is excluded without original saturation. More generally scalar graph congruence modulo a(t) gives the same argument. For equivariant split-abelian covers with a torsion-free special module of the correct degree, rank specialization and QGD1 force valuation invariance; each character has generic and special rank1. Finite central parameter shifts make all character residue maps injective and recover a full saturated carrier. Long quadratic relative group is forced to be order2, covering all parameter ramification.
lessons.avoid: Inferring automatic saturation from finiteness, parameter flatness, full right Weyl relations or even the correct identity graph; genuine constant-cover controls refute that. Do not replace identified graph action by set-theoretic support. Do not apply character repair when the special module has S-torsion, excess rank or unsplit higher-dimensional character data. Keep the relative closure index separate from Long whole image index. Do not apply scalar field-potential cancellation to arbitrary matrix corrections.
lessons.boundary: Long quadratic source closure ramifies at Q=(3ra-2)^2-8rv=0 inside the affine source. Its natural finite carrier is excluded at ordinary parameter with correct classical graph, and at every ramified parameter when equivariant with a torsion-free degree-two special module. The ordinary rank-one Long graph passes because its extra residue field is just k. Constant quadratic/cubic full Weyl carriers are nonsaturated but admit exact finite character repairs and are allowed etale covers. The ideal A_R*x+A_R*t has special S-torsion and at ordinary parameter lacks the identified graph. Nonequivariant ramified actions without scalar quantum-order graph congruence, changed matrix actions, and other special-module structures require separate actual admission; no finite Long carrier is constructed. QIR1 automatically upgrades rank-one free special graph congruence to quantum order, even for ramified parameters. Its scalar sub-quantum corrections use End_S(S)=S. This does not remove the separate quantum-order congruence condition for a general nonequivariant closure module of special rank two or higher, where the corrections can be matrices. The original rank-one Long graph still passes the closure ramification test. QTC1 identifies the actual Long off-diagonal self-correspondence on S0=K[r,r^-1,v,v^-1,a,d] as S0[w,w^-1]/(w^2-Q). Admission of the second source point forces w inverse, so the ramified branch is omitted and the ring is etale but nonfinite over S0. Dual composition therefore does not automatically produce the finite closure carrier ruled out by QGC1. Its special boundary is already nonfinite; a different closure construction must prove finite admission independently. QRA1 ramified companions admit full Weyl matrix actions in every cover degree. Their right classical coordinates lie on the ramified spectral cover rather than in the full physical polynomial symplectic frame required by QGC1. Thus QGC1 cannot be extended to arbitrary ramified matrix actions by dropping that frame/admission hypothesis. The exact-primitive unit obstruction is a separate all-rank gate for the elliptic monic model. QFR1 reducing-block residue is distinct from QGC1 ramified field-cover obstruction. QUR1 excludes every ramification order for the single monic inverse-isogeny module without assuming projector persistence. The rank-two argument does not supply automatic splitting or a general higher-rank closure theorem. QVA1 makes formal rank-one admission automatic for a finite generic full action with Gauss-regular scalar residue. Its scalar endomorphism argument starts from an ideal J, using (J:J)=S, and then forces its gcd normalization to be S. It does not remove the separate matrix quantum-order conditions for higher-rank closure modules or contradict QGC1 ramified-cover exclusions.
lessons.reopen_when: A direct nonsymmetric Long carrier is constructed, or a genuinely different matrix or nonequivariant ramified action supplies all Weyl relations, a finite invariant carrier and the correct descended rank-one classical graph. A natural equivariant quadratic closure with the correct classical rank is already excluded; unproved nonsaturation is not a remaining escape in that class.

lessons.use: Apply the rank-two lattice lemma to X itself. Global saturation gives a literal polynomial minimal label equation in a global helper, and the smooth-image Keller derivative makes it linear. This makes the source X rational over F; it is not yet a polynomial inverse. If the substituted multiplier is nonzero, eliminate Y and compare algebraic constants. If it is zero, X lies in C(T); polynomial-output irreducibility makes the L-base change a domain, while the actual source gives the finite self tensor L tensor_F L. Its multiplication map forces degree one. Thus every one-helper polynomial-direction overlap with exact closed content levels closes in all degrees without any generic filtration, primitive content or forgetful flatness. In HC4 the admitted residual has exactly two helpers and one root variable. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. Actual source disjointness therefore makes the helper curves disjoint; ordinary helper-plane degree descends a pencil of outer degree [L:F], and IQ0 forces degree one. No curve or action classification, generic ambient filtration, primitive content, monic/Bezout certificate or stable cancellation is needed. With d=[C(s,t):C(f,g)], its smooth normal geometric generic ambient ring has scalar units and exact class lattice Z^d/Z(1,...,1). The source stabilizer fixes a selected component class, nonzero of infinite order when d>1; source-fixed class vanishing is equivalent to d=1. Thus discarding the residual hypothesis from the universal carried-inverse criterion, even with these good target fibres, primitive content, scalar units, actual closed embedding and actual unit Hessian, is equivalent to JC2. This is an open-assertion equivalence and a source-correlated class obstruction, not a proof that the inverse or class vanishing holds. Extra compatibility with intrinsic HC4 data, composite content levels, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIT0 proves by a field-norm argument that every locally finite constant Nambu direction of a complex Keller map is locally nilpotent; one nonzero such direction forces a plane Keller inverse. HC4MYIT1 uses the actual Legendre energy G=x dot grad h-h: its single-direction finite orbit is equivalent to local nilpotence on the entire source ring. Under hypothetical HC4 nonautomorphy the finite-direction space is exactly W^perp for Tang's unique affine plane, hence has dimension two; an automorphic gradient has all four directions. These intrinsic all-degree criteria need no ambient observables or generic class vanishing. No extra finite direction or recurrence is automatic; finite derivative prefixes do not prove termination. Thus h=D(z)+w dot K(z), with D=h(z,0), K_i=partial_(w_i)h(z,0) and J(K) a nonzero constant. lessons.title: Prove helper flatness and finite-line curve surjectivity before descending the disjoint source pencil
lessons.when: A carried stable image in a polynomial-direction overlap is invariant in two multiplier helpers, under the residual and exact full closed-content hypotheses.
lessons.use: Check multiplier-zero images first using parameter-row descent and within-row transitivity. Otherwise the finite coefficient-drop set has empty generic fibres, so expected dimensions and retained miracle flatness prove the helper projection flat. Flat pullback to each helper curve embeds into its polynomial generic fibre and excludes hidden components and nilpotents. Actual source components map dominantly to those curves. Restrict a coordinate to a nonconstant source line: its parameter is integral over the curve algebra, so the line is finite surjective, even for a singular curve. Polynomial source units make curve units scalar. Actual source disjointness makes the helper curves disjoint; ordinary polynomial degree gives a common descended pencil whose outer degree equals the full source-field degree. IQ0 makes it one. This closes every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension, and with IQ1 the complete admitted HC4 overlap family, in all degrees. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons.avoid: Inverting M before checking multiplier-zero source images; assuming helper faithfulness; discarding pullback components by localization; assuming curve smoothness or rectification; identifying label degree with source degree before the component bijection; extending affine-space curve surjectivity to surfaces; importing action classification or stable cancellation unnecessarily; treating the admitted family as a universal graph normal form.
lessons.boundary: HC4MYIR0 closes actual source images contained in the multiplier divisor for every helper count under the generic residual polynomial-direction hypothesis alone: the full parameter action fixes the selected row, and source within-row transitivity makes its component target-fixed. HC4MYIR1 closes every two-helper overlap with the retained residual and exact full closed-content hypotheses for all q>=1,r>=q+1 and all degrees. The coefficient-drop set in the helper plane is finite and its generic fibres are empty; all other nonempty fibres have expected dimension, proving generic forgetful flatness without faithfulness. Flat pullback excludes hidden curve components. A nonconstant line in each source affine space is finite surjective onto its helper curve by an elementary integrality argument, and curve units are scalar. Actual source disjointness therefore makes the helper curves disjoint; ordinary helper-plane degree descends a pencil of outer degree [L:F], and IQ0 forces degree one. No curve or action classification, generic ambient filtration, primitive content, monic/Bezout certificate or stable cancellation is needed. HC4MYIR2 closes the complete admitted HC4 polynomial-direction overlap family: p+q+u=3 leaves only one-helper cases and the now closed two-helper one-root case. The former IQ2 invariant plane-curve residual is no longer open inside this family. This does not supply a universal graph normal form or compatible observables. Residual-direction failures, nonconstant composite content levels, other output geometries, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. Three or more helpers in larger stable dimensions remain separate. HC4MYIS0/1/2 give a sharp universal boundary for dropping the residual polynomial direction. Every plane Keller pair K=(f,g) has the actual closed HC4-size graph j=(f(s,t),s,t,u,v) carrying it through (T,(f(X)-T)Y+g(X)), with primitive multiplier content and smooth geometrically integral fibres over every target point, hence global faithful flatness. With d=[C(s,t):C(f,g)], its smooth normal geometric generic ambient ring has scalar units and exact class lattice Z^d/Z(1,...,1). The source stabilizer fixes a selected component class, nonzero of infinite order when d>1; source-fixed class vanishing is equivalent to d=1. The helper map has dimension-jumping full fibres over the actual d source points and is not flat. The same literal graph has actual unit Hessian for Q=T^2/2+X1Y+X2Z, and transfers to the fixed Meng-Yang potential through HM0. Its constructed gradient always has an explicit polynomial inverse; the arbitrary carried pair is not the intrinsic pair of a nonautomorphic HC4 gradient. Thus discarding the residual hypothesis from the universal carried-inverse criterion, even with these good target fibres, primitive content, scalar units, actual closed embedding and actual unit Hessian, is equivalent to JC2. This is an open-assertion equivalence and a source-correlated class obstruction, not a proof that the inverse or class vanishing holds. Extra compatibility with intrinsic HC4 data, composite content levels, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIT0 proves by a field-norm argument that every locally finite constant Nambu direction of a complex Keller map is locally nilpotent; one nonzero such direction forces a plane Keller inverse. HC4MYIT1 uses the actual Legendre energy G=x dot grad h-h: its single-direction finite orbit is equivalent to local nilpotence on the entire source ring. Under hypothetical HC4 nonautomorphy the finite-direction space is exactly W^perp for Tang's unique affine plane, hence has dimension two; an automorphic gradient has all four directions. A third independent finite-energy direction, or one finite direction with nonzero inverse-Hessian square, forces the inverse. HC4MYIT2 shows that the exact constant inverse-Hessian zero cone must equal that same linear two-plane under nonautomorphy; any other cone shape forces the inverse. Zero-square directions give explicit polynomial quasi-translations. Pure whole Hodge traces and finite-energy directions may be mixed in a rank-three certificate. A linear two-plane cone also occurs for an explicitly automorphic quartic-base control and is not a converse. These intrinsic all-degree criteria need no ambient observables or generic class vanishing. No extra finite direction or recurrence is automatic; finite derivative prefixes do not prove termination. The linear-plane residual, compatible arbitrary intrinsic observables, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. Any supplied linear two-plane contained in Z_h reconstructs an actual cotangent form without assuming nonautomorphy or invoking Tang: constant source coordinates make the upper-left inverse-Hessian block zero; its cross-block determinant is a unit, and block inversion makes the complementary actual Hessian block zero. Thus h=D(z)+w dot K(z), with D=h(z,0), K_i=partial_(w_i)h(z,0) and J(K) a nonzero constant. The remaining exact-plane case has a directly recoverable intrinsic Keller pair rather than a need for longer derivative prefixes. HC4MYIU0 classifies constant-trace zero-sections for actual closed embeddings retaining two ambient free projections: rank-three helper quadrics and nonzero rank-two levels cannot be affine planes; the remaining zero-sections are reduced plane components with an actual source coordinate pair. HC4MYIU1 closes every such embedding of the intrinsic potential lambda+w dot K when the base trace is the ambient critical value lambda. The rank-two first free jet is injective on a coordinate line, while the rank-one jet is already a coordinate pair. All helper degrees and nonlinear free-variable dependence are unrestricted; no fibre-affine or generic-action hypothesis is needed. Constant invertible free frames with arbitrary polynomial base offsets are admitted when their literal trace is lambda. A different constant trace leaves only a noncritical rank-one helper plane and explicit normal first-jet corrections; that full chart remains open. HC4MYIU2 checks a universal compensation in this residual: it has unit Hessian for every normalized plane Keller input and an embedded zero-section, but global immersion already forces the inverse by a two-dimensional spectral argument and a directly proved plane nilpotent-Jacobian lemma using the retained generative input. A genuine automorphic input explicitly fails immersion, so these are not embedding converses. Arbitrary ambient translations are not assumed to preserve unit Hessian or realize arbitrary intrinsic target shifts. The remaining noncritical rank-one embeddings, arbitrary intrinsic projection data, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIV0 gives the complete all-degree noncritical compensation H=w dot A, X=c+H, (Y,Z)=K-(2c+H)A+(w2,-w1)C and its exact gauge freedom. Its zero-section coordinate obligation is not global source recovery. HC4MYIV1 reproduces the characteristic-zero weak-type-one mechanism of Borisov-Gabber-Vasiu and derives primitive-helper normality and codimension-one recovery gates. For a primitive polynomial field helper a, the implicit derivative p=q_S(F,a) generates the pullback hypersurface singular ideal. Target descent of p or a positive power forces the Keller inverse; normality, regularity along source prime-divisor images, or local embedding at every source codimension-one point also suffice. Under nonautomorphy an actually reached singular divisor is unavoidable, and at least one component must share its generic target image with another source divisor. HC4MYIV2 uses the actual Legendre energy as the canonical primitive helper, with the Adamus-Hajto primitivity proof reproduced. A Keller gradient is invertible exactly when its Legendre hypersurface is normal; a linear implicit equation gives explicit inverse coordinates. In the hypothetical nonautomorphic HC4 cotangent case, the singular-preimage divisor already consists of collision lines on generic stable source planes, with degree d-1 counted with multiplicity. The actual smooth closed embedding and this different implicit image must not be confused. No normality certificate is automatic, and a primitive field helper is not a source algebra generator. Full noncritical rank-one data, arbitrary intrinsic projections, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIW0/1/2 now close the entire noncritical rank-one closed-embedding chart and hence every constant-trace intrinsic free projection, at any constant value. IW0 proves that every positive polynomial section of the smooth affine four-quadric has the same infinite-order integral middle class as its positive zero-section plane: an explicit proper homotopy identifies sections, a two-coordinate rotation swaps the planes, and a compact real S4 pairs with that plane in one transverse point. IW1 compares two principal divisors on the actual integral image intersection. Their cycles give sum of the d generic closed source sections equal to the one zero-section plane, so (d-1)alpha=0 forces d=1 and the Keller inverse. The actual closed embedding supplies the polynomial ambient lift and every multiplicity is one. The integral cycle map and Poincare-duality foundations are explicitly imported standard inputs, not symbolic-checker conclusions. No helper degree or higher free jet remains open within this chart. IW2 combines this with IU0/1 to close every constant trace, including constant affine frames with arbitrary polynomial offsets whenever D-v^T A^(-T)K is any constant. Earlier IU/IV assertions that the full noncritical chart remained open are historical and superseded in this scope by IW1/2. Existence of aligned intrinsic ambient free projections, nonconstant traces, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIX0/1/2 advance beyond the closed constant-trace family. IX0 gives explicit actual closed A2 embeddings with every integral middle class on the smooth four-quadric, including zero, using a geometric-series polynomial inverse and an exact multiplicity-m divisor calculation. An arbitrary affine plane cannot replace an IW section, and passing to the total quadric-level family kills that fibre class. IX1 gives actual radical-curve reconstruction for nonconstant rank-one traces: D=f^2, R=C[f,y1,y2], K=y+2f a imply that K on V(f) is a closed immersion. Any actual A1 zero component, including every coordinate-composite f=P(u), forces the inverse through retained plane-line rectification and one-line injectivity, with all helper degrees allowed. IX2 shows that descent of D=f^2 already forces f=a(K). The reduced source and target zero curves are then isomorphic and every target on a=0 has one preimage. Under hypothetical degree greater than one that whole curve lies in the nonproperness set, so every component must be singular with affine normalization A1. Any smooth component or nonparametric component closes; hyperbolas and their powers are covered, while singular cusps remain open. If a(0)=0 the original cotangent potential has exactly one critical point, excluding only its unit-ideal case in this scope. New nonconstant normal traces with no actual A1 component, singular descended parametric curves, higher helper ranks, unaligned intrinsic projections, actual endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIY0/1/2 close the contractible singular-cusp boundary and strengthen the generic-pencil gate. IY0 gives the exact identity nu_s=d nu_t+E for a Keller pencil relation, where nu=2g-2+r and E retains every source puncture mapping to a finite target point with its ramification index. Equal-genus one-puncture pencils force degree one, while positive target nu and source nu below three times it also close because HW0 excludes degree two. IY1 imports the Lin-Zaidenberg classification explicitly from Palka1405.5391v2 Theorem A: independent rectifications of two isomorphic contractible plane curves give matching monomial cusps; complete preimage and square-free pullback give a pencil identity, and the exact one-puncture genus calculation forces the inverse in every degree. No selected branch is substituted for the full inverse image and no arbitrary curve isomorphism is assumed ambient extendible. IY2 applies componentwise to the actual descended radical-curve isomorphism of IX2. Every remaining target component must have an internal multibranch singularity and Euler characteristic at most zero; different-component intersections do not suffice. Singular unibranch cusps previously retained as open in IX2 are now closed in this stated scope. A saturated contractible radical component also closes without global trace descent. Remaining irreducible pencils satisfy the exact defect identity; isomorphic zero curves do not automatically identify their generic invariants. Multibranch descended components failing the pencil certificate, genuinely non-descended unsaturated traces, higher helper ranks, intrinsic ambient projection existence, actual endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIZ0/1/2 close the entire target-descended rank-one trace family, including every formerly remaining internally multibranch component. IZ0 activates Vistoli one-place compactification and explicitly imports proper-flat Euler constancy and the normalization exact sequence: the generic pencil genus is the intrinsic normalization genus plus the finite normalization deficit, with one puncture. Properness, finite presentation and flatness are verified. Thus isomorphic one-place zero curves have matching generic-pencil invariants even without ambient equivalence. IZ1 combines complete inverse-image support, square-free Keller pullback and IY0 to force degree one over any irreducible one-place curve whose entire preimage is isomorphic to it, allowing nodes and positive normalization genus. IZ2 applies to actual rank-one embeddings whenever any positive power of D belongs to C(K). HW0 makes the normal trace f target-polynomial; IX2 supplies the full radical-curve isomorphism, and under hypothetical failure the target components are A1-normalized, hence one-place. IZ1 closes every such case. There is no descended nodal or other parametric exception and no helper degree bound. A saturated one-place radical component also closes without global descent; any hypothetical remaining one-place component needs another source prime outside the radical curve over its target image. Constant affine frames and polynomial offsets are covered when the transformed trace has positive-power target-field descent. Previous IX/IY descended multibranch frontiers are historical and closed in this scope, with prior evidence bytes retained. Genuinely non-descended unsaturated rank-one traces, higher helper ranks, unaligned intrinsic projections, actual endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYJA0/1/2 make the actual extra-prime frontier explicit. JA0 proves the scheme-theoretic target image equation and exact factor a(K)=f g with the unit ideal (f,g)=R, including normal-trace multiplicities. The open-and-closed etale section makes every extra source prime disjoint from the entire radical curve and gives an elementary Nisnevich square; local excision or a unit modulo f is not a global inverse. JA1 proves that a one-place radical component under hypothetical failure needs a multi-puncture extra component carrying its defining equation p as a nonconstant unit. If every extra component has only scalar units, the inverse follows. The all-one-place alternative would make b(K) a nonlinear composition and contradict the finite critical locus forced by the Keller differential. JA2 bounds the one-place part when the selected component has A1 normalization: including that component there are at most two one-place components, and a second requires all its singularities to be ordinary nodes. Every non-nodal selected component has no one-place extra. The argument explicitly activates the one-place Milnor critical budget; the multi-puncture component still has to occur and has finite-image boundary index at least its normalized degree. Thus an actual nonconstant unit and a finite target approached from infinity are required, not merely an abstract extra prime. The new section and Milnor inputs are explicit. The full w-dependent embedding must still exclude this configuration or force descent/saturation. Genuinely non-descended traces lacking the selected one-place component, higher helper ranks, unaligned intrinsic projections, actual endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYJB0 proves that the JA0 quotient automatically extends to B/(a^m)=R/(f^m) in every order, including all multiplicities, with isomorphic completions. The standard formal-etale thickening special case is attributed to Stacks00UP Lemma10.150.6 and reproduced directly, not imported as a new unproved theorem. Neither finite normal jets nor compatible all-order formal recovery close the global gap. Fixed rational recovery does close, and bounded rational approximation degrees close once m deg f>1+N deg K; hypothetical failure forces at least one coordinate to require target degrees at least ceil((m deg f-1)/deg K). The Catalan etale-open model has all jets but a nonrational inverse and puts its trace pole, rather than its zero, at the finite-image escape. The whole-plane Keller and global embedding obligations are not satisfied by that negative control. Full w-dependent recovery, genuinely non-descended traces, higher ranks, alignment and the original HC4/JC2 problem remain open. JC0/1 additionally exclude all source parameterizations of centered semisimple quadratic-composite graph images and their quadratic-similitude saturation, in arbitrary graph/source degrees. Nonzero nilpotent pencils can have unit Hessian; neither nonsemisimple nor uncentered images are silently included. JD0 identifies all nilpotent four-variable quadratic-composite graph source orbits with the existing singleton-zero endpoint using explicit shears. With JC0/1, the new commonly centered spectral frontier is nondiagonalizable pencils with a nonzero eigenvalue; this does not exclude nilpotent unit-Hessian members or solve the endpoint. JE0/1 close every remaining common-center nonzero-Jordan case to gradient inverse under unit Hessian. The entire admitted quadratic-composite graph image family, including all source degrees and certified quadratic similitudes, reduces exactly to the old singleton-zero endpoint; no residual spectral search remains inside it. JF0/1 extend to independent centers through the exact reciprocal-Hessian rational pencil test. Invertible cyclic offsets exclude all nonlinear outer degrees; other cyclic cases have the stated infinity gate and double-resonance boundary. JF2 reduces every nilpotent affine-offset graph family to exactly the two old endpoint alternatives for universal inversion, without solving either. JG0/1 now close the entire former four-variable cyclic affine-pencil resonance by an explicit source shear and a genus-one whole-fibre obstruction. Every admitted cyclic affine-quadratic graph with nonconstant outer polynomial is inverse-closed in every source degree; a new affine-pencil mechanism beyond the known endpoints must be nonnilpotent and noncyclic. JH0 now counts compatible simple determinant poles as whole finite critical groups. JH1 excludes every affine offset of every invertible simple-spectrum pencil and the stated nondegenerate proper-Krylov families in all nonlinear outer/source degrees; compatible multiple poles, degenerate Krylov spaces and the actual endpoints are not silently included. JI0/1 now inverse-close every invertible semisimple four-variable affine pencil for every offset, including degenerate Krylov pairings and high active multiplicity, in all nonlinear outer/source degrees. This is inverse closure rather than universal unit-Hessian nonexistence. Singular pencils, the explicit two-critical-point rank-one source-orbit gate and nonsemisimple boundary cases remain separate. JK0/1 now reduce all suspended univariate multipliers and compensated graphs in arbitrary degrees to the two old source orbits and the two fixed full-source tests h0,h1. Every base-preserving polynomial source automorphism is excluded for multiplier degree>=2, including nonlinear base and dual maps. The full special-value Hodge profiles pass for h0,h1, and only source maps changing the physical base algebra could remain; their full orbits are not declared solved. JL0/1 now inverse-close every invertible four-variable affine quadratic pencil for every offset and nonlinear outer/source degree, including all nonsemisimple Jordan types and degenerate Krylov pairings. Exact plane polar genera, whole eigenvector fibre strata and complete low-genus stationary counts leave singular T as the remaining spectral boundary. This is inverse closure, not universal unit-Hessian nonexistence; h0,h1 and both actual endpoints remain open. JM0/1 now cover every rank-at-most-one affine pencil in all outer/source degrees: nonzero-eigenvalue rank one has only the invariant quadratic h0/h1 resonance, while the nilpotent branch retains the old endpoint tests. A zero-eigenvector polynomial shear and actual complete critical mass justify the suspension steps; unstabilized nonexistence alone is not assumed to stabilize. Beyond the same four fixed tests, additional affine mechanisms must have singular rank-two or rank-three T. JN0/1 now reduce every inner quadratic with a critical point and every admissible null-kernel family to the same four fixed universal tests. Specific plane/ternary quadratic stabilizations are proved from actual mass/profile evidence, not bare inverse closure. Beyond those tests the remaining affine inner must be a degree-two polynomial coordinate with singular rank-two/rank-three T and no admissible null direction; explicit cubic/quartic-plus-univariate normal forms are open frontier forms, not solutions. JO0/1 reduce every isotropic-kernel pencil, irrespective of offset orthogonality, and the entire cubic coordinate-inner family to the same four fixed tests. Positive trigonal zero-chain genus and an exact binary-cone trace retain every singular group. Beyond the four tests an additional affine mechanism requires simple zero, a nondegenerate kernel line with nonzero offset, rank T=3 and the sole quartic form with both ternary quadratics nondegenerate; that class remains open. JP0/1/2 now reduce the entire affine quadratic-composite question to the four retained tests plus three explicit quadratic-resonance cubic families N=0,x^2,2xz. The remaining nonzero-level cubic families have passing entire value profiles and common native critical Hessians and remain open; they are not assumed equivalent to h0,h1. lessons.title: Use the canonical source-correlated modification to audit residual-free inverse claims before pursuing coefficients
lessons.when: A proposed extension drops the surviving root direction from the admitted overlap theorem and replaces it with good global fibres, primitive content, scalar units or actual unit Hessian.
lessons.use: Insert an arbitrary plane Keller pair into M=f(X)-T,V=M Y+g(X) with the graph (f,s,t,u,v). Its actual closed image and smooth integral fibres everywhere do not need an inverse. The exact geometric class lattice is Z^d modulo the diagonal, where d is the original Keller field degree. The source stabilizer fixes its selected component class; it has infinite order when d>1. Thus canonical source-fixed class vanishing is equivalent to JC2. The graph also pulls Q back to f^2/2+su+tv with determinant-one Hessian and an explicit gradient inverse, and transfers to the fixed Meng-Yang potential. This checks that a merely carried pair is not automatically the intrinsic pair of a nonautomorphic gradient. Focus a broader theorem on the source-correlated class obstruction or on that additional intrinsic compatibility, rather than on degree or smoothness refinements. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons.avoid: Assuming good global fibres imply zero source-fixed generic classes; localizing away the selected multiplier-zero image; inferring principality of individual geometric components from the smooth global equation; treating a conditional degree-three permutation lattice as a nonautomorphic Keller example; equating an arbitrary carried pair with intrinsic HC4 gradient data; claiming JC2 from the equivalence.
lessons.boundary: HC4MYIS0/1/2 give a sharp universal boundary for dropping the residual polynomial direction. Every plane Keller pair K=(f,g) has the actual closed HC4-size graph j=(f(s,t),s,t,u,v) carrying it through (T,(f(X)-T)Y+g(X)), with primitive multiplier content and smooth geometrically integral fibres over every target point, hence global faithful flatness. With d=[C(s,t):C(f,g)], its smooth normal geometric generic ambient ring has scalar units and exact class lattice Z^d/Z(1,...,1). The source stabilizer fixes a selected component class, nonzero of infinite order when d>1; source-fixed class vanishing is equivalent to d=1. The helper map has dimension-jumping full fibres over the actual d source points and is not flat. The same literal graph has actual unit Hessian for Q=T^2/2+X1Y+X2Z, and transfers to the fixed Meng-Yang potential through HM0. Its constructed gradient always has an explicit polynomial inverse; the arbitrary carried pair is not the intrinsic pair of a nonautomorphic HC4 gradient. Thus discarding the residual hypothesis from the universal carried-inverse criterion, even with these good target fibres, primitive content, scalar units, actual closed embedding and actual unit Hessian, is equivalent to JC2. This is an open-assertion equivalence and a source-correlated class obstruction, not a proof that the inverse or class vanishing holds. Extra compatibility with intrinsic HC4 data, composite content levels, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIT0 proves by a field-norm argument that every locally finite constant Nambu direction of a complex Keller map is locally nilpotent; one nonzero such direction forces a plane Keller inverse. HC4MYIT1 uses the actual Legendre energy G=x dot grad h-h: its single-direction finite orbit is equivalent to local nilpotence on the entire source ring. Under hypothetical HC4 nonautomorphy the finite-direction space is exactly W^perp for Tang's unique affine plane, hence has dimension two; an automorphic gradient has all four directions. A third independent finite-energy direction, or one finite direction with nonzero inverse-Hessian square, forces the inverse. HC4MYIT2 shows that the exact constant inverse-Hessian zero cone must equal that same linear two-plane under nonautomorphy; any other cone shape forces the inverse. Zero-square directions give explicit polynomial quasi-translations. Pure whole Hodge traces and finite-energy directions may be mixed in a rank-three certificate. A linear two-plane cone also occurs for an explicitly automorphic quartic-base control and is not a converse. These intrinsic all-degree criteria need no ambient observables or generic class vanishing. No extra finite direction or recurrence is automatic; finite derivative prefixes do not prove termination. The linear-plane residual, compatible arbitrary intrinsic observables, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. Any supplied linear two-plane contained in Z_h reconstructs an actual cotangent form without assuming nonautomorphy or invoking Tang: constant source coordinates make the upper-left inverse-Hessian block zero; its cross-block determinant is a unit, and block inversion makes the complementary actual Hessian block zero. Thus h=D(z)+w dot K(z), with D=h(z,0), K_i=partial_(w_i)h(z,0) and J(K) a nonzero constant. The remaining exact-plane case has a directly recoverable intrinsic Keller pair rather than a need for longer derivative prefixes. HC4MYIU0 classifies constant-trace zero-sections for actual closed embeddings retaining two ambient free projections: rank-three helper quadrics and nonzero rank-two levels cannot be affine planes; the remaining zero-sections are reduced plane components with an actual source coordinate pair. HC4MYIU1 closes every such embedding of the intrinsic potential lambda+w dot K when the base trace is the ambient critical value lambda. The rank-two first free jet is injective on a coordinate line, while the rank-one jet is already a coordinate pair. All helper degrees and nonlinear free-variable dependence are unrestricted; no fibre-affine or generic-action hypothesis is needed. Constant invertible free frames with arbitrary polynomial base offsets are admitted when their literal trace is lambda. A different constant trace leaves only a noncritical rank-one helper plane and explicit normal first-jet corrections; that full chart remains open. HC4MYIU2 checks a universal compensation in this residual: it has unit Hessian for every normalized plane Keller input and an embedded zero-section, but global immersion already forces the inverse by a two-dimensional spectral argument and a directly proved plane nilpotent-Jacobian lemma using the retained generative input. A genuine automorphic input explicitly fails immersion, so these are not embedding converses. Arbitrary ambient translations are not assumed to preserve unit Hessian or realize arbitrary intrinsic target shifts. The remaining noncritical rank-one embeddings, arbitrary intrinsic projection data, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIV0 gives the complete all-degree noncritical compensation H=w dot A, X=c+H, (Y,Z)=K-(2c+H)A+(w2,-w1)C and its exact gauge freedom. Its zero-section coordinate obligation is not global source recovery. lessons.title: Use the actual energy and inverse-Hessian cone to certify intrinsic directions before attempting ambient observables
lessons.when: An actual complex HC4 potential has unit Hessian, with arbitrary graph shape or polynomial degree, and an intrinsic direction can be certified by an exact recurrence, zero-square identity or whole pure trace.
lessons.use: Construct the polynomial Nambu derivations from the actual inverse Hessian and G=x dot grad h-h. Commuting derivatives recover every source coordinate from G, so a finite energy orbit tests local finiteness on the whole source ring. A field norm excludes nonzero eigenvalues, making local finiteness nilpotence. Tang and the one-direction plane slice argument show that a nonautomorphic HC4 potential has exactly a two-dimensional finite-direction space W^perp. Its inverse-Hessian zero cone and pure whole-trace covectors give the same plane. Three independent certificates of any mixture, one finite direction with nonzero square, or an exact zero cone of any other shape force the gradient inverse. lessons.title: Odd dihedral torsors split formally along the entire branch; place the unavoidable cubic index away from it
lessons.when: Testing actual etale odd cyclic sign covers, a global cubic generator, or proposed exclusions based on ramification-curve gluing, inner singularities or arbitrarily high finite branch jets.
lessons.use: Restrict the anti-invariant TORSOR class to the scheme-theoretically fixed ramification curve: it is killed by2 and odd n, hence zero with all singular gluing retained. Apply Stacks nilpotent invariance to every finite thickening. A reflection has one fixed odd label and paired others, giving a global formal quotient product and a generator along the entire branch in every odd dihedral degree. For the actual cubic use (2,-1+z), trace discriminant4G, index9-G and normalized relation a^3-b^2=3G I^2. For EACH finite order choose a global primitive lift with a=1+G/3,b=1-G,I=1-G/9 to that order. Its index is nonconstant by PF56 but disjoint from the branch. Seek a global constraint from the shared conductor and marked source or Cartier Picard/linking.
lessons.avoid: Replacing torsor triviality by normalization-only line-bundle triviality; inferring Picard vanishing or global product from formal splitting; assuming restriction of odd Picard torsion to C is injective; treating a different lift at each order as one global lift of all orders; applying nilpotent invariance to a merely quasi-etale cover; deleting the square index from the norm equation; increasing local branch jets as a stand-alone exclusion; applying the theorem to arbitrary Sd or even dihedral covers.
lessons.boundary: The theorem covers every odd cyclic sign torsor with dihedral inversion and every branch degree, with etaleness at singular points required. It forces formal splitting and branch-local monogenicity but allows nontrivial global Picard torsion, as Oka Cstar confirms. The actual A1 quartic has a nonconstant index disjoint from the branch for each chosen finite approximation. Full quartic and higher-degree Keller exclusions remain open; existence of such algebraic data for the PF63 passing curves is not supplied.
lessons.reopen_when: Supply a genuinely global obstruction to the branch-avoiding index and actual normal cubic/quartic conductor, or a full source/Picard/linking mismatch. A local jet or singular-gluing obstruction must explain how it escapes the universal formal splitting theorem.

lessons.title: Compose full graph corners while checking the side of dual finiteness
lessons.when: A proposed new quantum action is assembled from finite carriers, duals, self-correspondences or normal-closure constructions.
lessons.use: For forward composition, apply the first right corner homomorphism to every entry of the second idempotent and right matrices. This produces a normalized finite corner of product size and degree bound. Track generic left and right indices and completed degrees by their separate multiplicative tower laws. A finite carrier is an integral projective generator, but its target dual is finite on the opposite target side. Before source-balanced reverse composition, reduce it to the classical fiber product. Its evaluation kernel reduces to the off-diagonal part. For a noninvertible characteristic-zero etale map of affine space this part is not finite over the source. Long exposes the boundary explicitly by w^2=Q and second-point admission w inverse.
lessons.avoid: Treating finite left and finite right as interchangeable; using Morita evaluation over the source image without proving it equals the full endomorphism algebra; promoting a division tensor bimodule to a Galois closure algebra; inferring failure of the original carrier from a nonfinite reverse composition; or inferring generic nonfiniteness solely from a nonfinite special fiber.
lessons.boundary: The universal self-product equivalence uses external fpqc descent, purity and characteristic-zero affine-space covering theory. The explicit Long localization and integrality argument are independent of the global covering theorem. Its actual etale off-diagonal cover differs from the finite ramified normalization. First-order Hochschild/Witt lifting and bounded prime degree do not give an all-order bounded realization or prescribe arithmetic support. No new Long full action or finite corner is constructed. The actual QNI1 k-fold iterates give generic indices3^k, completed degree1 and forward degree at most12^k in every rank at least three, with arbitrary identity contact and formal innerness at contact order at least two. No rank-two example or bound independent of k is inferred.
lessons.reopen_when: A new normalized finite Long corner is constructed, an all-degree obstruction excludes every such corner, or a genuinely different reverse/closure construction supplies its missing finite admission.

lessons.title: Test primitive helper recovery on source divisors and use the canonical Legendre hypersurface
lessons.when: A proposed embedding construction has a primitive polynomial field helper, a candidate normal implicit image, or complete noncritical compensation data with only generic source recovery.
lessons.use: Write the primitive implicit equation q(T,S) and pull back p=q_S. Polynomial Nambu differentiation makes the entire hypersurface singular ideal equal to (p) on the source. Target descent of p or one positive power forces the inverse. Under nonautomorphy p has an actual singular-preimage divisor, so normality or local embedding in source codimension one is enough to close the map. This reproduces the characteristic-zero weak-type-one mechanism with attribution. For a gradient, use G=x dot grad h-h: its actual derivative identity proves primitivity. Normality of the different Legendre hypersurface is equivalent to a gradient inverse, and its linear equation gives the inverse explicitly. Conditional cotangent nonautomorphy has collision lines on generic stable fibres. Keep full compensation identities and gauge freedom separate from this global recovery obligation. lessons.title: Compress a quantum defect on a reducing classical fiber block
lessons.when: A polynomial matrix classical symbol or finite special module is proposed as a physical Weyl action, especially near a singular spectral fiber.
lessons.use: At a point find a reducing idempotent block on which the relevant classical generators act scalarly. Compressed trace kills every first correction commutator, so compute its period on the full PBW Poisson defect. A nonzero period excludes all ordinary formal corrections without a degree bound. Determine the generated obstruction module by polynomial annihilator identities rather than a generic-field calculation. For the monic elliptic pair the class is S/(u,v), period1. An exhaustive negative-weight cocycle decomposition kills every quadratic lower period and excludes quantum order2. At arbitrary quantum order, check a commuting idempotent through the sub-quantum fiber representation before using the persistent-block compressed-trace obstruction. For the single monic module, use QUR1 repolarization instead: regular-sequence syzygies control every commuting lower jet at a moving common zero.
lessons.avoid: Inferring all-ramified nonlifting from one first-order obstruction, assuming a classical reducing projector persists when its character coincides with the other nilpotent block, treating localization of a punctual class as global admission, or confusing the physical [v,u]=27h plane with the QRA1 surface model where u,v commute.
lessons.boundary: QFR1 retains its all-degree ordinary and order-two finite-copy residue tests and its general persistent-block criterion. For the single monic module QUR1 removes that extra hypothesis and excludes every quantum order through a rank-two regular-sequence argument at a moving zero. Its proof does not automatically extend to arbitrary higher multiplicities or added matrix summands. The scalar forward Long graph remains formally unobstructed.
lessons.reopen_when: A genuinely different special module or a higher-multiplicity model has an admitted full action, or a normalized finite corner for the rank-one Long graph is constructed. The single monic module is closed at every parameter order; do not launch a quantum-order ladder.

Such planes specialize through saturated DVR lattices,even with ramified or denominator-bearing frames.
